Some fell on the walking path, and birds ate them immediately. (People who hear God's word, but Satan instantly snatches it away).
Some fell on gravel. They sprouted fast but burned up in the sun because they had no roots. (People who get incredibly excited about faith at first, but quit the second life gets hard).

Some fell in the weeds, which choked the plants so they couldn't produce anything. (People who hear the word, but get completely distracted by money, stress, and wanting cool stuff, so their faith dies).
But some fell in good, rich dirt and produced a massive harvest—thirty, sixty, or a hundred times what was planted! (People who hear the word, accept it, and let it change their lives)."
§The Mustard Seed

Jesus also said: "What is God's kingdom like? It's like a mustard seed. When you plant it, it's the smallest seed on earth. But once it grows, it shoots up and becomes the biggest plant in the garden, with massive branches where birds can build nests."
§Defeating the Hurricane
When evening came, Jesus told his crew, "Let's cross to the other side of the lake." They left the crowd behind.

While they were sailing, a sudden hurricane whipped up. The waves were so massive they were crashing into the boat, and it was starting to sink. Jesus was in the back of the boat, fast asleep on a cushion.
The disciples woke him up, screaming in a panic, "Teacher! Don't you care that we are about to drown?!"
Jesus woke up, told the wind to "Quiet down," and told the waves to "Chill out." Immediately, the wind stopped, and the lake went dead calm.
He looked at his crew and said, "Why are you such cowards? Do you still not have any faith?"
The disciples were absolutely terrified of him. They whispered to each other, "Who is this guy?! Even the wind and the water take orders from him!"

Mark.title: The Graveyard Zombie and the Dead Girl
paragraphs: They landed on the other side of the lake in a Gentile (non-Jewish) area. The second Jesus stepped out of the boat, a totally insane guy who lived in the graveyard charged at him. This guy was possessed by an evil spirit and was wildly strong. People had tried chaining him up, but he just snapped the chains like twigs. Day and night, he roamed the tombs screaming and cutting himself with sharp rocks.
When he saw Jesus, he fell on his knees. The demon inside him screamed, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God?! Swear to God you won't torture me!"
Jesus asked, "What is your name?"
The demon replied, "My name is Legion, because there is an entire army of us inside this guy."

The demons begged Jesus not to banish them, but to send them into a massive herd of 2,000 pigs feeding nearby. Jesus gave them permission. The demons left the man and entered the pigs. The entire herd went totally insane and stampeded right off a steep cliff into the lake, drowning. The pig herders ran away and told everyone what happened. When the locals came out, they saw the once-crazy guy sitting there fully dressed and totally normal. It freaked them out so much they begged Jesus to leave their town.
§The Healing Interruption

Jesus crossed back over the lake, and another massive crowd mobbed him. A highly respected synagogue leader named Jairus fell at Jesus's feet, begging, "My little girl is dying. Please come put your hands on her so she will live!" Jesus went with him.

In the crushing crowd, there was a woman who had been suffering from constant internal bleeding for twelve years. She had spent all her money on doctors, but only got worse. She thought, "If I can just touch his clothes, I'll be healed." She snuck up behind him, touched his jacket, and instantly, the bleeding stopped.
Jesus immediately stopped. "Who touched my clothes?" he asked. His disciples laughed, "Look at this massive crowd crushing you, and you're asking who bumped into you?"
But the woman came forward trembling and told him the truth. Jesus said, "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
§Waking the Dead
Right then, guys from Jairus's house showed up and told the dad, "Don't bother the Teacher anymore. Your daughter is dead."
Jesus ignored them and told Jairus, "Don't be afraid. Just believe."

When they got to the house, everyone was sobbing and wailing loudly. Jesus walked in and said, "Why all the screaming? The kid isn't dead; she's just taking a nap." They literally laughed in his face.
Jesus kicked everyone out except the parents and his three closest guys. He walked into the room, grabbed the dead girl's hand, and said, "Talitha koum!" (which means, "Little girl, get up!").

Instantly, the twelve-year-old girl stood up and started walking around the room. Her parents were completely out of their minds with shock. Jesus told them to keep it quiet and to go get her some food.

Mark.title: Hometown Rejection, a Gruesome Party, and Defying Gravity
paragraphs: Jesus went back to his hometown of Nazareth, but the people there just couldn't take him seriously. "Wait, isn't this the carpenter? Mary's kid?" Because they had zero respect, he barely did any miracles there. It actually blew his mind how little faith they had.

He then sent his twelve disciples out on a road trip, two by two. He gave them the power to kick out demons and heal the sick, telling them, "Pack light. No extra food, no money. Just go." They went out and completely crushed it.

A Savage Birthday Party (Trigger warning: This gets dark.) King Herod threw a massive VIP birthday party for himself. His stepdaughter did a dance that he loved so much, he stupidly promised her anything she wanted. Her mom hated John the Baptist (who was locked in Herod's prison), so she told her daughter: "Ask for John the Baptist's head on a platter." Herod was trapped in front of his friends, so he actually ordered the execution.

Feeding 5,000 and Ghosting on the Water When the disciples got back from their road trip, Jesus tried to take them across the lake for a vacation. But 5,000 men (plus families) literally ran around the lake to beat them there. Jesus felt bad for them, so he took a kid's lunch—five loaves of bread and two fish—and miraculously multiplied it to feed everyone until they were stuffed.

Later that night, the disciples were in a boat rowing against a brutal headwind. Around 3:00 AM, Jesus just casually walked out to them on top of the water. He was actually about to walk right past them, but they saw him, thought he was a ghost, and started screaming. Jesus said, "Relax! It's me. Don't be afraid." He climbed in, the wind completely died, and the guys were absolutely terrified and confused.

Mark.title: Fake Rules and a Savage Mom
paragraphs: The religious mafia (Pharisees) came all the way from Jerusalem to complain: "Why don't your guys do the ceremonial hand-washing routine before they eat?" Jesus roasted them: "You guys are massive hypocrites. You care more about your made-up traditions than God's actual rules. Listen to me: Nothing you put into your mouth makes you toxic. It's the garbage that comes out of your mouth—the hate, the greed, the jealousy, the trash-talk—that proves your heart is completely toxic."

A Mom Won't Take No for an Answer Jesus tried to travel in secret to a non-Jewish area, but a local woman found him. She fell at his feet, begging him to kick a demon out of her daughter. Jesus tested her: "It's not right to take the children's food and throw it to the dogs." She didn't even flinch. She clapped right back: "True, Lord. But even the dogs under the table get to eat the kids' crumbs." Jesus loved her comeback. "Because of that answer, you can go home. The demon is gone." And it was.

Later, they brought him a guy who was deaf and could barely speak. Jesus put his fingers in the guy's ears, touched the guy's tongue, looked up to heaven, and said, "Ephphatha!" (which means, "Open up!"). The guy's hearing and speech were instantly fixed.

Mark.title: Blind Eyes and a Hard Reality Check
paragraphs: Jesus pulled off another massive catering miracle, this time feeding 4,000 people with just seven loaves of bread and a few small fish.

Right after that, the Pharisees showed up demanding a magic trick from heaven to prove he was legit. Jesus sighed heavily from his gut. "Why are you guys always looking for a sign? You're not getting one." He got in the boat and left them standing there.

In a town called Bethsaida, some people brought a blind man to Jesus. Jesus actually spit on the guy's eyes and put his hands on him. "Can you see anything?" The guy looked around. "I see people, but they look like trees walking around." Jesus put his hands on the guy's eyes one more time, and boom—his vision was 20/20.

The Ultimate Wake-Up Call Jesus asked his crew, "Who do you guys say I am?" Peter stepped up: "You are the Messiah." Jesus said, "Keep that quiet for now. Here's the plan: The religious leaders are going to torture and kill me, but three days later, I'll rise from the dead." Peter actually pulled Jesus aside and tried to scold him for saying that. Jesus spun around and put Peter on blast in front of everyone: "Get behind me, Satan! You only care about human plans, not God's."

Jesus told the crowd: "If you want to follow me, you have to completely deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow my lead. If you try to save your life, you'll lose it. If you give your life away for me, you'll save it. What's the point of winning the whole world if you lose your actual soul?"

Mark.title: The Mountain Transformation and Real Greatness
paragraphs: Jesus took Peter, James, and John up a massive mountain. Suddenly, his clothes became blindingly white—whiter than bleach. Moses and Elijah (two legendary prophets from centuries ago) appeared and started talking to him. A cloud covered them, and God's voice thundered: "This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!" The three guys were absolutely terrified.

When they got back down to the valley, the other disciples were failing to cast a demon out of a boy who was having violent seizures. The boy's dad begged Jesus, "If you can do anything, please help us!" Jesus said, "'If you can'? Everything is possible for the person who believes." The dad immediately cried out, "I do believe! Help me overcome my unbelief!" Jesus kicked the demon out instantly. He later told his guys, "That kind of demon only comes out through prayer."
Who's the Boss? Walking home, the disciples were secretly arguing about who was the greatest among them. Jesus called them out, grabbed a little kid, put his arms around him, and said:
"If you want to be first in my kingdom, you have to go straight to the back of the line and be the servant of everyone else."
He also gave them a hardcore warning about sin: "If your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It's better to enter heaven maimed than go to hell with both hands. Take your sin seriously."

Mark.title: Rich Guys, Blind Guys, and Boss Ambitions
paragraphs: People were bringing little kids to Jesus. The disciples tried to act like bouncers and shoo them away, thinking Jesus was too important. Jesus got seriously annoyed: "Stop! Let the kids come to me. If you don't receive God's kingdom with the absolute trust of a child, you'll never get in."

The Rich VIP A wealthy young guy ran up, fell on his knees, and asked, "Good teacher, how do I get eternal life?" He bragged that he had kept all the religious rules since he was a kid. Jesus looked at him with love and said, "You're just missing one thing. Go sell everything you own, give the money to the poor, and follow me." The guy's face fell, and he walked away depressed. He was insanely rich, and his money was his real god. Jesus told his crew, "It is easier to jam a camel through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter God's kingdom."

The VIP Seats James and John pulled Jesus aside and literally asked for the two best thrones in heaven next to him. The other ten disciples heard about it and were furious. Jesus shut it down immediately:

"In the world, the rulers boss everyone around and flex their power. Not with you. Whoever wants to be great has to be a servant. I didn't come here to be served; I came to serve and give my life as a ransom for everyone."

As they left town, a blind beggar named Bartimaeus started screaming at the top of his lungs, "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" The crowd told him to be quiet, but he just yelled louder. Jesus stopped and called him over. "What do you want me to do for you?" "Rabbi, I want to see." Jesus said, "Go. Your faith has healed you." Bartimaeus got his sight back instantly and followed Jesus down the road.

Mark.title: The Parade and the Temple Takedown
paragraphs: Jesus finally arrived in Jerusalem for the Passover festival. He rode into the city on a borrowed donkey, and the crowd went wild, throwing their coats and palm branches on the road, shouting, "Hosanna! Blessed is the coming kingdom!"
The next day, Jesus walked into the massive Temple complex.

He saw the religious leaders running a massive scam—overcharging tourists who needed to buy animals for sacrifices. Jesus went into full beast mode. He started flipping over tables, kicking over chairs, and physically blocking people from carrying merchandise through the area. He yelled, "God said, 'My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations,' but you’ve turned it into a hangout for thieves!" The religious leaders were absolutely terrified of his influence and started officially plotting his murder.

Mark.title: Traps, Taxes, and the Ultimate Rule
paragraphs: The religious mafia tried to trap Jesus with impossible questions so they could arrest him.

The Tax Trap: "Is it legal to pay taxes to Caesar?" If he said yes, the Jewish crowd would hate him. If he said no, the Romans would arrest him for treason. He asked for a coin. "Whose face is on this? Caesar's? Then give Caesar his money. But give God your actual life."

The Greatest Rule: A religious scholar asked, "Out of all the commandments, which one is the absolute most important?" Jesus nailed it: "Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, mind, and strength. And the second is: Love your neighbor as yourself. Nothing is bigger than these two." The scholar agreed, and Jesus said, "You aren't far from God's kingdom." After that, nobody dared to ask him any more trick questions.

Jesus then watched the crowd dropping money into the Temple offering boxes. Rich people were throwing in massive amounts of cash. A poor widow walked up and dropped in two tiny copper coins (worth about a penny). Jesus told his crew, "She just gave more than all the rich people combined. They gave out of their extra wealth; she gave everything she had to live on."

Mark.title: The End of the World Survival Guide
paragraphs: As they left the massive Temple, a disciple said, "Look at these amazing buildings!" Jesus dropped a bomb: "See all this? Every single stone is going to be completely torn down."
Later, his core crew asked him privately when the end of the world was coming. Jesus gave them the ultimate survival guide:
Don't fall for fake messiahs.
There will be massive wars, earthquakes, and famines. That's just the warm-up.
People are going to arrest you, beat you up, and hate you just because you follow me. But the Holy Spirit will give you the words to say when you're on trial.
The sun will go dark, and the Son of Man will come through the clouds with massive power and glory.
The Main Point: Nobody knows the exact day or hour. Not the angels, not even the Son—only the Father. So stay awake and stay ready. ---

Mark.title: The Perfume, the Passover, and the Ultimate Betrayal
paragraphs: At a dinner party, a woman came up to Jesus, broke open a jar of insanely expensive perfume (worth a whole year's salary), and poured it over his head. Some people got angry, saying it was a massive waste of money. Jesus defended her: "Leave her alone! She did a beautiful thing. She's actually preparing my body to be buried."
Meanwhile, Judas Iscariot completely sold out. He went to the religious leaders and made a deal to hand Jesus over.

The Last Supper During the Passover meal, Jesus dropped a bombshell: "One of you eating with me right now is going to betray me." Everyone panicked. Then Jesus took bread, broke it, and gave it to them: "Take it; this is my body." He took a cup of wine: "This is my blood of the new covenant, poured out for many."

The Garden Ambush They went to a garden called Gethsemane. Jesus was in such deep agony he told his guys, "My soul is completely crushed with sorrow to the point of death." He begged God to find another way, but ultimately said, "Not what I want, but what you want."

Suddenly, Judas walked up with a massive mob armed with swords and clubs. Judas kissed Jesus on the cheek—the secret signal. The guards grabbed Jesus. One of Jesus's guys pulled a sword and sliced off a guard's ear, but Jesus didn't fight back. In the chaos, every single disciple abandoned him and ran into the night. (Fun fact: One young guy who was following them got grabbed by his shirt, slipped out of it, and literally ran away naked.)

The religious council put Jesus on trial in the middle of the night, spitting on him and beating him. Outside in the courtyard, Peter was recognized. Just like Jesus predicted, Peter cursed and swore three times, "I don't even know the guy!" The rooster crowed. Peter broke down and sobbed.

Mark.title: The Trial, the Torture, and the Cross
paragraphs: The leaders dragged Jesus to Pilate, the Roman governor. Pilate knew Jesus was innocent and that the religious leaders were just jealous, but the crowd was rioting, screaming, "Crucify him!" Pilate caved to the mob, released a literal murderer named Barabbas instead, and handed Jesus over to be executed.

The Roman soldiers dragged Jesus into the courtyard. They dressed him in a fake purple robe, twisted together a crown of massive thorns, and smashed it onto his head. They beat him over the head with sticks, spit on him, and mocked him.

They forced him to carry his cross to Golgotha (The Place of the Skull). They nailed him to the wood. The religious leaders walked by, taunting him, "He saved others, but he can't save himself! Come down from the cross, and we'll believe you!"
At noon, the entire sky went pitch black for three straight hours. Jesus screamed out, "My God, my God, why have you abandoned me?" He took one last breath and died.

The exact second he died, the massive, heavy curtain inside the Temple ripped violently in half from top to bottom. A tough Roman commander standing right in front of the cross saw how he died and said, "This man truly was the Son of God."

A respected leader named Joseph of Arimathea bravely asked Pilate for Jesus's body. He wrapped Jesus in linen, put him in a tomb carved out of solid rock, and rolled a massive boulder over the entrance.

Mark.title: The Empty Tomb and the Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: Very early on Sunday morning, Mary Magdalene and two other women bought spices to anoint Jesus's body. They were walking to the tomb, wondering, "Who is going to help us roll that massive stone away?"
But when they got there, the stone was already rolled back!

They walked into the tomb, and a young man wearing a glowing white robe (an angel) was just sitting there. The women completely freaked out. The angel said, "Don't be terrified. You are looking for Jesus, who was crucified. He isn't here! He has risen from the dead! Look, here is where they put him. Now go tell his disciples—especially Peter—that he is going ahead of you to Galilee, just like he promised."

(Note: The oldest, most original manuscripts of Mark end right here on a massive cliffhanger): The women ran out of the tomb, trembling and completely bewildered. They were so absolutely terrified that they didn't say anything to anyone.

(Later additions to Mark wrap up the story): Jesus appeared first to Mary Magdalene, then to two guys walking in the country, and finally to the remaining eleven disciples while they were eating. He gave them their ultimate mission:
"Go into the entire world and preach the Good News to absolutely everyone. Anyone who believes and is baptized will be saved."

After speaking to them, the Lord Jesus was taken up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God. The disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord backed up their message with massive power and miracles.

Luke.title: Two Impossible Babies
paragraphs: The Temple Shock Back when Herod was king of Judea, there was a priest named Zechariah. He and his wife, Elizabeth, were good, rule-following people who honored God. But they had a massive heartbreak in their lives: they couldn't have kids, and now they were practically senior citizens.

One day, Zechariah was on duty inside the main Temple sanctuary, burning incense. The crowd was outside praying. Suddenly, an angel of the Lord appeared, standing right next to the altar. Zechariah froze, absolutely terrified.
But the angel said to him:

"Don't be afraid, Zechariah! God heard your prayer. Your wife Elizabeth is going to have a son, and you are going to name him John. He is going to bring you massive joy, and he will be a legendary prophet filled with the Holy Spirit before he is even born. He's going to turn the hearts of the people back to God and get them ready for the Lord."
Zechariah looked at him and essentially said, "Yeah right. Prove it. I'm an old man, and my wife is old too. How can I be sure this is real?"

The angel was not amused. "I am Gabriel. I stand in the actual presence of God, and He personally sent me to give you this good news. But because you didn't believe my words, you are going to be completely mute. You won't be able to speak a single syllable until the day this baby is born."
When Zechariah finally came out to the crowd, he couldn't talk. He just kept making hand gestures, and everyone realized he had seen a vision. Sure enough, he went home, and Elizabeth got pregnant.

The Teenage Virgin Six months later, God sent Gabriel on another mission, this time to a tough little town called Nazareth. He appeared to a virgin named Mary, who was engaged to a carpenter named Joseph.
Gabriel walked in and said, "Greetings! You are highly favored, and the Lord is with you."
Mary was super confused and honestly a little freaked out. She wondered what kind of greeting this was. Gabriel said:

"Don't be afraid, Mary. God has chosen to bless you. You are going to get pregnant and give birth to a son, and you will name him Jesus. He will be incredibly great and will be called the Son of the Most High. God will give him the throne of his ancestor David, and his kingdom will never, ever end."
Mary asked the obvious question: "How is that even possible? I'm a virgin."

Gabriel answered, "The Holy Spirit will come over you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. The baby will be holy—the Son of God. Look, even your old relative Elizabeth is six months pregnant right now. Absolutely nothing is impossible with God."
Mary bravely took a deep breath and said, "I am the Lord's servant. Let it happen exactly like you said." And the angel left.

The Hype Song and the Naming Mary rushed to visit Elizabeth. The absolute second Mary walked through the door and said hello, the baby inside Elizabeth (John) literally leaped for joy. Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit and loudly blessed Mary. Mary responded by dropping an epic, poetic song (known as the Magnificat) about how God was about to flip the world upside down—crushing the arrogant billionaires and lifting up the humble and hungry.

When it was time for Elizabeth's baby to be born, all the neighbors and relatives showed up to celebrate. On the eighth day, they were about to name him Zechariah Jr. after his dad. Elizabeth stepped in: "No. His name is John." They argued with her. "Nobody in your family has that name!"

They turned to Zechariah and used sign language to ask him. He asked for a writing tablet and wrote: "His name is John." The exact second he wrote that, his voice came back. He immediately started praising God and gave a massive prophecy about how his new son would prepare the way for the Savior of the world.

Luke.title: The Real Christmas Story and the Temple Flex
paragraphs: Around that time, the Roman Emperor, Caesar Augustus, flexed his power and ordered a massive census across the entire empire. Everyone had to travel back to their ancestral hometown to register. Because Joseph was a descendant of King David, he packed up a very pregnant Mary and hiked from Nazareth all the way to Bethlehem.

When they got there, the town was totally packed. There were no guest rooms left anywhere. So, when Mary went into labor, she wrapped her newborn son tightly in strips of cloth and laid him in a manger (a feeding trough for animals).

The Shepherds' Alert That same night, there were some tough, lower-class shepherds out in the fields guarding their sheep. Suddenly, an angel of the Lord appeared right in front of them, and the blinding glory of God lit up the entire field. The shepherds were absolutely terrified.
The angel said:

"Don't panic! I am bringing you massive good news that will bring ultimate joy to all people. Today in the town of David, a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord. Here is how you'll know it's him: you will find a baby wrapped tightly in cloth, lying in a feeding trough."
Suddenly, a massive army of angels appeared in the sky, shouting and praising God: "Glory to God in the highest heaven, and peace on earth to the people he favors!"

When the angels left, the shepherds looked at each other and said, "Let's go to Bethlehem right now and see this!" They sprinted to the town, found Mary, Joseph, and the baby in the manger. Then they went out and told literally everyone they could find about what had just happened.

The Temple Flex (12 Years Later) Fast forward twelve years. Every year, Jesus's parents traveled to Jerusalem for the massive Passover festival. When the festival ended, Mary and Joseph started the long walk home, assuming 12-year-old Jesus was hanging out with the other kids in their massive traveling caravan.
After a full day of walking, they realized he was missing. They panicked, ran all the way back to Jerusalem, and frantically searched the city for three days.

They finally found him sitting right in the middle of the Temple, surrounded by the most highly educated religious PhDs in the country. He wasn't just listening; he was asking them high-level questions, and everyone there was mind-blown by how deeply he understood everything.

His parents were astonished, but Mary was upset. "Son, why did you do this to us? Your father and I have been terrified, searching everywhere for you!" Jesus looked at them and calmly said: "Why were you searching everywhere? Didn't you know I had to be in my Father's house?" They didn't really understand what he meant, but he obediently went back to Nazareth with them and continued to grow up, gaining favor with God and people.

Luke.title: The Savage Preacher and the Family Tree
paragraphs: It was the fifteenth year of Emperor Tiberius's rule. Pontius Pilate was the governor, and the religious high priests were Annas and Caiaphas.

During this time, the word of God came to John (Zechariah's son) out in the desert. He started hiking all around the Jordan River, preaching a baptism of changing your mind and getting your sins forgiven.
Massive crowds came out to get baptized, but John didn't sugarcoat anything for them. He was savage:

"You bunch of poisonous snakes! Who warned you to run from God's coming anger? Prove that you have actually changed your lives! Don't just stand there and think, 'We're safe because Abraham is our ancestor.' God could turn these rocks into children of Abraham! The axe is already swinging at the roots of the trees. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit is getting chopped down and thrown into the fire."

The crowd was shaken. "What should we do then?" John gave them real, practical rules: "If you have two shirts, give one to the guy who has none. If you have extra food, share it." Even the corrupt tax collectors showed up. "Teacher, what should we do?" John said: "Stop scamming people. Don't collect a single penny more than you are required to." Some soldiers asked, "What about us?" John said: "Stop extorting people, stop framing people with fake charges, and be satisfied with your paycheck."

People were so excited they started wondering if John was actually the Messiah. John shut that down immediately: "I'm just baptizing you with water. But a guy is coming who is so vastly powerful that I'm not even worthy to untie his shoes. He is going to baptize you with the Holy Spirit and with literal fire."

The Ultimate Endorsement One day, when all the people were being baptized, Jesus stepped into the water and was baptized too. As he was praying, heaven physically tore open, and the Holy Spirit came down on him in a physical form that looked like a dove. A voice boomed from heaven: "You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am incredibly pleased."

(Luke then lists Jesus's family tree. But unlike Matthew, who started with Abraham to prove Jesus was Jewish royalty, Luke works backward. He traces Jesus's lineage from Joseph, back through King David, back through Abraham, back through Noah, all the way back to Adam, the very first human created by God. Luke does this to prove one massive point: Jesus is fully connected to the entire human race. He is the Savior for everyone.)

Luke.title: The Desert Showdown and the Hometown Mob
paragraphs: Jesus, totally full of the Holy Spirit, left the Jordan River and was led by the Spirit straight into the brutal, unforgiving desert.

For forty days, he ate absolutely nothing. He was starving. The devil showed up to take advantage of his physical weakness and test him: "If you're really the Son of God, tell this rock to turn into a loaf of bread." Jesus blocked the attack, quoting the Scriptures: "It is written: 'People need more than just bread to survive.'"

Strike Two: The devil took him up high and showed him a massive vision of all the kingdoms on earth in a single second. "I will give you all this power, wealth, and glory," the devil said. "It's all mine to give away. Just get down on your knees and worship me, and it's all yours." Jesus blocked it again: "It is written: 'Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.'"

Strike Three: The devil took him to Jerusalem, right to the highest point of the massive Temple. "If you're God's Son, jump off! The Scriptures say God will send angels to catch you so you don't even stub your toe." Jesus shut him down one last time: "It also says: 'Do not put the Lord your God to the test.'" The devil, completely defeated, backed off to wait for a better opportunity.

The Mic Drop in Nazareth Jesus headed back to the Galilee region, and rumors about his power were spreading like wildfire. He went back to his hometown, Nazareth, and went to the synagogue (the local gathering place) on the Sabbath.
He stood up to read, and they handed him the scroll of the ancient prophet Isaiah. He unrolled it and found this exact spot:

"The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he chose me to preach good news to the poor. He sent me to announce freedom for the prisoners, to give sight back to the blind, and to set the crushed and broken people free."

He showed up the scroll, handed it back, and sat down. Every single eye in the room was glued to him. He looked at them and dropped the mic: "Today, this scripture has come true right while you were listening."

At first, the hometown crowd was amazed. But then they started whispering, "Wait, isn't this just Joseph's kid?" Jesus knew they wanted him to do magic tricks for them like he did in other towns. But he reminded them that God often bypasses arrogant insiders to bless total outsiders. He gave them historical examples: "During a massive famine, God didn't send the prophet Elijah to help the widows in Israel; he sent him to a foreigner. And the prophet Elisha didn't heal the Israelites with leprosy; he only healed Naaman, the commander of an enemy army."

When the crowd heard this, they absolutely lost their minds. They were so insanely triggered that they formed a violent mob, dragged Jesus out of the synagogue, and pushed him to the edge of a massive cliff, intending to throw him off and kill him. But Jesus didn't panic. He literally just walked right through the middle of the screaming mob and went on his way. It was the ultimate boss move.

He went down to the city of Capernaum. While he was teaching, a guy possessed by a demon started screaming at the top of his lungs: "Go away! What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth?! I know exactly who you are—the Holy One of God!" Jesus didn't flinch. "Be quiet and get out of him!" he ordered. The demon violently threw the man to the ground right in front of everyone and left without actually injuring him. Everyone was terrified and amazed by his authority.

Later that day, he went to Simon Peter's house and instantly healed Peter's mother-in-law from a severe fever. At sunset, the whole town brought their sick and demon-possessed friends to him, and he healed every single one of them.

Luke.title: Sinking Boats and Ripping Roofs
paragraphs: One day, Jesus was standing by the Lake of Gennesaret (the Sea of Galilee). The crowd was pressing in so hard to hear him that he was about to get pushed into the water.
He saw two empty boats on the beach. He climbed into the one belonging to Simon Peter and asked him to row out a little bit. Jesus sat down in the boat and taught the massive crowd from the water.

When he finished, he turned to Peter: "Row out into the deep water and drop your nets for a catch." Peter sighed. "Boss, we've been working our guts out all night long and didn't catch a single fish. But... because you said so, I'll drop the nets."

When they did, they caught so many fish that the nets actually started to snap. They frantically waved for their partners in the other boat to come help. They filled both boats so full of fish that they literally started to sink.

When Simon Peter saw the sheer scale of the miracle, he collapsed at Jesus's knees, totally overwhelmed. "Get away from me, Lord! I am a sinful mess of a man." He and his partners, James and John, were completely awestruck. Jesus smiled at Peter. "Don't be afraid. From now on, you're not going to be catching fish. You're going to be catching people." They pulled their boats up onto the beach, walked away from the biggest payday of their lives, and followed him.

Healing the Untouchable In one of the towns, a man showed up who was absolutely covered in advanced leprosy (a highly contagious, flesh-eating disease). In that culture, lepers were complete outcasts—people would throw rocks at them if they got too close. But this guy fell face-down in the dirt and begged, "Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean." Jesus reached out his hand and actually touched the untouchable man. "I want to," Jesus said. "Be clean." Instantly, the disease vanished.

The Roof Crashers A few days later, Jesus was teaching in a packed house. Some of the top religious experts (Pharisees) from all over the country were sitting right there in the front row, watching him closely.

Four guys arrived carrying their paralyzed buddy on a sleeping mat, but they couldn't even get near the door because of the massive crowd. So, they carried him up the outside stairs to the flat roof, literally ripped off the roof tiles, and lowered the paralyzed guy on ropes right down into the middle of the room, landing directly in front of Jesus.

When Jesus saw how massive their faith was, he looked at the paralyzed guy and said, "Friend, your sins are forgiven." The religious experts immediately started thinking to themselves, "This is pure blasphemy! Who does this guy think he is? Only God can forgive sins." Jesus knew exactly what they were thinking. He said, "Why are you questioning this in your hearts? What's easier to say: 'Your sins are forgiven' or 'Get up and walk'?" He looked at the experts. "Just to prove to you that the Son of Man has the authority on earth to forgive sins..." He turned back to the paralyzed man. "I tell you, get up, grab your mat, and go home." Instantly, the guy stood up in front of everyone, grabbed his mat, and walked out of the house praising God. The crowd lost their minds. "We have seen impossible things today!"

Drafting the Hated Tax Collector Later, Jesus walked past a tax collection booth and saw a guy named Levi (Matthew) sitting there. (Tax collectors were hated by everyone because they worked for the occupying Roman army and scammed their own people). Jesus just looked at him and said, "Follow me." Levi got up, left everything behind, and followed him.

Levi was so excited he threw a massive VIP banquet at his house for Jesus. A huge crowd of tax collectors and other shady characters were there eating with them. The stuck-up Pharisees complained to Jesus's disciples: "Why are you guys eating and drinking with outcasts?" Jesus answered them directly: "Healthy people don't need a doctor—sick people do. I didn't come to invite the rule-followers to change their lives; I came to invite the misfits."

They then complained that Jesus's guys were having parties instead of fasting and acting super serious and religious. Jesus basically told them: "You can't pour a massive, explosive new movement into old, rigid religious rules. If you put new fermenting wine into old, brittle leather wineskins, they will burst. You need new wineskins for new wine."

Luke.title: The Rule Breaker and the Upside-Down Kingdom
paragraphs: One Sabbath day (the strict day of rest), Jesus and his crew were walking through some wheat fields. His guys were hungry, so they snapped off some heads of wheat, rubbed them in their hands, and ate the grain. Some Pharisees immediately threw a flag on the play: "Why are you doing what is illegal on the Sabbath? That counts as harvesting!" Jesus shut them down with Bible history: "Haven't you ever read what King David did when he and his soldiers were starving? He went into the house of God and ate the sacred bread that only priests are allowed to eat." Then he dropped the hammer: "The Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath."

The Trap in the Synagogue On another Sabbath, Jesus was teaching in the synagogue. A guy was there whose right hand was completely shriveled up. The Pharisees and legal experts were watching Jesus like hawks, waiting to see if he would heal the guy so they could arrest him for "working" on the weekend.

Jesus knew exactly what they were plotting. He told the guy with the bad hand, "Get up and stand right here in the middle of the room." The guy stood up. Jesus looked at the haters and asked, "I have a question for you. What is legal on the Sabbath: to do good, or to do evil? To save a life, or to destroy it?" They just stared at him. He looked around at all of them, then looked at the man and said, "Stretch out your hand." The man did, and his hand was perfectly restored. The religious leaders were absolutely furious and immediately started discussing how to take Jesus out.

Drafting the Starting Lineup Around this time, Jesus went out to a mountainside and spent the entire night praying to God. When the sun came up, he called his followers together and officially drafted twelve of them to be his "Apostles" (his core messengers). The squad was: Simon (who he renamed Peter), his brother Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James (son of Alphaeus), Simon the Zealot, Judas (son of James), and Judas Iscariot (the guy who eventually became the traitor).

The Upside-Down Rulebook (The Sermon on the Plain) Jesus came down the mountain with his new crew and stood on a level area with a massive crowd. People had come from all over the country to hear him and get healed. Power was literally coming out of him, curing everyone.
He looked at his disciples and delivered a speech that completely flipped the world's definition of success upside down:

The Blessings: "You are incredibly blessed when you are poor, because the kingdom of God is yours. You are blessed when you are hungry right now, because you will be satisfied. You are blessed when you weep, because you will laugh. And you are blessed when people hate you, exclude you, and trash-talk you just because you follow me. Jump for joy when that happens, because your reward in heaven is going to be massive!"

The Reality Check: "But watch out if you are rich right now—you've already gotten all the comfort you're going to get. Watch out if you are stuffed with food—you will go hungry. Watch out if you're laughing it up now—you will mourn and weep. And watch out if everyone thinks you're awesome and popular—that's exactly how their ancestors treated the fake prophets."

Savage Love "But to those of you who are actually listening, I say this: Love your enemies. Do good to the people who hate you. Bless the people who curse you. Pray for the people who treat you like dirt. If someone punches you on one cheek, turn and offer them the other one too. If someone steals your coat, give them your shirt as well.

Treat other people exactly how you want them to treat you. If you only love people who love you back, what's so special about that? Even the worst sinners do that. If you only do favors for your friends, big deal. Love your enemies! Be merciful, exactly like your Father is merciful."

Stop Playing Referee "Stop judging other people, and you won't be judged. Forgive, and you will be forgiven. Why do you obsess over the tiny speck of sawdust in your buddy's eye, but completely ignore the massive telephone pole sticking out of your own eye? You're a hypocrite! Take the plank out of your own eye first, and then you'll actually be able to see clearly to help your friend."

The Rock vs. The Dirt "A good tree doesn't produce rotten fruit, and a rotten tree doesn't produce good fruit. You can tell what a person is really like by what they say—whatever is overflowing in their heart is what comes out of their mouth.

Why do you guys call me 'Lord, Lord,' but you don't actually do what I say? Whoever listens to my words and puts them into action is like a smart builder who digs deep and builds the foundation of his house on solid rock. When the river floods and the water smashes against the house, it doesn't even shake. But the guy who hears my words and ignores them is like a fool who builds a house on the dirt with absolutely no foundation. The second the flood hits it, it completely collapses into a massive wreck."

Luke.title: The Roman Boss and the VIP Party Crasher
paragraphs: After Jesus finished his massive speech, he headed into the town of Capernaum.
There was a Roman Centurion (a high-ranking, tough-as-nails commander of the occupying enemy army) who had a servant he highly valued. The servant was incredibly sick and about to die.

When the Centurion heard about Jesus, he sent some respected Jewish leaders to ask Jesus to come save his servant. They pleaded with Jesus: "This guy actually deserves your help. He loves our nation and even paid to build our synagogue."
Jesus went with them. But when he got close to the house, the Centurion sent friends out to stop him with a message:

"Lord, don't bother coming all the way here. I'm not worthy to have you under my roof. Just say the word from right where you are, and my servant will be healed. I know exactly how authority works. I tell a soldier to go, and he goes. I tell a guy to do this, and he does it."

When Jesus heard that, he was absolutely blown away. He turned to the massive crowd following him and said, "I'm telling you, I haven't found faith this massive anywhere in all of Israel." When the messengers got back to the house, the servant was completely healed.
§Crashing a Funeral

Soon after, Jesus went to a town called Nain. As he walked up to the town gate, a funeral procession was coming out. A young guy had died, and he was the only son of his mother, who was already a widow.
When Jesus saw her crying, his heart absolutely broke for her. He walked right up and said, "Don't cry."

Then he stepped up and actually touched the coffin. The guys carrying it froze. Jesus looked at the dead body and said, "Young man, I say to you, get up!" The dead guy literally sat right up and started talking. Jesus handed him back to his mom.
The crowd was completely terrified and started praising God. "A massive prophet has shown up! God has come to help his people!"
§John the Baptist's Doubts

Meanwhile, John the Baptist was locked up in prison, and it was messing with his head. He sent two of his guys to ask Jesus, "Are you really the Messiah we've been waiting for, or should we keep looking for someone else?"

Right then, Jesus cured a bunch of people and kicked out some demons. He told John's guys, "Go back and tell John exactly what you just saw: the blind can see, the paralyzed are walking, the dead are waking up, and the poor are hearing good news. Tell him not to doubt me."

After they left, Jesus hyped up John to the crowd: "John isn't some soft guy wearing fancy silk suits in a palace. He is the greatest prophet who ever lived. But honestly, even the least important person in God's kingdom is greater than him."
§The Ultimate Forgiveness Flex

One of the strict religious experts, a Pharisee named Simon, invited Jesus over for a fancy dinner. While they were eating, a woman who had a terrible, shady reputation in the city found out Jesus was there. She crashed the VIP party, bringing a jar of insanely expensive perfume.
She stood behind Jesus, crying so hard her tears were falling on his feet. She actually wiped his feet with her hair, kissed them, and poured the perfume on them.
Simon the Pharisee was disgusted. He thought, "If this guy was a real prophet, he'd know this woman is outcasts and he'd kick her out."
Jesus read his mind. "Simon, I have something to tell you."
"Tell me, Teacher."
"Two guys owed money to a banker. One owed five hundred bucks, the other owed fifty. Neither could pay, so the banker completely canceled both debts. Which guy will love the banker more?"
Simon said, "Obviously the one who had the massive debt canceled."

Jesus looked right at the woman but kept talking to Simon: "Exactly. Look at this woman. I came into your house, and you didn't even give me water for my dusty feet. She washed them with her tears. You didn't greet me with a kiss; she hasn't stopped kissing my feet. You didn't put oil on my head; she poured perfume on my feet.
Her massive, many sins have been completely forgiven—and that is why she has shown massive love. But a person who is only forgiven a little bit, only loves a little bit."
He looked at the woman and said, "Your sins are forgiven. Your faith has saved you. Go in peace."

Luke.title: The Financial Backers, the Dirt Story, and Waking the Dead
paragraphs: After this, Jesus started traveling from town to town, dropping the good news about God's kingdom. His twelve main guys were with him, but so were a group of women who had been healed of evil spirits and diseases.

One of them was Mary Magdalene (Jesus had kicked seven demons out of her), along with Joanna (whose husband was the manager of King Herod's household), Susanna, and a bunch of others. These women were actually bankrolling the entire road trip out of their own pockets.
§The Story of the Dirt
§A massive crowd gathered, and Jesus told them a story:
"A farmer went out to plant seeds.
As he tossed the seed, some fell on the hard walking path. People stepped on it, and the birds ate it instantly.
Some fell on rock. It sprouted, but the plants dried up because there was no moisture.
Some fell in the thorn bushes, and the thorns choked the plants to death.
But some fell on good, rich dirt. It grew and produced a massive crop—a hundred times more than what was planted!"
His disciples pulled him aside later. "What does that actually mean?"

Jesus broke it down: "The seed is God's word. The hard path is people who hear it, but the devil immediately snatches it out of their hearts so they can't be saved. The rock is people who get incredibly excited at first, but the second things get tough, they quit. The thorns are people who hear the word, but their faith gets completely choked out by the stress, money, and distractions of life. But the good dirt? That's the people with honest, good hearts who hold onto the word and patiently produce a massive harvest."
§Defeating the Hurricane
One day, Jesus and his squad got into a boat to cross the lake.
While they were sailing, Jesus took a nap. Suddenly, a sudden hurricane whipped down onto the lake. The boat was taking on water, and they were in serious danger of drowning.
The disciples stunned him awake, screaming, "Master! Master! We're going to die!"
Jesus woke up, totally calm, and yelled at the wind and the raging waves to stop. Instantly, the storm died, and the water was perfectly flat.
He looked at his crew. "Where is your faith?"
They were absolutely terrified and completely mind-blown. They whispered to each other, "Who is this guy?! He commands the actual weather, and it obeys him!"
§The Graveyard Zombie

They landed on the other side. The second Jesus stepped off the boat, a totally naked, insane guy who lived in the town graveyard ran up to him. This guy was possessed by demons and had been chained up by the locals multiple times, but he always snapped the chains with supernatural strength and ran out into the wild.
He fell at Jesus's feet and the demon inside him screamed, "What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God?! Don't torture me!"
Jesus asked, "What's your name?"
"Legion," he replied, because an entire army of demons had invaded him.

The demons begged Jesus not to throw them into the Abyss, but to let them go into a massive herd of pigs feeding on the hill. Jesus gave the order. The demons shot out of the man and into the pigs. The entire herd went totally insane and stampeded right off a steep cliff, plunging into the lake and drowning.

The pig farmers ran away and told the whole town. When the locals showed up, they saw the once-insane guy sitting right at Jesus's feet, fully dressed and completely normal. It completely freaked the locals out, and they begged Jesus to leave their territory. Jesus told the healed man, "Go home and tell everyone what God has done for you."
§The Double Miracle
When Jesus crossed back over the lake, a synagogue leader named Jairus fell at his feet, begging Jesus to come to his house because his twelve-year-old daughter was dying.

As Jesus was walking there, the massive crowd was crushing him. A woman who had been suffering from constant internal bleeding for twelve straight years (and had spent all her money on doctors with no cure) snuck up behind him. She barely touched the edge of his jacket, and instantly, her bleeding completely stopped.
Jesus stopped walking. "Who touched me?"
Peter laughed. "Boss, there are hundreds of people crushing you right now."
Jesus said, "No, someone deliberately touched me. I felt power go out from me."
The woman, trembling, fell at his feet and admitted it in front of everyone. Jesus smiled at her. "Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace."
Right at that moment, someone from Jairus's house ran up and said, "Your daughter is dead. Don't bother the Teacher anymore."
Jesus heard him and said to Jairus, "Don't be afraid. Just believe, and she will be healed."

When they got to the house, everyone was wailing and sobbing loudly. Jesus walked in and said, "Stop crying! She isn't dead; she's just asleep." They literally laughed in his face because they knew she was a corpse.
Jesus took her by the hand and called out, "My child, get up!" Her spirit immediately returned, and she stood right up. Her parents were completely out of their minds with shock.

Luke.title: The Road Trip, The Mountain Transformation, and The Hard Truth
paragraphs: Jesus called the Twelve together and gave them ultimate power and authority to kick out all demons and cure diseases. He sent them out on a massive road trip to preach God's kingdom and heal the sick.

His instructions were hardcore: "Take absolutely nothing for the journey. No walking stick, no backpack, no bread, no money, no extra shirt. Stay wherever people welcome you. If a town rejects you, shake the dust off your feet when you leave as a warning to them."
They went out, crushing it from village to village.
§Feeding the 5,000

When the apostles got back, Jesus tried to take them to a town called Bethsaida for a quiet retreat. But the crowds found out and tracked him down. He welcomed them, taught them, and healed the sick all day.
By late afternoon, the Twelve came to him: "Send the massive crowd away so they can go to the surrounding villages and buy food. We're in the middle of nowhere."
Jesus said, "You feed them."
They panicked. "We only have five loaves of bread and two fish! Do you want us to go buy groceries for all these people?" (There were about 5,000 men there, plus women and kids).
Jesus said, "Have them sit down in groups of fifty."

He took the five loaves and two fish, looked up to heaven, gave thanks, and broke them. He handed the food to the disciples to pass out. Miraculously, the food just kept multiplying. Everyone ate until they were totally stuffed, and the disciples even picked up twelve full baskets of leftovers!
§The Ultimate Question and the Cross
One day, when Jesus was praying alone with his crew, he asked them, "Who do the crowds say I am?"
They replied, "Some say John the Baptist, others say Elijah, or one of the ancient prophets come back to life."
"But what about you?" he asked. "Who do you say I am?"
Peter stepped up and nailed it: "You are God's Messiah."

Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone yet. Then he dropped a massive reality check: "The Son of Man is going to suffer horribly. The religious leaders are going to reject him and kill him. But on the third day, he will be raised back to life."
He looked at all of them and laid out the terms of following him:

"If any of you want to be my follower, you have to completely put yourself second. You have to pick up your cross every single day and follow my lead. If you spend your life desperately trying to save it, you'll lose it. But if you lose your life for me, you'll save it. What good is it if you gain the entire world, but you lose or destroy your own soul?"
The Mountain Transformation (The Transfiguration)

About eight days later, Jesus took Peter, John, and James hiking up a mountain to pray. As he was praying, the appearance of his face completely changed, and his clothes became blindingly bright, like a flash of lightning.
Suddenly, two dead legends—Moses and Elijah—showed up in glorious splendor and started talking with Jesus about his upcoming death in Jerusalem.

Peter and the guys had been sleeping, but they woke up and saw Jesus's massive glory. Peter, terrified and not knowing what to say, babbled, "Master, this is awesome! Let's build three shrines right here!"
While he was talking, a cloud covered them, and God's voice thundered out of the cloud: "This is my Son, whom I have chosen. Listen to him!" When the voice stopped, it was just Jesus alone.
§The Fail and the Real Flex

The next day, when they came down the mountain, a massive crowd met them. A man begged Jesus, "Look at my only son! An evil spirit keeps seizing him, throwing him into violent convulsions with foam at his mouth. I begged your disciples to kick it out, but they couldn't."
Jesus sighed. "You unbelieving, stubborn generation. How long do I have to put up with you? Bring your son here."

Even while the boy was walking over, the demon threw him to the ground in a violent seizure. Jesus rebuked the evil spirit, healed the boy instantly, and handed him back to his dad. Everyone was mind-blown by the sheer greatness of God.
While everyone was marveling at the miracles, the disciples actually started arguing among themselves about which one of them was the greatest.

Jesus knew what they were thinking. He grabbed a little kid, stood him by his side, and roasted their egos: "Whoever welcomes a little kid like this in my name, welcomes me. The guy who is the least among all of you—he is the one who is truly great."
§No Looking Back
As they hit the road for Jerusalem, a guy walked up and said, "I will follow you anywhere you go."
Jesus gave it to him straight: "Foxes have dens, and birds have nests, but the Son of Man doesn't even have a place to sleep."
He told another guy, "Follow me."
The guy said, "Lord, let me go bury my father first."
Jesus said, "Let the spiritually dead bury their own dead. Your job is to go preach the kingdom of God."
Another guy said, "I'll follow you, Lord, but let me go say goodbye to my family first."

Jesus replied with a farming metaphor: "Nobody who puts his hand to the plow and keeps looking back is fit for service in the kingdom of God." (Translation: If you want to follow me, you have to be all in. No distractions.)

Luke.title: The 72, The Good Samaritan, and The Stress Trap
paragraphs: Jesus decided his core team of 12 wasn't enough to reach everyone, so he drafted a massive secondary squad of 72 followers. He sent them out in pairs ahead of him to every town he planned to visit.

His pre-game speech was intense: "The harvest is massive, but the workers are few. I'm sending you out like lambs into a pack of wolves. Pack light—no money, no backpack, no extra shoes. Don't even stop to chat on the road. When you enter a town, heal the sick and tell them, 'The kingdom of God is right here.' If a town rejects you, wipe their dust off your feet and leave."
The 72 went out and came back absolutely hyped. "Lord, even the demons submit to us when we use your name!"

Jesus smiled. "I saw Satan fall like lightning from heaven. I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy. But don't flex about the demons obeying you. Flex about this: your names are written in heaven."
§The Ultimate Rivalry (The Good Samaritan)
A religious lawyer tried to trap Jesus with a technical question: "Teacher, what do I have to do to inherit eternal life?"
Jesus asked, "What does the Law say?"
The lawyer answered, "Love God with everything you have, and love your neighbor as yourself."
Jesus said, "Nailed it. Do that, and you'll live."
But the lawyer wanted to look smart and find a loophole, so he asked, "Okay, but who exactly is my neighbor?"
Jesus answered with one of the most famous stories of all time:
"A Jewish guy was hiking down the treacherous, winding road from Jerusalem to Jericho.
He got jumped by a gang of muggers. They stripped him, beat him half to death, and left him bleeding in the dirt.

A Jewish priest happened to be walking down the same road. He saw the dying guy, but crossed over to the other side and ignored him. Next, a Levite (a Temple assistant) walked by. He did the exact same thing—ignored him.

But then a Samaritan walked by." (Note: Jews and Samaritans hated each other. They were massive, bitter rivals.) "When the Samaritan saw the Jewish guy, his heart broke. He bandaged the guy's wounds, put him on his own donkey, took him to a hotel, and stayed up all night taking care of him. The next day, the Samaritan paid the hotel manager out of his own pocket and said, 'Take care of him. If it costs more, I'll pay you back when I return.'
Jesus looked at the lawyer. "Which of those three guys was an actual neighbor to the man who got mugged?"
The lawyer couldn't even bring himself to say the word 'Samaritan.' He just muttered, "The one who showed mercy."
Jesus said, "Go and do exactly what he did."
§Martha's Stress Trap
Jesus and his crew stopped at the house of two sisters, Martha and Mary.
Mary immediately sat down right at Jesus's feet to listen to him teach. Martha, on the other hand, was running around like crazy, stressing out about cooking a massive meal and cleaning the house.
Martha finally snapped, marched up to Jesus, and said, "Lord, don't you even care that my sister left me to do all the work by myself?! Tell her to get up and help me!"

Jesus gently roasted her: "Martha, Martha. You are stressing and panicking about a million different things. But only one thing actually matters right now. Mary chose the right thing, and I'm not taking it away from her."

Luke.title: The Prayer Guide and Roasting the Fakes
paragraphs: One day, after Jesus finished praying, his guys asked him, "Lord, teach us how to pray."
Jesus gave them a tight, simple, no-nonsense template (The Lord's Prayer):
"Father, show us who you are. Bring your kingdom here. Give us the food we need for today. Forgive our sins, because we forgive everyone who wrongs us. And keep us from giving in to temptation."

He told them a story to prove that God actually wants to answer them: "Imagine going to your buddy's house at midnight and pounding on the door saying, 'Listen, I need three loaves of bread, I have guests!' Your buddy yells, 'Go away, my kids are asleep!' But if you just keep knocking and being shamelessly annoying, he'll eventually get up and give you the bread just to make you stop.

So here is the rule: Keep asking, and you will receive. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and the door will open. If human dads know how to give good gifts to their kids, don't you think your Father in heaven will give the Holy Spirit to the people who ask?"
§The Finger of God

Jesus kicked a demon out of a guy who couldn't speak. Instantly, the guy started talking. But some haters in the crowd said, "He's only doing that because he's using the power of Beelzebul, the boss of the demons."

Jesus shut down their terrible logic: "If a kingdom is divided against itself, it collapses. Why would Satan fight his own guys? But if I am driving out demons by the actual finger of God, that means God's kingdom just crashed your party."
§The Dinner Party Roast
A Pharisee invited Jesus over for dinner. Jesus sat down without doing the super-strict, traditional ceremonial hand-washing routine first. The Pharisee was visibly shocked.
Jesus saw his reaction and absolutely went off on the religious leaders:
"You guys obsess over cleaning the outside of the cup, but your insides are completely stuffed with greed and wickedness! You fools! Didn't God make the inside too?"
"You make sure you tithe exactly 10% of your tiny garden herbs like mint and rue, but you completely ignore actual justice and the love of God!"

"You love getting the VIP seats at the synagogue and having people treat you like celebrities in the marketplace. You're like unmarked graves—people walk over you and get spiritually contaminated without even knowing it!"
One of the legal experts said, "Teacher, when you insult them, you're insulting us too."
Jesus didn't back down. "Woe to you legal experts too! You crush people with massive lists of impossible religious rules, but you won't lift one finger to help them carry the load!"
After that dinner, the religious leaders were furiously plotting how to catch him saying something illegal so they could destroy him.

Luke.title: Hypocrisy, Money, and Being Ready
paragraphs: A crowd of many thousands gathered—it was so packed people were literally trampling each other. Jesus turned to his guys and said, "Watch out for the 'yeast' of the Pharisees. I'm talking about their hypocrisy. Everything they are faking right now is going to be exposed. Whatever you whisper behind closed doors is going to be shouted from the rooftops."
He gave them a massive confidence boost:

"Don't be terrified of guys who can only kill your physical body and then can't do anything else. Fear God, who holds your actual eternal soul. Look at the sparrows—they are virtually useless, but God doesn't forget a single one of them. He even knows exactly how many hairs are on your head. You are worth vastly more than a whole flock of sparrows. Don't panic."
§The Rich Fool
A guy in the crowd yelled, "Teacher, tell my brother to split the family inheritance with me!"
Jesus declined to play judge, but he used it as a teaching moment: "Watch out! Guard yourselves against all types of greed. Your actual life is not measured by how much stuff you own."

He told a story: "A really rich farmer had a massive harvest. He had so much crop he didn't know where to put it. Instead of sharing it, he said, 'I'll tear down my old barns and build massive new ones! Then I can hoard all my grain and goods, retire early, drink, and party!'

But God said to him, 'You absolute fool! You are going to die this very night. Now who gets all the stuff you hoarded?' That's exactly how it goes for anyone who builds up massive wealth for themselves but is completely broke when it comes to God."
§Stop Stressing

Jesus looked at his disciples: "Stop worrying about your life, what you're going to eat, or what you're going to wear. Look at the ravens—they don't have barns or bank accounts, but God feeds them. Look at the wildflowers—they don't go shopping for clothes, but they look better than kings.

If God takes care of birds and grass, don't you think he'll take care of you? Stop stressing. Put God's kingdom first, and he'll handle the rest. Sell your extra stuff, give to the poor, and build a bank account in heaven that can never be stolen or destroyed. Wherever your treasure is, that's exactly where your heart will be."
§Be Ready for the Boss

Jesus warned them to stay spiritually sharp. "Be like servants waiting for their boss to get back from a late-night wedding. Keep your uniform on and the lights burning. If the boss comes back at 3:00 AM and finds them ready, he will actually put on an apron and serve them! But if the manager thinks, 'The boss is delayed,' and starts getting drunk and beating the other servants, the boss is going to return when he least expects it and fire him on the spot. To whom much is given, much is expected."

Luke.title: The Crooked Woman and the Narrow Door
paragraphs: Some people told Jesus a horrific news story about how the Roman governor Pilate had slaughtered some Galileans while they were worshipping.

Jesus asked, "Do you think those people were murdered because they were worse sinners than everyone else? Absolutely not. But I'm telling you, unless you change your life and turn back to God, you will all perish too."

He told a story about a guy who had a fig tree that hadn't produced fruit in three years. The guy told his gardener, "Chop it down, it's taking up space." The gardener pleaded, "Give me one more year to fertilize it. If it produces, great. If not, we chop it down." (Jesus's point: God is giving you a second chance. Don't waste it.)
§The Sabbath Showdown (Again)

Jesus was teaching in a synagogue on the Sabbath. A woman walked in who had been crippled by an evil spirit for 18 solid years. She was bent completely double and literally couldn't stand up straight.
Jesus called her over, put his hands on her, and said, "Woman, you are totally free from your sickness." Instantly, she snapped upright and started praising God.
The leader of the synagogue was absolutely furious that Jesus healed on the day of rest. He yelled at the crowd, "There are six days for working! Come get healed on those days, not on the Sabbath!"

Jesus absolutely roasted him in front of everyone: "You hypocrites! Every single one of you unties your ox or your donkey and leads it out to get water on the Sabbath. This woman is a daughter of Abraham, and Satan has kept her chained in a cage for 18 years! Shouldn't she be untied from her chains on the Sabbath?"
The haters were completely humiliated, and the massive crowd went wild, totally loving everything Jesus was doing.
§The Narrow Door
Someone asked Jesus, "Lord, are only a few people going to be saved?"

Jesus answered, "Make every single effort to squeeze through the narrow door. A lot of people are going to try to get in later, but they won't be able to. Once the owner locks the door, you can knock all you want, screaming, 'Lord, open up! We ate with you! You taught in our streets!' But he will say, 'I have no idea who you are. Get away from me, you evildoers.' It's not about being near me; it's about actually knowing me."

Luke.title: The Dinner Party Rules and the True Cost
paragraphs: Jesus went to eat dinner at the house of a prominent Pharisee leader on the Sabbath. They were watching his every move. A guy with severely swollen limbs (dropsy) was right in front of him. Jesus asked the experts, "Is it legal to heal on the Sabbath or not?" They completely refused to answer. Jesus took hold of the guy, healed him, and sent him home.
Then he noticed how all the VIP guests were fighting over the best, most honorable seats at the dinner table. He dropped some savage life advice:

"When you get invited to a massive wedding, don't sit in the VIP seat. If someone more important than you shows up, the host is going to make you get up and move to the back in front of everyone. It's humiliating. Instead, go sit in the absolute worst, lowest seat. Then the host will come and say, 'Friend, move up to a better seat!' You'll look like a boss in front of everyone. Because everyone who flexes will be humbled, and the one who humbles himself will be elevated."

He then told the host, "When you throw a party, don't just invite your rich friends, brothers, and rich neighbors, hoping they'll invite you back and repay you. Go out and invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, and the blind. They can't pay you back, but God will reward you at the resurrection."
§The Massive Excuses

Jesus told a story: "A guy threw a massive banquet and invited a ton of VIPs. But when the food was ready, every single VIP made a lame excuse. One said, 'I just bought a field, I can't come.' Another said, 'I just bought five pairs of oxen, I have to go test them.' Another said, 'I just got married, sorry.'

The host was furious. He told his servant, 'Go out into the streets and alleys right now! Bring in the poor, the crippled, the blind, and the lame.' The servant did, but there was still room. The host said, 'Go out to the country roads and the hedges, and make people come in! I want my house full. But none of those stuck-up guys who made excuses are getting a single taste of my banquet!'"
§The Cost of Following
Massive crowds were following Jesus because he was popular. He turned around and gave them a harsh reality check about what it actually takes to be on his team:

"If you come to me but you don't love me so much more than your own father, mother, wife, kids, brothers, and sisters—yes, even your own life—that it looks like hate in comparison, you cannot be my disciple. And whoever does not carry their cross and follow me cannot be my disciple.

"Think about it. If you're going to build a massive tower, you sit down first and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to finish it, right? Otherwise, you'll lay the foundation, run out of cash, and everyone will laugh at you.

You have to be willing to give up absolutely everything you have, or you cannot be my disciple. Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, it's useless garbage and gets thrown out. If you have ears, listen."

Luke.title: The Ultimate "Lost and Found" Trio
paragraphs: The corrupt tax collectors and the "sinners" (the outcasts and misfits) were all crowding around Jesus just to hear him speak. The Pharisees and religious teachers started muttering, "This guy welcomes outcasts and actually eats with them."
Jesus heard them and responded by dropping three of the most epic stories back-to-back-to-back to explain exactly how God views lost people.
1. The Lost Sheep

"Suppose one of you has 100 sheep, and one wanders off and gets lost. Doesn't he leave the 99 safe sheep in the open country and go track down the lost one until he finds it? And when he finds it, he joyfully puts it on his shoulders, carries it home, and calls all his friends: 'Throw a party! I found my lost sheep!'
I'm telling you, heaven throws a way bigger party over one sinner who changes their life than over 99 'perfect' people who don't think they need to change."
2. The Lost Coin
"Or suppose a woman has ten highly valuable silver coins and loses one.
Doesn't she light a lamp, sweep the entire house, and search like crazy until she finds it? And when she finds it, she calls her friends: 'Throw a party! I found my lost coin!'
I'm telling you, the angels of God throw a massive party when even one sinner repents."
3. The Prodigal Son (The Masterpiece)

"There was a wealthy man who had two sons. The younger son walked up to his dad and basically said, 'I wish you were dead. Give me my half of the inheritance right now.' The dad agreed and split his wealth.

The younger son packed up, moved to a distant country, and completely blew all the money on wild, reckless partying. When he was totally broke, a severe famine hit the country. He was starving. He got a humiliating job feeding pigs, and he was so hungry he actually wanted to eat the pig slop.

Finally, he came to his senses. He thought, 'Even my dad's lowest servants have plenty of food, and I'm out here starving to death. I'll go back and tell him: Dad, I have sinned against heaven and against you. I'm not worthy to be your son anymore. Just hire me as a servant.' So he started the long walk home.

But while the son was still a long way off, his dad saw him. The dad's heart was completely filled with compassion. He hiked up his robes and literally sprinted down the road, threw his arms around his filthy, pig-smelling son, and kissed him.
The son started his rehearsed speech: 'Dad, I've sinned... I'm not worthy...'

But the dad ignored the speech and started yelling to his servants: 'Hurry! Bring the best VIP robe in the house and put it on him! Put the family ring on his finger and sandals on his feet! Go butcher the fattened calf! We are throwing a massive BBQ! My son was dead, and now he is alive again! He was lost, and now he is found!' The party went absolutely crazy.
Meanwhile, the older brother was out working in the field. When he got close to the house and heard the music and dancing, he asked a servant what was going on.
'Your brother is back!' the servant said. 'Your dad killed the fattened calf because he's safe!'
The older brother was absolutely furious. He refused to go inside. His dad came out and begged him to come in.

But the older brother snapped at his dad: 'Look! I've been slaving away for you for years! I never disobeyed a single rule! But you never even gave me a young goat so I could party with my friends. But when this son of yours comes home after blowing your money on prostitutes, you throw him a massive feast?!'

The dad looked at him gently. 'My son, you are always with me, and everything I own is already yours. But we had to celebrate and be glad. Because this brother of yours was dead, and now he is alive. He was completely lost, and now he is found.'"

Luke.title: The Clever Scammer and the Massive Chasm
paragraphs: Jesus told his disciples a story about a rich boss who had a shady financial manager. The boss caught the manager wasting his money and fired him: "Turn in your account books. You're done."

The manager panicked. "I'm too weak to do manual labor, and I'm too proud to beg. What am I going to do?" He came up with a genius, totally corrupt plan. He called in all the people who owed his boss money. To the guy who owed 800 gallons of olive oil, the manager said, "Quick, cross that out and write 400." To the guy who owed 1,000 bushels of wheat, he said, "Make it 800." He did this so that when he got kicked out, these guys would owe him a massive favor and let him crash at their houses.
When the rich boss found out, he actually praised the dishonest manager for being so shrewd.

Jesus explained the point: "The people of this world are often way smarter about handling their business than the people of the light. Use your worldly wealth right now to help others and build relationships, so that when your money is completely gone, you'll be welcomed into eternal homes. If you can't be trusted with a little bit of money, nobody is going to trust you with true spiritual wealth. You cannot serve both God and Money."

The Pharisees, who absolutely loved money, heard this and sneered at Jesus. He looked right at them: "You guys love looking good in front of everyone, but God knows your actual hearts. What the world thinks is highly valuable is actually total garbage in God's eyes."
§The Rich Man and Lazarus

Jesus dropped another intense story: "There was an insanely rich man who wore the most expensive purple clothes and partied every single day. Right outside his front gate laid a beggar named Lazarus, covered in sores. Lazarus was so hungry he just wanted the crumbs that fell off the rich guy's table. Even the street dogs would come and lick his sores.
Eventually, both men died.

The angels carried Lazarus right to Abraham's side in heaven. The rich man went to Hades (hell), where he was in absolute agony. He looked up, saw Abraham far away with Lazarus, and screamed, 'Father Abraham! Have pity on me! Send Lazarus to dip just the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! I am burning in this fire!'

But Abraham said, 'Son, remember that in your lifetime you had all the good things, and Lazarus had all the bad. Now he is comforted, and you are in agony. Besides, there is a massive, uncrossable chasm fixed between us. Nobody can cross over from here to there, or there to here.'
The rich man begged, 'Then please send him to warn my five brothers so they don't end up in this place of torment!'
Abraham replied, 'They have the Scriptures of Moses and the Prophets. Let them listen to that.'
'No!' the rich man said. 'If someone comes back from the dead, then they'll change their lives!'
Abraham gave the ultimate mic-drop: 'If they won't listen to the Scriptures, they won't be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.'"

Luke.title: Ten Lepers and the Lightning Flash
paragraphs: Jesus warned his crew about causing other people to stumble: "Temptations to sin are definitely going to happen. But things will go horribly for the person who causes them! It would be better for you to have a massive millstone tied around your neck and be thrown into the ocean than to cause one of these little ones to trip up. Watch yourselves!"

He also gave them a strict rule on forgiveness: "If your brother wrongs you, call him out. If he repents, forgive him. Even if he wrongs you seven times in one day, and comes back seven times saying, 'I repent,' you absolutely must forgive him."
The apostles were overwhelmed. "Lord, increase our faith!"

Jesus replied, "If you have faith even the size of a tiny mustard seed, you could tell this massive mulberry tree, 'Rip yourself up by the roots and plant yourself in the ocean,' and it would obey you."
§The One Who Came Back

While hiking along the border of Samaria and Galilee, ten men covered in severe leprosy saw Jesus. Because they were contagious outcasts, they stood far away and screamed, "Jesus, Master, have pity on us!"
Jesus yelled back, "Go show yourselves to the priests!" (The priests were the only ones who could declare a leper officially clean).
As the ten men turned and walked away, they were instantly completely healed.

But only one of the ten guys stopped, turned around, and ran back, praising God at the top of his lungs. He threw himself face-down at Jesus's feet and thanked him. And this guy was a Samaritan (a hated foreigner).
