You used to be in the dark, but now you're in the light. Jesus is lighting up your path, so no more tripping. It's time for a miraculous transformation. Do what's good and right and true—that's how you live in the light. Figure out what makes Jesus happy, and then go do it.

Don't waste your time on pointless stuff. Expose the fakes for who they are. It's lame when people do shady things in the dark. So wake up, get out of your funk, and let Jesus shine a light on you. Pay attention to how you're living. These are crazy times, so make every moment count. Don't just drift through life; figure out what the Boss wants.

And don't get ruined on wine—that's just a cheap thrill. Instead, get filled up with God's Spirit. Sing awesome songs to Jesus from your heart, not just drinking songs. Always be ready to thank God the Father for everything, in the name of our Master, Jesus Christ.
Out of respect for Jesus, be cool and respectful to each other.

Wives, support your husbands like you support Jesus. The husband is the leader, not in a bossy way, but in a loving, protective way, just like Jesus is with the church. So, just like the church follows Jesus' lead, wives should do the same with their husbands.

Husbands, you gotta go all out for your wives, just like Jesus did for the church. He gave everything for her to make her amazing and beautiful. That's how you should love your wife. It's like you're doing yourself a favor since you're a team now.

Nobody hates their own body, right? You feed it and take care of it. That's how Jesus treats us, the church, because we're part of Him. That's why a guy leaves his parents and sticks with his wife, and they become one. It's a huge mystery, and I don't get all of it. But what's clear is how Jesus treats the church. And that's the blueprint for how every husband should love his wife, and how every wife should respect her husband.

Ephesians.title: The Ultimate Boss Battle
paragraphs: §The Armor of God

Alright, listen up. Your parents? You gotta listen to them. It's the right thing to do. There's even a cheat code in the Bible for it: 'Respect your mom and dad.' It's the first rule that comes with a bonus level: a long and awesome life. Total transformation.
Dads, don't be that guy who sets up impossible levels for your kids. Don't make them rage-quit. Instead, be their guide, show them how to follow the real VIP, Jesus.

If you've got a boss, don't just do the bare minimum. Yeah, you gotta respect them, but remember who you're *really* working for: the big boss, Christ. So, go all in, give it 100%, like you're on a mission from God. And do it with a good attitude, because you're not just working for some random guy, you're working for God. And trust me, He pays way better. Doesn't matter if you're the CEO or the intern, good work gets you a fat bonus from the Master.

And for you bosses out there, the same rules apply. Don't be a tyrant. No throwing your weight around or making threats. You and your team are on the same level in God's eyes. He's the ultimate boss, and He doesn't play favorites.

So, here's the deal. God is super powerful, and he wants you to be too. He's got a whole arsenal of epic gear for you, so suit up. You're gonna need it to stand up to the Devil's cheap shots. This isn't some quick game you can just walk away from. This is a full-on war for your life against the Devil and his whole crew of enforcers of fallen angels.

So be ready. You're facing something way bigger than you can handle on your own. Grab every piece of armor God gives you, so when the dust settles, you're the one left standing. We're talking about Truth, Righteousness, Peace, Faith, and Salvation. These aren't just words; they're your weapons. Learn how to use them, because you'll need them every day. And God's Word? That's your ultimate weapon. And don't forget to pray. Pray hard and long. Pray for your friends. Keep each other hyped up so no one gets left behind.

And hey, pray for me too. Pray that I'll have the guts to say what I need to say, when I need to say it, and here's the thing message out to everyone. Even though I'm basically in jail for being a preacher, I've still got a job to do.
My boy Tychicus is coming to see you. He's a solid guy and a real pro at serving the Master. He'll give you the full scoop on how I'm doing and get you all fired up in your faith.
Peace out, my friends. May God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ give you love and faith. Grace and nothing but grace to everyone who loves our Master, Jesus Christ.

Philippians.title: Paul’s Letter From Lock-Up
paragraphs: §Joy in Chains

What's up, Philippi crew! It's Paul and Tim, just a couple of guys on Jesus's squad, hitting you up. This is for all the Jesus followers in town, including the head honchos and the whole team. We're sending you major positive energy and peace from God the Father and our main man, Jesus.

Every time I even *think* about you guys, I'm like, 'Thank you, God!' Seriously, every single time, it makes me want to pray for you, and I'm not even mad about it. I'm so stoked that you've been all-in with us, spreading the good news about Jesus since day one. I'm 100% sure that God, who started this awesome thing in you, is gonna see it through and give you a miraculous transformation on the day Jesus comes back.

And for real, I'm not just gassing you up. You guys are my ride-or-dies. You stuck with me when I was in jail, when I was on trial, and when I got out. You've been there for the whole crazy ride, and God's been super generous to us through it all. He knows I miss you guys like crazy. Sometimes I feel like I'm on the same wavelength as Jesus about you.

So, here's what I'm praying for you: that your love for each other just keeps leveling up. And not just that you love a lot, but that you love *smart*. You gotta use your brain and check your feelings so your love is the real deal, not just some mushy, fake stuff. Live like you're in love, a life that makes Jesus proud. A life that's producing all kinds of good stuff, making Jesus look good to everyone and getting them all in on praising God.

Hey, so I gotta tell you, being in jail has had the total opposite effect of what my haters wanted. Instead of shutting me down, the message about Jesus has blown up! All the guards here, and pretty much everyone else, found out I'm locked up because of Jesus. That made them curious, and now they're learning all about him. And get this: most of the other Jesus followers here are way more confident than ever, and they're not afraid to talk about God and Jesus.

Now, it's true that some people are preaching about Jesus just because they see me out of the way and they want the spotlight. But others are doing it for the right reasons. One group is all about love; they know I'm here defending the message and they want to help. The other group is just being greedy, trying to get something for themselves now that I'm not around. Their motives are wrong. They see me as competition, so they think the worse it is for me, the better it is for them.

So what do I do? I've decided I don't really care what their motives are. Whether they're good, bad, or whatever, every time they open their mouths, they're talking about Jesus, so I'm just gonna cheer them on!

And I'm gonna keep on cheering, because I know how this is all gonna end. With your prayers and the help of Jesus's Spirit, everything he wants to do in me and through me is gonna get done. I can't wait to see what's next. I'm not worried about being embarrassed at all. In fact, everything that's happening to me in here is just making Jesus more famous, whether I live or die. They didn't shut me up; they gave me a bigger stage! If I'm alive, I'm Jesus's messenger; if I'm dead, I'm his prize. It's a win-win. I can't lose.

As long as I'm alive, I've got good work to do. If I had to choose right now, I don't know what I'd pick. It's a tough call! The thought of leaving this life and being with Jesus is awesome. Some days, that's all I want. But most days, because of what you guys are going through, I know it's better for me to stick around. So, I'm planning on being here for a while, to help you grow and be joyful in your faith. You can look forward to a big reunion when I come visit you again. We'll be praising Jesus and having a great time together.

In the meantime, live in a way that makes the message of Jesus look good. Don't let your actions depend on whether I'm there or not. You've got to be the same whether I'm there to see it myself or I hear about it from far away. Stand together, have one goal, and fight for people to trust in the good news. Don't back down or get scared by the opposition. Your courage and unity will show them that they're going to lose and you're going to win—and it's all because of God. There's more to this life than just trusting in Jesus. There's also suffering for him. And the suffering is just as much a gift as the trust. You're in the same fight you saw me go through, and you're getting an update on it in this letter.

Philippians.title: How to Be a Real MVP
paragraphs: §The Christ Hymn

So, if you've gotten anything good out of following Jesus, if His love has actually changed you, if being part of our squad means anything, and if you guys have any heart at all—do me a solid. Get on the same page, love each other, and be true ride-or-die friends. Don't be that person who's always trying to be the main character. Don't try to sweet-talk your way into the VIP section. Instead, be humble and hype up your friends. Don't just look out for number one. Forget about yourself for a minute and help someone else out.

Your attitude should be the same as Jesus'. He was literally on the same level as God, but He didn't flex His power. He didn't cling to His top-tier status. Nah, when the time was right, He gave up all His perks, and basically became a servant. He became human! And He stayed human, which was a total glow-down for Him. He didn't ask for special treatment. He just lived a humble, obedient life and then died a humble, obedient death—the worst kind of death, too: crucifixion.
§Shine Like Stars

Because He was so obedient, God gave Him the ultimate transformation and honored Him more than anyone or anything, ever. So now, everyone in heaven, on earth, and even the ghosts of people long gone, will bow down and worship Jesus. They'll all shout out that He's the boss, bringing major props to God the Father.

So, my friends, here's the deal. Just keep doing what you've been doing. When I was with you, you were all about listening and obeying. Now that I'm gone, you gotta step it up even more. Go hard in your faith, and be respectful and aware of God. That power you feel? That's God's power inside you, helping you do what makes Him happy.

Do everything without complaining or second-guessing. Go out there and be a breath of fresh air in this messed-up world. Show people what it's like to live a good life and know the living God. Be the light in the darkness, so when Jesus comes back, I can be proud of you. You'll be the proof that all my hard work wasn't for nothing.
And even if I get taken out right here, right now, I'll be happy to be part of the sacrifice of your faith. But hey, you gotta be happy for me too. Whatever you do, don't feel bad for me.

I'm planning to send Timothy to you guys soon, so he can give me the scoop on how you're all doing. That would be awesome. There's no one else like Timothy. He's a real one, and he actually cares about you. Most people are just in it for themselves and don't really care about Jesus' mission. But you know Timothy is legit. He's been like a son to me, and we've been spreading the message together. As soon as I know what's up with my situation here, I'll send him your way. And I'm hoping I'll be right behind him.

But for now, I'm sending Epaphroditus back to you. He's my boy, my partner in crime. You sent him to help me, and now I'm sending him to help you. He's been dying to see you all, especially since you heard he was sick. He wanted to let you know he's all good now. He almost died, for real, but God showed him mercy. And not just him, but me too. If he had died, it would have been another huge L for me.

So you see why I'm so stoked to send him back. When you see him all healthy and strong, you'll be so happy, and I'll be relieved. Give him a huge welcome and a big hug. People like him deserve all the respect. Remember how you guys started helping me but couldn't finish? Well, he finished the job, and he almost died doing it. What a legend.

Philippians.title: All-In for the Win
paragraphs: §Knowing Christ Is Everything

Alright, guys, let's wrap this up. The main thing is to be stoked about God! I know I sound like a broken record, but it's super important, so I'm gonna say it again: watch out for the haters. I'm talking about those super-religious show-offs who are all talk. They're obsessed with outward stuff, like old-school rituals, but they're missing the point. We're the real deal because we're powered by God's Spirit, and we're all about hyping up Christ. We know we can't do this on our own, even though my resume is pretty stacked. Seriously, I was born into the right family, part of the VIP tribe of Benjamin, a rule-following expert, and I was so hardcore I even went after the church. I was basically a straight-A student in the rulebook.

But all that stuff I used to flex about? It's garbage. I've tossed it all out. Why? Because knowing Jesus is the ultimate prize. Everything else is just trash compared to the epic privilege of knowing him personally. I've dumped my old achievements so I can fully grab onto Christ and have him grab onto me. I don't want some weak, rule-based 'goodness.' I want the real, powerful kind that comes from trusting Christ—the kind that's straight from God.

I ditched all that lame stuff so I could really know Christ, feel his resurrection power, and even be part of his crew through the tough times, right up to the end. If there's a way to be in on the ultimate comeback—the resurrection—I'm all in.

Look, I'm not saying I'm perfect or that I've got it all figured out. But I'm on the journey, chasing after Christ, who amazingly chased after me first. Don't get it twisted, I'm no expert. But I'm laser-focused on the finish line, where God is calling us to be with Jesus. I'm running my race, and I'm not looking back.
So, for those of us who are serious about this, let's stay locked in on that goal. If you're getting sidetracked, God will get you back on track. We're on the right path, so let's keep moving.

Stick with me on this, and watch the people who are running the same race. There are a lot of people out there on different paths, chasing other things, and they'll try to get you to follow them. I've warned you about them before, and I'm saying it again: they're all about taking the easy way out. They can't stand the cross. But that easy street is a dead end. They're all about their own desires, and their life is just about feeding their own appetites.

But our story is way different. We're citizens of heaven! We're waiting for our Savior, the boss, Jesus Christ. He's going to give our regular bodies a miraculous transformation, making them awesome like his. He's got the power to put everything in its right place, and he's gonna make us whole.

Philippians.title: The No-Stress Guide to Life
paragraphs: §Rejoice Always

Alright, listen up, my crew. You guys are the best, seriously. I'm so proud of you, so just keep doing what you're doing and stay solid with God. And hey, Euodia and Syntyche, you two need to squash your beef and make up. It's not a good look. My man Syzygus, I need you to be the ref and help them sort it out. These ladies were total rockstars for the cause, right there with me and the rest of the OG squad. They're VIPs in God's book, so they need to act like it.

Keep the positive energy going with God 24/7. Seriously, get hyped about him! And be cool with everyone you meet; let them know you're on their team. The Boss could show up any second, so be ready! Don't stress or worry about anything. Instead of panicking, just pray. Turn your worries into a conversation with God, and let him know what's up. Before you know it, you'll feel this awesome sense of peace, like everything's gonna be alright. It's a total game-changer when you let God's peace take over instead of letting worry run your life.
§Think About These Things

To wrap it up, my friends, you've gotta guard your thoughts. Focus on stuff that's real, honorable, right, pure, and awesome. Think about the best things, not the worst; the transformations, not the fails. Basically, whatever is worth praising, lock your mind on that. Just copy what you learned from me—the stuff you heard me say and saw me do. If you do that, the God who lines everything up perfectly will bring some of that perfect harmony into your life.

I was so stoked to see you guys showing you care about me again. Not that you ever stopped, you just didn't have a chance to show it. But for real, it's not like I *needed* anything. I've learned the secret to being happy no matter what's going on. I'm good with a little and I'm good with a lot. I can handle being totally full or starving, having tons of cash or being broke. I can power through literally anything because of the One who gives me strength. But don't get me wrong, your help was a huge deal. It was awesome that you had my back when I was in a tight spot.

You guys in Philippi know the deal. When I first hit the road with the Message, you were the only church that had my back, the only ones who supported me. You even sent help more than once when I was in Thessalonica. I'm not saying this because I'm looking for a handout. I just want you to get the rewards that come from being generous.

And now, I'm totally set. The stuff you sent with Epaphroditus was more than enough. It was like the best-smelling BBQ on the grill for God—he loved it. And you can bet that same God will take care of everything you need. His generosity is way bigger than yours, and it all comes through Jesus. Our God and Father gets all the glory forever and ever. Amen.
Say hi to all of God's people for me. My friends here say what's up. All the Christians here, especially the crew who work in Caesar's palace—the government headquarters—send their greetings.
May the incredible grace of our leader, Jesus Christ, be with you all, deep down in your spirit.

Colossians.title: Jesus is the GOAT
paragraphs: §The Supremacy of Christ

Hey, what up? It's Paul, on a special mission from Jesus, part of God's epic master plan. Me and my bro Timothy are sending a shout-out to all the true believers in Colosse. Hope you're getting all the good stuff from God our Father.

We're always hitting up God, our Father, and Jesus, the Messiah, to say thanks for you guys. Seriously, we can't stop. We keep hearing about your solid faith in Jesus and how you're always showing love to all the other Christians. You guys are totally focused on your future in heaven, and that hope keeps you going strong.

The message you heard is the real deal, just as legit as the first day you heard it. It's not some trend that fades away; it's blowing up all over the world, getting bigger and stronger, just like it is with you. From the moment you heard and got what God is doing, you've been all in. And it's still going strong, just like our boy Epaphras taught you. He's a super-reliable worker for Christ, a real one. He's the one who told us how the Spirit has made love a huge part of your lives.

So for real, since we first heard about you, we haven't stopped praying for you. We're asking God to give you the smarts and the right vibe to totally get his plan. We're praying you'll live in a way that makes the Boss proud, that you'll crush it in his work. The more you learn how God operates, the better you'll get at your own stuff. We're praying you'll have the strength to hang in there when things get tough—not just gritting your teeth, but that awesome power-up God gives. It's the kind of strength that helps you handle anything and still be stoked, thanking the Father who made us worthy to be part of his awesome, bright future.

God totally saved us. He pulled us out of some dead-end situations and dark places. He put us in the kingdom of his Son, who he loves like crazy. This is the Son who rescued us from the mess we were in and wiped our slate clean from all the misfits we were stuck repeating.

When we look at this Son, we're basically seeing the invisible God. We see God's original blueprint for everything. Because everything, and I mean *everything*—in the sky, on the ground, stuff you can see and stuff you can't, even all the different levels of angels—it all started with him and is all about him. He was there before anything else existed, and he's the one holding it all together, even right now. And when it comes to the church, he's the one who organizes it and keeps it together, like a head on a body.

He was the top dog from the very beginning, and he's the VIP in the end, leading the resurrection parade. From start to finish, he's the main event, way above everyone and everything. He's so huge that all of God fits perfectly in him with room to spare. And here's the thing: all the broken, messed-up parts of the universe—people, things, you name it—get fixed and put back together in perfect harmony because of his death, because of the blood he shed on the cross.

You guys are a perfect example of what he does. You used to have your backs to God, thinking rebellious stuff about him and causing trouble all the time. But now, because Christ went all in for you on the cross and literally died for you, he brought you back to God's side. He put your lives back together, making you whole and holy in his eyes. You don't just walk away from a gift like that! You stay grounded and solid in that trust, always tuned in to the message, and don't get sidetracked. There's no other message but this one. Every single person on earth gets this same message. And me, Paul? I'm one of the messengers.

I want you to know I'm actually glad I'm the one in jail right now and not you. There's a lot of suffering in the world that needs to be dealt with, the kind of stuff Christ takes on. I'm happy to take my share of that for the church. When I became a servant of the church, I saw this suffering as a gift, God's way of helping me serve you and lay out the whole truth.

This big secret has been under wraps for a long time, but now it's out in the open. God wanted everyone, not just the Jews, to know this amazing and glorious secret, no matter who they are or what their background is. The secret is basically this: Christ is in you, so you can be sure you'll share in God's glory. It's that simple. That's what our message is all about. We preach Christ, and we warn people not to add a bunch of extra stuff to it. We teach with a lot of common sense so we can help everyone grow up and be mature. And being mature is just about one thing: Christ. Nothing more, nothing less. That's what I'm working my butt off for every single day, using the awesome energy God gives me.

Colossians.title: Don't Get Played
paragraphs: §Alive in Christ

Hey, I gotta tell you, I'm going hard in the paint for you guys and the crew over in Laodicea. A lot of you have never even seen my face, but it doesn't matter. I'm in your corner, for real. You're not flying solo in this.

I want you all to be tight, like a solid team, and to really get what God is doing. I want you to have your minds blown by the awesome mystery of Christ. All the best stuff—wisdom, knowledge, all of it—is packed into him. And he’s not hiding it; he’s showing it to us! I’m telling you this so you don’t get faked out by people trying to sell you some other “secret” or “mystery.”
Yeah, I’m far away, and you might never meet me in person, but believe me, I’m right there with you. I’m stoked to hear that you’re living right and that your faith in Christ is rock solid.

So here’s the deal: you’ve got Christ Jesus, the Master. Now live like it. You’re rooted in him, built on him. You know the playbook, so get out there and play! And be stoked about it, overflowing with thanks.

Watch out for people who try to impress you with big words and philosophical nonsense. They’re just trying to drag you into pointless arguments. They’re peddling man-made traditions and superstitions about spirits and stuff. That’s not how Christ rolls. Everything about God is in him, plain and simple. You don’t need a telescope or a horoscope to see how awesome Christ is and how empty everything else is without him. When you’re with him, you’re complete. He’s the head honcho over everything and everyone.

And you don’t get in on this by following a bunch of rules or getting circumcised. Nah, you’re already in. You got in through what Christ did for you when he wrecked the power of sin. Your baptism was like a funeral for your old life and a resurrection to a new one. God raised you from the dead, just like he did with Christ. When you were dead in your sins, you couldn’t do anything for God. But God made you alive with Christ! Think about it! All your sins are gone, the slate is clean. That old arrest warrant against you was canceled and nailed to the cross. He totally owned all the spiritual bullies in the universe at the cross and paraded them around like fools.
So don’t let anyone give you a hard time about what you eat or drink, or about religious festivals or holidays. That stuff is just a shadow of the real thing, and the real thing is Christ.

Don’t put up with people who try to control you, telling you to bow down to angels and have visions. They’re just full of hot air. They’re not connected to the source of life, who is Christ. He’s the one who holds us all together. He’s the head, and we’re the body. We can only grow up healthy in God if we’re getting our life from him.

So if you’ve left all that fake, childish religion behind with Christ, why do you let people push you around with rules like, “Don’t touch this! Don’t taste that! Don’t go near this!”? Do you really think that stuff that’s here today and gone tomorrow is that important? It might sound deep and spiritual, but it’s just another way of showing off and making yourself look good.

Colossians.title: Level Up Your Life
paragraphs: §Rules for Holy Living

Hey, so if you're for real about this new life with Christ, you gotta act like it. Start chasing the stuff that matters, the stuff Christ is in charge of. Don't just stare at your feet, obsessed with what's right in front of you. Look up! See what's happening with Christ, 'cause that's where the real action is. Get on his level.

Your old self? Dead and gone. Your new life, your *real* life, is with Christ in God's crew, even if nobody else sees it. He's your whole life. And when Christ, your real life, shows up again on Earth, you're gonna show up too—the real you, the awesome you. Until then, just chill and be cool with not being the center of attention, just like Christ was.
§Relationships

So, you gotta drop everything connected to that old, dead life. All that horrible stuff: being unfaithful, being impure, always wanting more, doing whatever you want whenever you want, and just grabbing whatever looks good. That's a life run by things and feelings, not by God. And that's the kind of stuff that makes God want to just blow up in anger. You used to be all about that stuff, but you didn't know any better. Now you do, so get rid of it for good: getting mad all the time, being cranky, being mean, cussing, and talking trash.

And don't lie to each other. You're done with that. It's like taking off a set of filthy, old clothes that don't even fit and throwing them in a fire. Now you've got a whole new wardrobe, a total transformation. Every piece is custom-made by God, with his name on it. All the old trends are out. Words like 'Jew' or 'non-Jew,' 'religious' or 'not religious,' 'insider' or 'outsider,' 'savage' or 'lame,' 'slave' or 'free'—they don't mean anything anymore. Now, everyone's all about Christ. Everyone's in the crew.

So, since you're God's chosen VIPs for this new life of love, you gotta dress the part. God picked out this outfit for you: be compassionate, be kind, be humble, be strong but quiet, and have self-control. Be chill, be cool with not being first, and be quick to forgive when someone messes up. Forgive them as fast and as completely as the Boss forgave you. And no matter what else you wear, always wear love. It's your go-to, everyday gear. Never leave home without it.

Let the peace of Christ keep you all on the same page, working together. No more going off and doing your own thing. And be thankful. Let the Word of Christ, the Message, just take over your whole house. Give it tons of space in your lives. Teach and help each other out with good advice. And sing! Sing your hearts out to God! Everything you do, every single detail—what you say, what you do, whatever—do it all for the Boss, for Jesus. And thank God the Father every step of the way.
Wives, you gotta support your husbands and submit to them in a way that honors the Boss.
Husbands, love your wives like crazy. Don't take advantage of them.
Kids, listen to your parents. The Boss loves to see that.
Parents, don't be too hard on your kids, or you'll break their spirits.

And for all you workers out there, do what your bosses tell you. Don't just do the bare minimum to get by. Do your best. Work hard for your real Boss, for God. You can be sure you'll get paid in full when you get your inheritance. Always remember, the ultimate Boss you're serving is Christ. The lazy worker who does a bad job will be held responsible. Being a follower of Jesus isn't an excuse for bad work.

Colossians.title: The Final Shout-Outs
paragraphs: §Final Instructions
Alright, so if you're a boss, don't be harsh to your employees. Be cool and treat them right. Remember, you've got a boss too - the big guy upstairs, God.
§**Prayer Requests & Spreading the Word**

Always be praying. Like, for real. Stay sharp, and be thankful for everything. And hey, while you're at it, pray for us. Pray that God opens up opportunities for us to talk about the big secret of Jesus, even though I'm stuck in jail. Pray that I can explain it all super clearly to everyone.
Be smart about how you act around people who don't know Jesus. Don't be weird. Make every moment count. When you talk, be cool and build people up, don't roast them or cancel them.

My boy Tychicus is coming to you, and he'll give you the full scoop on me. He's a solid guy and a great helper in God's work. I'm sending him so you know what's up with us and so he can get you hyped about your faith. I'm also sending Onesimus with him. He's one of your own, and he's become a super trustworthy and awesome bro. They'll tell you everything that's been going down here.

Aristarchus, my cellmate, says 'sup. So does Mark, Barnabas's cousin. You got a letter about him, so if he rolls through, give him a warm welcome. Jesus, the one they call Justus, also sends a shout-out. These are the only guys from the old crew who are still with me, working for God's kingdom. They've been a huge help, for real.

Epaphras, who's from your town, says hi. That guy is a beast! He's always praying hard for you guys, that you'll level up and be super confident in what God wants for you. I've seen him grind for you and the people in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
Luke, the awesome doctor, and Demas both say what's up.
Tell our friends in Laodicea we said hi. Same to Nympha and the church that meets at her place.
After you read this letter, make sure the church in Laodicea reads it too. And you guys need to read the letter I sent to them.
Oh, and tell Archippus to get on it and crush the job the Boss gave him. Like, totally own it.
I'm signing this myself - Paul. Don't forget to pray for me while I'm in here. Grace out.

1 Thessalonians.title: The Real Influencers
paragraphs: §Thankful for You

What's up to the squad at Thessalonica! It's me, Paul, along with my boys Silas and Timothy. We're sending this to all of you who are part of the crew of God the Father and our main man, Jesus Christ. Hope you're feeling the positive energy and peace from God.

Seriously, we're always gassing you up to God. We can't stop telling him how awesome you guys are. We're constantly remembering how you're crushing it with your faith, showing major love to everyone, and patiently waiting for our leader, Jesus, to come back. We know for a fact that God doesn't just like you; He's totally chosen you for His team. When we shared the good news with you, it wasn't just a bunch of talk. The Holy Spirit showed up and made you guys totally sure about it, giving you a miraculous transformation in your beliefs.

You guys saw how we rolled when we were with you, and you decided to be just like us. And by copying us, you were really copying the ultimate boss, Jesus. Even though you got a lot of hate for believing, you were still super stoked because of the Holy Spirit. You took the bad with the good, and the good with the bad, and that's what's up.

Because of you, everyone in Macedonia and Achaia is hearing about Jesus. You guys are the real influencers. Your faith is making so much noise that we don't even have to say anything. People are telling us how you welcomed us and ditched your old fake gods to serve the one true God. They're blown away by how you're all waiting for His Son, Jesus, to show up—the one who saved us from the ultimate punishment.

1 Thessalonians.title: We're Legit, Not Fakes
paragraphs: §Paul's Ministry

Hey, what's up, guys? So, you know our visit wasn't a total bust. We got roughed up pretty bad back in Philippi, you remember that, but we didn't let it stop us. We had God's back, so we showed up and dropped his message on you, no matter who was hating on us.

God put us through the wringer to make sure we were the real deal, that he could trust us with his message. So for real, when we talk to you, we're not trying to get likes or follows—we're all about that God approval. We passed his vibe check, so you know we're not feeding you lies or have some secret plan. We never tried to sweet-talk you; you guys know that. And God knows we weren't just trying to scam you.

We could have flexed on you because we're apostles of Christ, but we never acted like we were big shots. We weren't all distant and weird with you. We just hung out with you like you were one of us. We weren't talking down to you; we cared about you like a mom cares for her kids. We seriously loved you guys. We didn't just want to give you the message; we wanted to give you a piece of our hearts. And we totally did.

You guys remember how we were, right? We worked like crazy, staying up all night, so we wouldn't be a burden to you while we were telling you about God. You saw for yourselves that we were cool and respectful, and we were super real with you because you're our fellow believers. And God knows we weren't just mooching off you! You saw it all. We were like a dad to each of you, giving you fist bumps, hyping you up, and showing you how to live a lit life for God, who invited us into his kingdom, into this awesome life.

And now, looking back, we're just so thankful to God. Like, a huge thank you! When you heard God's message from us, you didn't just blow it off like it was some random dude's opinion. You took it seriously as God's actual word, which it is, and now God is doing his thing in you guys!

You know, you're basically twinning with the churches of God in Judea, the OG followers of Jesus. You got the same hate from your own people that they got from theirs. The same people who killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets and then kicked us out of town. They're on God's bad side and everyone else's, because they're trying to stop us from telling people how to be saved. They've basically made a career out of being haters, and they're pros at it. But God's had enough. He's about to shut it down.

Man, you have no idea how much we miss you guys. It hasn't even been that long, and we're not *really* separated because you're in our hearts, but we've been trying so hard to come see you. I, Paul, have tried a bunch of times, but Satan kept blocking me. But when our Lord Jesus comes back, who do you think we're going to be bragging about? It's you! You guys are our ultimate trophy!

1 Thessalonians.title: We Miss You Guys, For Real
paragraphs: §Living to Please God

Hey, so we just couldn't take being away from you any longer. We were stuck in Athens and totally bummed we couldn't come see you. So, we sent our boy Timothy to check in, give you a boost, and make sure you weren't letting all the drama get you down. He's a solid guy, a real one in the faith, and he's all about spreading the good news about Jesus.

Honestly, you shouldn't be shocked that things are tough. We told you this was coming. It's just part of the deal. When we were with you, we gave you the heads-up that trouble was on the way. Now that it's here, you get it. That's why I was so worried. I had to know how you were holding up. I didn't want the devil to slide into your DMs and mess everything up that we'd built together.

But then Timothy came back with a killer report about your faith and how you're all showing love to each other, and man, we felt so much better. It's awesome to hear that you guys still think we're cool and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you. Even though we're going through it over here, just knowing you're all good keeps us going. Your faith is giving us life.
Seriously, how can we even thank God enough for all the joy you guys bring us? We're praying for you 24/7, hoping we get to see you again soon and help you out if your faith ever gets a little shaky.

We're asking God and Jesus to make a path for us to get to you. And we're praying that you get a miraculous transformation in the love department, so much that it spills over onto everyone around you, just like our love for you. We hope you're feeling strong, pure, and totally confident when Jesus comes back with his whole crew.

1 Thessalonians.title: Level Up Your Life & The Ultimate Comeback
paragraphs: §Those Who Have Died

Alright, real talk, my guys. We’re not just gonna say this, we’re gonna shout it: keep crushing it for God. This isn’t some boring homework assignment; it’s like a victory dance. You already know the playbook we got from the head coach, Jesus. God’s main thing is for you to live clean. Stay away from all the sus stuff, you know?

Basically, have some self-respect. Your body is a temple, not a trash can, so don’t treat it like people who don’t even know God. Don't be mean to your friends and family or step on them to get ahead. God sees that, and trust me, He’ll handle it. We’ve told you before, God didn’t call us to be messy and horrible. He’s calling us to a miraculous transformation, inside and out.
§Be Ready
And if you just ghost this advice, you’re not just dissing us, you’re straight-up rejecting God. And He’s the one giving you His Holy Spirit, which is a pretty VIP gift. So yeah, don't do that.

When it comes to being a good friend and getting along, you guys don’t even need me to lecture you. God already taught you how to be bros. Seriously, you’re already nailing it—we hear about how you’re treating everyone in Macedonia. So just keep getting better at it. Level up that friendship game.

And hey, chill out. Stop worrying about everyone else’s business and just focus on your own grind. We’ve said this a bunch, but it’s a good reminder. We want you to live in a way that even people outside our crew respect you, not just mooching off your friends all the time.

Now, about the question you guys had about what happens to our friends who have already died. Don’t panic out about it like people who have no hope. The grave isn’t the end of the game. Since Jesus literally died and then respawned, God’s totally going to bring back everyone who was on Team Jesus when they died.

And get this—this is straight from the Master, so it’s legit. When Jesus comes back to get us, those of us who are still around won’t get to cut the line. The ones who already died? They’re the VIPs who go first. The Master Himself will give the signal—it’ll be like an archangel’s thunder and a massive trumpet blast. He’ll come down from heaven, and the dead who believed in Christ will rise up first. Then, the rest of us still here will get beamed up into the clouds with them to meet the Master. We’ll literally be walking on air! It’s gonna be one epic family reunion with Jesus. So, when you’re feeling down, just remember that and cheer each other up.

1 Thessalonians.title: The Ultimate Surprise Party
paragraphs: §Final Instructions

Hey, what's up, guys? So, about when all this crazy end-of-the-world stuff is gonna go down... honestly, I don't even need to get into it. You already know the deal. The Master's return isn't something you can just mark on your calendar. He's not gonna slide into your DMs with a heads-up. It's gonna be more like a thief in the night – totally random. Just when everyone's chilling, thinking, "We're so set, life is good," BAM! Everything goes sideways. It'll be as sudden and intense as a pop quiz you didn't study for.

But you guys are in the loop, so you won't be caught off guard. You're the real VIPs, the kids of the light. We're living in the open, we know what's up. So, let's not be like those other people, sleepwalking through life. Let's stay woke and be smart. They're the ones who are all about late-night partying and getting ruined. That's not our scene. We're all about the daylight, so let's act like it. Let's be clear-headed, rocking our faith, love, and the hope that we're saved.

God didn't choose us to get roasted; He chose us for a miraculous transformation through our main man, Jesus. He took one for the team, and his death was the ultimate power-up for us. So, whether we're alive and kicking or six feet under, we're alive *with him*! So, keep hyping each other up. Build that hope so everyone's on the same page, no one gets left behind. I know you're already doing it, so just keep that good energy flowing.
Alright, now for the leaders who are putting in the work for you, the ones who are basically your spiritual coaches. You gotta show them some major respect. Shower them with appreciation and love!

And for everyone else, just get along. Do your part. If you see someone slacking, give them a friendly nudge to get back in the game. Be gentle with the ones who are struggling, and help out the ones who are totally wiped. Be patient with everyone, and pay attention to what they need. And when you start getting on each other's nerves, don't just start throwing shade. Look for the good in people and try to bring it out.
Always be stoked, no matter what. Keep the prayers coming, 24/7. And be thankful for everything, even the bad stuff. This is how God wants His squad, the followers of Jesus, to live.

Don't ignore the Holy Spirit, and don't shut down people who have a message from the big guy. But also, don't be a sucker. Check everything out, and only keep the good stuff. If something seems suspicious, toss it.

May God, the one who makes everything awesome, give you a total transformation—spirit, soul, and body—and keep you ready for when our Master, Jesus, shows up. The one who called you is the real deal. If he said it, he'll do it. Seriously.
Keep praying for us, fam. Give all the other believers a big hug. And make sure everyone hears this message. Don't leave anyone out.
The amazing grace of Jesus Christ be with you all!

2 Thessalonians.title: Payback is Coming
paragraphs: §Encouragement in Persecution

What's up, guys? It's Paul, Silas, and Timothy here, giving a shout-out to our crew in Thessalonica. We're repping God the Father and our main man, Jesus Christ. He's the one who hooks you up with everything you need and helps you level up into who you're meant to be.

Seriously, we can't stop thanking God for you guys. It's not just 'cause we're nice; we actually have to. Your faith is blowing up, and the way you look out for each other is awesome. We're totally bragging about you to everyone. You're holding it down and staying strong even when things get rough and life throws you curveballs. We're telling all the other churches how legit you are.

All the tough stuff you're going through? It's actually a good sign. It shows God's getting you ready for his kingdom. Yeah, you're taking some hits now, but payback is coming. When the boss, Jesus, rolls up from heaven with his squad of powerful angels, it's going to be lit. He's coming to settle the score with everyone who gave you a hard time. For all the people who ghosted God and ignored his message, it's game over. They'll be permanently kicked out from the awesome presence of the Lord and his incredible power. But for us, his followers, it's the moment we've all been waiting for. He's going to get a massive hero's welcome from everyone who believed, and that includes you, because you trusted what we told you.

So, knowing this epic day is right around the corner, we're always praying for you. We're asking God to make you worthy of his call, to power up all your good intentions and faithful actions with his energy so your lives make a real impact. The goal is for your life to bring honor to Jesus, and in return, he'll honor you. It's all thanks to the free gift of grace from our God and the Lord, Jesus Christ.

2 Thessalonians.title: The Final Boss
paragraphs: §The Day of the Lord

Alright guys, listen up, for real. Chill out and don't get all hyped up about Jesus coming back. I know you're excited to meet the big guy, but don't let anyone fool you with some fake news or a phony letter that looks like it's from me, saying you missed the whole thing. Don't fall for that garbage.

Before the real deal goes down, a couple of things have to happen first. First, a bunch of people are gonna totally ghost God. It's gonna be a massive falling away. Then, the final boss shows up—this guy who's basically Satan's right-hand man. He's gonna go on a rampage, dissing every other god and trashing their temples. Once he's cleared the field, he's gonna walk into God's own Temple, sit on the throne, and be like, "I'm God now." Seriously, have you guys already forgotten I told you all this? C'mon!

Remember how I said something is holding the final boss back for now? Yeah, that's still happening. But the evil vibes are already out there, working low-key. Soon, though, the thing holding him back will be gone, and this guy will be unleashed. But don't even sweat it. The Master, Jesus, will show up right when he does and totally own him. Jesus appears, and poof! That loser is toast.

The final boss will roll in with a ton of fake power, pulling off all these bogus miracles and signs. It's all a big show, a scam to trick people who don't want to hear the truth that could save them. And since they're so into all that evil stuff, God's just gonna let them have it. They wanted a world of lies, so that's what they'll get. They'll be stuck in their own fake reality.

But you guys? We're always thanking God for you. You're the real VIPs, chosen by God from the very beginning. He picked you to be saved because you kept it real and believed the truth. He invited you into this awesome life through the message we shared, so you could get in on the glory of our Master, Jesus Christ.

So, stand strong, my guys. Keep your feet on the ground and your heads held high. Hold on tight to everything we taught you, whether we said it to your face or wrote it in a letter. I pray that Jesus himself and God our Father, who loves you like crazy and has given you non-stop help and confidence, will fire you up, make your work awesome, and give you the right words to say.

2 Thessalonians.title: Don't Be a Freeloader
paragraphs: §Warning Against Laziness

Alright, one last thing, my guys. Keep us in your thoughts, and pray that God's message goes viral, just like it did with you guys. Also, pray that we can dodge all the haters and troublemakers out there. It turns out, not everyone who says they're on the team is for real. But God is the ultimate VIP; He's got our back and will keep you safe from the negativity.

We have total faith in you because you're with the Lord. We know you're already doing all the stuff we talked about, and you're gonna keep crushing it. We hope the big guy upstairs keeps guiding you to be more loving and tough, just like Christ was.

Now, here's a direct order from our Lord, Jesus Christ: you gotta ghost anyone in the squad who's being lazy and not pulling their weight like we showed you. Don't let them just freeload off everyone else. We set the example, right? We weren't just chilling and expecting you to take care of us. Nah, we worked our butts off, grinding day and night so we wouldn't be a burden to any of you. It wasn't because we couldn't have asked for your help—we had the right to. We just wanted to show you what the hustle looks like, hoping you'd catch on.

Remember the golden rule we had? "If you don't work, you don't eat." Simple. But now we're hearing that some of you are just being lazy bums, mooching off the hard work of others. That's not cool. We're telling those people to get a job, no excuses, and start paying their own way. For the rest of you, don't get tired of doing the right thing.

If anyone ignores what we're saying in this letter, you need to call them out. Don't hang out with them or support their freeloading. Maybe that'll make them realize they're messing up. But don't treat them like an enemy. Just have a real talk with them, like a bro helping another bro out.
May the Lord of peace himself give you peace all the time, in every way. May the Lord be with you all.
I, Paul, am signing this off with my own hand. I do this in all my letters so you know it's legit.
The amazing grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with all of you!

1 Timothy.title: Paul's Pep Talk to His Protégé
paragraphs: §Watch Out for False Teaching

Hey, what up! It's Paul, on a special mission for Jesus, the guy who gives us major hope. God our Savior gave me the orders, and I'm writing this to you, Timothy, my awesome apprentice in the faith. Hope you're getting all the positive energy from God and Jesus!

So, remember when I was heading to Macedonia and I told you to hold down the fort in Ephesus? Well, stick with that plan. You gotta make sure everyone's teaching the real stuff and not getting sidetracked. Apparently, some people are telling crazy stories and making up weird family trees that just lead to pointless arguments. That's not what we're about. We're trying to build up people's faith and help them follow God.

The main thing we're pushing for is just **love**. Like, real love, not the fake kind that's all about you or what you can get. It's about having a heart that's wide open to God. But some people totally miss this and end up in the weeds, just gossiping and causing drama. They act like they're big-shot experts on God, but they have no clue what they're talking about, even though they sound super smart.

Look, rules are important, but it's all about who you're talking to and how you say it. The rules aren't really for people who are already doing the right thing. They're for the rebels, the ones who disrespect God, life, relationships, and the truth. They're for the people who mock the awesome message that God put me in charge of.

Speaking of which, I'm so stoked that Jesus trusted me with this gig. He totally went out on a limb for me. Before, I was a total wrecking ball, going after believers and being super arrogant. But God showed me mercy because I was clueless and didn't know who I was messing with. Then, BAM! Grace, faith, and love just flooded my life, all because of Jesus.

Here's something you can count on: Jesus came to save sinners, and I'm exhibit A. I was the worst of the worst, and the only reason I'm even here is because of God's insane mercy. Now, he uses me as an example of his never-ending patience for anyone who's thinking about trusting him.
So, major props and glory to the King of everything, the one and only God who's immortal and invisible, forever and ever. Amen!

I'm passing the torch to you, my man Timothy. All the things that were prophesied about you were getting you ready for this. It's all coming together so you can crush this mission. Be a warrior, hold on tight to your faith, and be true to yourself. This is a battle, after all.

Some people have already bailed on their faith by being lazy and thinking they can do whatever they want. Hymenaeus and Alexander are a couple of them. I had to kick them out so they could learn not to disrespect God.

1 Timothy.title: Prayer 101 and How to Act in Church
paragraphs: §Instructions on Worship

Alright, so first things first, I need you to pray. Like, all the time. Hit up God for everyone you know. And make sure you're praying for the people in charge, like the prez and the government peeps. If they're doing a good job, we can all just chill and live our lives in peace, focusing on God. That's God's jam, for real.

God wants to save, like, literally everyone. He wants everyone to get the real scoop: there's only one God, and only one guy who connects us to Him—Jesus. He was the ultimate VIP who put himself on the line to bust us out of the trap of sin. The news is getting out there, and that's my main gig: telling people who've never heard about God what's up, and how to get in on it through simple faith.

Since we're talking about prayer, guys, when you pray, do it with positive energy. Don't be shaking your fists all angry at your enemies. Just raise your hands to God. And ladies, you're in on this too. Show up with humility, not all extra with your looks, chasing the latest trends. The best way to have a transformation is by doing awesome stuff for God.

I'm not saying girls can't be leaders, but in the church gathering, they shouldn't be trying to run the whole show and boss the guys around. It's a time for everyone to be chillin' and learnin' together. Remember, Adam was created first, then Eve. And Eve got played by the serpent, becoming the first one to mess up, with Adam right behind her. But look, the whole mom thing brought a huge win in the end, turning things around from Eve's mistake. This salvation, though, only comes to those who stick with trusting God, loving others, and keeping it real as they grow up. You can count on that.

1 Timothy.title: How to be a Church VIP
paragraphs: §Leaders in the Church

So, you wanna be a leader at church? That's legit. But hold up, it's not like they're just handing out VIP passes. There are some ground rules. First, you gotta have a good rep. People need to know you're a solid guy. You gotta be a one-woman man, stay chill, and be the kind of guy people can actually talk to. And yeah, you need to know your stuff when it comes to God. Don't be a party animal, and definitely don't be a bully. Be cool, don't get triggered by everything, and don't be greedy. You've got to have your own life on lock, and your own kids have to actually look up to you. Seriously, if your own house is a mess, how are you gonna run God's house? Also, you can't be a rookie Christian; that's a surefire way to get a big ego and let the Devil trip you up. Even people who aren't into church should think you're a decent guy, or you're just setting yourself up to get roasted.

And the same goes for the church's support crew, the deacons. These guys need to be the real deal—no fakes, no drama. They can't be hitting the bottle too hard or just in it for the perks. They have to be all-in on the big mysteries of the faith and not just trying to climb the ladder. They gotta prove themselves first. If they've got the right stuff, then they're in. And this isn't a boys-only club; the ladies have to meet the same standards. They need to be serious, trustworthy, and not spreading gossip or drinking too much. The whole crew needs to be loyal to their families and have their lives in order. When you serve like that, you get major respect and make the whole Jesus-faith look good.

I'm hoping to swing by and see you soon, but I'm writing this down just in case I get held up. This is the playbook for how we do things in God's family, the church of the living God, which is like the ultimate fortress of truth. This whole Christian thing is a huge mystery, way bigger than we can get our heads around, but some parts are crystal clear. Like how Jesus showed up as a regular guy, the Holy Spirit proved he was the real deal, and angels saw the whole thing. His story was told to everyone, people all over the world started believing in him, and then he had the ultimate transformation and went back to heaven.

1 Timothy.title: Don't Get Played by the Haters
paragraphs: §Training in Godliness

Alright, so the Holy Spirit is dropping some major truth bombs. He's saying that down the road, some people are gonna totally ghost the faith. They'll get catfished by demons and start believing a bunch of fake news from professional liars. These guys have been capping for so long, they don't even know what's real anymore. They'll try to tell you not to get married or that you can't eat certain foods. But that's nonsense! God made all that food to be enjoyed with a grateful heart, especially by those of us who are in the know. Everything God created is a banger, and we should be thankful for it. Nothing should be dissed or thrown out. God's Word and our prayers make everything legit.

If you pass this on to the squad, you'll be a real one for Jesus. You've been raised on the truth of the faith and solid teaching, so you know what's up. Don't get sidetracked by cringey stories that people try to pass off as religion. Instead, you gotta train every day to be spiritually swole. Hitting the gym is cool and all, but a disciplined life in God is a miraculous transformation that makes you fit for today and forever. That's a fact, so take it seriously. This is why we're going all in on this mission. We're betting everything on the living God, the GOAT who saves everyone, especially those who believe.

So, get the word out and teach everyone these things. And don't let anyone fool you because you're young. You gotta lead the charge and show other believers how it's done. Be a role model with your words, your actions, your love, your faith, and your integrity. Keep reading the Scriptures, giving good advice, and teaching. And that special power you got when the church leaders prayed for you? Keep that skill sharp and ready to use.

Go all in on these things. The more you practice, the more everyone will see you level up right in front of them. Keep a solid grip on who you are and what you teach. Don't get distracted. Just keep grinding. If you do that, both you and everyone who listens to you will get that ultimate W: salvation.

1 Timothy.title: The Real VIPs and How to Treat 'Em
paragraphs: §Advice for Different Groups

Alright, so here's the deal on how to treat people in the church. First off, don't go dissing the old guys. Talk to an older guy like he's your own dad, and the younger guys like they're your bros. Show some major respect to the older women like they're your mom, and the younger women like they're your sisters. Basically, treat everyone like family.

Now, about the widows. You gotta look out for the ones who are truly on their own. If a widow's got family, they need to step up and take care of her. That's like, Christianity 101—your faith starts at home. It's like paying back your parents for all the stuff they did for you, and God is super into that. You can spot a real-deal widow because she's all-in on God, always praying for everyone. But if a widow is just playing people for their money, she's a fake. Make sure everyone knows this so they do the right thing. If you don't take care of your own family, you're basically ghosting your faith, which is even worse than not believing in the first place.

For the older widows, you can sign them up for a special support squad. The church will have their back, but they gotta be over 60, only been married once, and have a rep for being a real MVP—helping with kids, welcoming strangers, and taking care of tired-out Christians and people who are hurting.

But don't put the young widows on this list. They'll join up and then immediately be like, 'I'd rather have a husband.' They'll break their promise and just get into drama, wasting their time with gossip and nonsense. Seriously, it's better for the young widows to just get married, have kids, run their homes, and not give the haters anything to talk about. Some of them have already bailed and are following Satan.
And if a Christian woman has widows in her family, she's gotta take care of them. Don't just dump them on the church. The church has its hands full with the widows who have nobody.

Now, for the leaders who are crushing it, especially the ones who work hard at preaching and teaching, give them a bonus. The Bible says you shouldn't muzzle an ox when it's working, and a worker deserves to get paid.

Don't even listen to a complaint about a leader unless you've got two or three witnesses to back it up. If someone does mess up, call them out in front of everyone. That'll send a message to anyone else who's thinking about doing the same thing.

I'm telling you this with God, Jesus, and all the angels as my witnesses: follow these instructions and don't play favorites. Don't be in a rush to make someone a leader. If you do, you might end up being part of their mess. Keep yourself clean. And hey, don't let the critics get to you. A little wine is fine; it's good for your stomach and can help you feel better.

Some people's sins are super obvious, like they're marching straight to judgment. Other people's sins are more low-key and don't show up until later. It's the same with good deeds. Some are easy to see, but none of them can be hidden forever. The truth always comes out in the end.

1 Timothy.title: Don't Get Played by Money
paragraphs: §Money and Contentment

Alright, so if you're working for someone, you gotta show them respect. Don't be a slacker and make God and what we're teaching look bad. And if your boss is a Christian? Even better. Treat them like family, 'cause they are. These are the things you gotta tell people.

Now, if you see so-called leaders teaching weird stuff and ignoring the solid truth from Jesus, you gotta call them out. They're just posers who love to start drama, spread rumors, and trash-talk everyone. It's like a virus of backstabbing, and nobody even knows what's real anymore. They're just in it to get rich quick, thinking faith is their personal ATM.

Being truly committed to God is the real transformation. It's not about cash; it's about being real with God. We came into the world with nothing, and we'll leave with nothing. So if we've got food and clothes, we're good. That's enough.

But those leaders who are just chasing money? They're headed for a total wipeout. The obsession with getting rich is a trap that leads to all kinds of trouble. Some people have totally lost their faith chasing money and now they're living with major regrets. It's a total disaster.

But you, Timothy, you're a man of God. You need to run from all that nonsense. Go hard after a life that's legit—full of integrity, faith, love, and patience. Stay in the game, run your race, and grab that eternal life you were called to, the one you told everyone you were all-in for.

I'm giving you a serious mission, in front of God who gives life and Jesus who stood his ground and didn't back down from Pilate: Stick to the plan. Don't slack off. Our main man, Jesus, is coming back right on schedule. His return is guaranteed by the ultimate VIP, the King of all kings and Lord of all lords. He's the only one who can't be defeated by death, shining so bright you can't even look at him. No one has ever seen him, 'cause he's on another level. All honor and power to him forever! You know it.

And tell the rich people in this world to chill out. They need to stop flexing and being obsessed with their money, 'cause it can all disappear tomorrow. Tell them to chase after God, who gives us way more than we could ever handle. They should use their wealth to do good, be super generous, and help others out. That's how they build up real treasure that lasts forever and get a life that's actually worth living.

And yo, Timothy, my man. Guard the truth you've been given. Protect it with your life. Don't get sucked into all the pointless arguments and fake knowledge from the so-called 'experts.' People who get caught up in all that talk can totally miss the point of faith. Stay blessed!

2 Timothy.title: Level Up Your Faith Game
paragraphs: §Fan the Flame
Hey, it's Paul, on a special mission for Jesus, dropping a line to my main man, Timothy. You're like a son to me, for real. Hope you're getting all the positive energy from God and Jesus.

Every time I pray, which is like, all the time, I give a massive shout-out to God for you. I'm talking about the same God my family has followed forever. Man, I miss you. Thinking about our last goodbye still gets me a little choked up, but I can't wait for us to hang out again. It's gonna be epic.

Speaking of good memories, I can't forget your solid-gold faith. That's some serious legacy stuff, passed down from your grandma Lois to your mom Eunice, and now it's your turn to shine. Remember when I put my hands on you and prayed? You got a special power-up for your mission. Don't let that fire die out! God didn't give us a spirit of being scared and wimpy. He wants us to be absolute beasts, full of love and with our heads on straight.

So, don't you dare be ashamed to talk about our boss, Jesus, or about me being locked up for him. You gotta take your hits for the cause, just like the rest of us. The only way we can do this is with God's power. He's the one who saved us and gave us this VIP access to a holy life. It wasn't because we were so awesome; it was his master plan from the beginning. He had this gift waiting for us in Jesus before we even existed. And now, since our Savior showed up, it's crystal clear: Jesus totally wrecked death and put life on full blast for everyone to see.

This is the message I'm supposed to shout from the rooftops as a preacher and a teacher. And yeah, it's gotten me into a ton of trouble. But I'm not sweating it. I know who I've put my trust in, and He's more than capable of protecting what He's given me until the very end.
So, keep grinding. Hold on to that faith and love you've got in Jesus, just like I taught you. That's the real deal. Guard that treasure the Holy Spirit put inside you.

I'm sure you've heard that pretty much everyone from Asia ghosted me, even those guys Phygelus and Hermogenes. Total letdown. But shout-out to Onesiphorus and his family! That guy was a real one. He came and chilled with me so many times and wasn't even a little bit embarrassed that I was in jail. The first thing he did when he got to Rome was track me down. I pray God shows him major love on judgment day. You know better than anyone how much he helped out back in Ephesus. What a legend.

2 Timothy.title: Level Up Your Faith Game
paragraphs: §A Good Soldier

Alright, little bro, listen up. You gotta go all in for Jesus. Everything I've taught you, the stuff everyone was thrilled about? Pass it on to some solid guys who can teach others too. When things get tough, you gotta be tough too, just like Jesus. Think about it: a soldier on a mission doesn't get sidetracked by drama at the mall. He's focused on the mission. An athlete who cheats? He's not winning any medals. And the farmer who works hard is the one who gets the crops. Let that sink in. God will make it all make sense.

Never forhere's the thing: Jesus, from the legendary family of David, came back from the dead. That's the core message. That's why I'm in the slammer right now. But you can't lock up God's message! That's why I'm toughing it out, so everyone God's calling can get their transformation in Christ. And this is 100% legit: If we die with him, we get to live with him. If we stick with him through the hard times, we'll be VIPs with him. If we ghost him, he'll ghost us. But if we fail him, he'll never fail us. He's gotta be true to himself, you know?

Keep reminding everyone of these key things. Tell them to stop arguing about clueless stuff that just messes with their faith and makes everyone tired. Just focus on being awesome for God, doing stuff you can be proud of, and keeping it real with the truth. Stay away from people who just talk a big game but don't live it. Words have power, and if you're not living right, they're like poison. Look at Hymenaeus and Philetus—they're totally off track, telling people the resurrection already happened and messing everyone up.

But God's truth is solid, like a building with this written on it: **God knows his squad.** And **if you're on God's team, you gotta ditch the bad stuff.** Think of it like this: in a fancy kitchen, you've got nice plates for serving good food, and you've got trash cans for the garbage. You want to be the nice plate that God can use to serve up blessings to everyone.

So, run from all the childish stuff you want to do. Instead, chase after what's right—faith, love, and peace. Hang out with people who are serious about praying to God. Don't get into pointless arguments; they just turn into fights. A servant of God shouldn't be a fighter. You gotta be a good listener and a patient teacher, even with people who don't want to listen. You never know, God might just help them see the light and escape the devil's trap, where they're being used to do his dirty work.

2 Timothy.title: Watch Out for the Fakes
paragraphs: §The Last Days

Hey, Tim, listen up. Don't be a rookie. Things are gonna get crazy difficult, especially near the end. People are gonna be all about themselves, obsessed with money, and always flexing. They'll be arrogant, say messed-up things, and totally disrespect their parents. They'll be rude, mean, and always fighting. They won't listen to anyone, will spread rumors, and act on impulse. They'll be savage, cynical, and stab you in the back. They'll be brutal, full of hot air, and chasing after every desire. They'll act like they're all about God, but it's just a show. They're like wild animals on the inside. So, ghost those kinds of people.

These are the guys who slide into the DMs of vulnerable girls who are going through a tough time. They take advantage of them, especially the ones who are down on themselves and will believe any new 'truth' that comes along. These girls get played every single time and never learn. These guys are just like those old-school fakers, Jannes and Jambres, who tried to go against Moses. They're total rejects from the real faith, with messed-up thinking, and they're anti-truth. But don't worry, these imposters won't get far. Everyone will see right through them, just like they did with those Egyptian guys.

But you, Tim, you're my boy. You've been with me through it all. You've seen how I teach, how I live, what I'm all about. You've seen my faith, my patience, my love, and how I've dealt with tough times. You were there with me when I was getting grief in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. And you know that God had my back and rescued me every time! Anyone who's serious about living for Jesus is going to have a rough time. That's just how it is. And those suspicious con artists will keep taking advantage of people's faith. They're just as lost as the people they're tricking. As long as they're around, things are only going to get crazier.

But don't let any of that get to you. You've got to stick with what you've learned and what you believe. You know your teachers are legit. You've been learning the Holy Scriptures since you were a kid! The Bible is the ultimate guide to being saved through faith in Jesus. Every single part of the Bible is from God and is useful. It shows us what's true, calls us out when we're wrong, corrects our mistakes, and trains us to live God's way. Through the Bible, we get our act together and are ready for whatever God has planned for us.

2 Timothy.title: Passing the Torch
paragraphs: §Final Charge

Hey, listen up, because this is major. God's watching your every move, and Jesus is the ultimate ref who'll make the final call on everyone, no exceptions. He's about to go big-time with his kingdom, so you gotta get out there and shout the message from the rooftops. Stay sharp, call people out when they're wrong, but also cheer them on. Never back down, and keep it real.

You're gonna run into people who can't handle the real talk. They'd rather snack on spiritual junk food—whatever sounds cool and makes them feel good. They'll totally ghost the truth and chase after fake stuff. But you? You stay focused. Power through the tough times, keep the message alive, and be the MVP for God.
§Paul's Farewell

It's your turn to step up. I'm about to check out, my life poured out for God. This whole journey has been the only race that matters, and I went all out, keeping the faith until the very end. Now, all that's left is the victory celebration—God's epic applause. And for real, He's a fair judge. He's not just gonna reward me, but everyone who's hyped for his return.

Get over here ASAP. Demas bailed on me, chasing the latest trends in Thessalonica. Crescens is in Galatia, and Titus is in Dalmatia. Only Luke is still with me. Bring Mark with you; he's a huge help, and I'm sending Tychicus to Ephesus. Oh, and grab my winter coat I left with Carpus in Troas, and don't forget my books and especially the notebooks.
And watch your back around Alexander the metalworker. That guy seriously tried to cancel our message and caused a ton of drama. God will serve him the karma he deserves.

When I had my first hearing, nobody had my back. They all bounced, totally scared. But whatever, because the Boss, Jesus, stood right by me. He powered me up to get the message out loud and clear to people who'd never heard it. It was like being saved from a lion's mouth! God's got me, keeping me safe for his heavenly kingdom. Mad props to him forever and ever. You know it!
Give a shout-out to Priscilla and Aquila, and to Onesiphorus's whole crew. Erastus is still back in Corinth, and I had to leave Trophimus in Miletus because he was sick.
Seriously, try to make it here before winter hits.
Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the homies here say 'what's up'.
May God be with you. Peace out.

Titus.title: Step Up and Lead Right
paragraphs: §Qualifications for Leaders

Hey, what up? It's your boy Paul, and I'm on a special mission from God and Jesus. My whole deal is to get people hyped about the faith, especially God's chosen crew. I'm here to spill the real tea about God and how to live a life that's not totally lame. My goal is to get everyone stoked about eternal life. God promised this way back, and he's not the type to ghost on his promises. When the time was right, he dropped the truth on everyone, and I'm the one he picked to spread the word. So, to my main man Titus, my legit son in the faith: I hope you get all the good stuff from God our Father and our Savior, Jesus.

I bounced and left you in charge on that island, Crete, so you could finish up the stuff I didn't get to. You need to pick some leaders for each town, but don't just pick anyone. Make sure they're solid guys. Are they respected? Are they loyal to their wives? Are their kids cool and not always getting into trouble? A church leader has to be someone people look up to. He can't be a pushy bully, have a short fuse, be a party animal, a bully, or just in it for the cash. He's gotta be welcoming, helpful, smart, fair, and have his act together. Most importantly, he needs to have a solid grip on the message, so he can use the truth to either get people excited about learning or shut down the haters who are talking trash.

And trust me, there are a lot of haters out there. They're rebels, and they're full of hot air and lies. The worst ones are the religious fakes who should know better. You gotta shut them down. They're messing up whole families with their bogus teachings, just to make a quick buck. One of their own even said it: "Cretans are basically professional liars, savage beasts, and lazy slobs." And he wasn't wrong. So you gotta get in their face and stop all that nonsense about made-up rules and myths. That way, they can get back to having a real, strong faith. For people with clean minds, everything is clean. But for the dirtbags who don't believe, nothing is. They leave their grimy fingerprints on everything they think and do. They talk a big game about knowing God, but their actions show they're fakes. They're total frauds, disobedient, and good for nothing.

Titus.title: How to Not Be a Total Noob
paragraphs: §Teaching Sound Doctrine

Alright, Titus, here's the deal. You gotta tell everyone the real stuff, the solid truth. Tell the old guys to chill out, be respectable, and wise. They need to have legit faith, love, and not give up. And the older ladies? They need to be respectful and not be gossiping or getting ruined. They should be like, total role models. That way, the younger women can see how to love their husbands and kids, be good and pure, keep their homes clean, and be awesome wives. We don't want anyone dissing God's message because of how we act. Oh, and tell the young guys to get their lives together and be disciplined.

But for real, the best way to teach them is to just do it yourself. Be a living example. Be legit in what you teach, and don't say crazy stuff. Then, even the haters who are totally against us won't have anything to roast you about. They might even start to think you're not so bad after all.

Tell the workers to be loyal and a major plus to their bosses. No talking back, and no stealing office supplies or whatever. When they act with good character, it makes God's teachings look even better. It's like a total transformation for the faith.

God's ready to forgive everyone, and He's not keeping it a secret. Salvation is for everybody! He's showing us how to ghost our old, selfish lives and start living a life that's all about Him. This new life is starting now, and it's getting us hyped for the epic day when our awesome God and Savior, Jesus Christ, shows up. He sacrificed himself to save us from our dark, rebellious lives and make us into a squad He can be proud of, a team that's all about doing good things.
So, tell everyone this stuff. Hype them up, and if they get out of line, you gotta correct them. You're the leader here. Don't let anyone treat you like a scrub.

Titus.title: How to Be a Real G
paragraphs: §Doing Good

Alright, listen up. Make sure everyone knows to respect the government and follow the rules. No need to be a rebel without a cause. Always be ready to help someone out. Don't be throwing shade or starting fights. God's crew should be known for being generous and cool to everyone.

And yo, don't forget where we came from. Not too long ago, we were the clueless ones, stubborn and getting played by our own bad habits. We were walking around with a chip on our shoulder, hating on people and getting hated on right back. But then God, our awesome and loving Savior, stepped in and showed his power.
