Honestly, God, it's wild that you even care about us. Why do you bother with us at all? We're just like a puff of smoke, like shadows from a bonfire that disappear in a second.

God, come down from heaven and show your power. Make the mountains tremble. Unleash your lightning everywhere; send your arrows flying. Reach down from the sky and pull me out of this sea of hatred, away from these toxic people who lie to my face and stab me in the back after a handshake.
O God, I'm going to write a new song for you, and I'll play it on my guitar. It's a song for the God who saves leaders, the God who rescued his boy David.
Save me from my enemies, and get me away from these fake people who lie straight to your face and then betray you.

Let our sons grow up strong and dependable, like sturdy oak trees. Let our daughters be as beautiful and vibrant as a field of wildflowers. Let our storage be full of food, and our fields be full of animals. Keep us safe from attacks and from being kicked out of our homes. Get rid of the crime in our neighborhoods.
Man, the people who have all this are so blessed. The people who have God as their God are truly blessed.

Psalms.title: God is ALWAYS on Your Side (No Cap)
paragraphs: My God, my King, I'm gonna hype you up forever! Seriously, I'll praise your name for all of time.
I'll thank you every single day, like, forever and ever.
God is just so awesome, you can't even praise him enough. His greatness is, like, infinite.
Literally every generation is amazed by what you do. They all tell stories about your epic deeds.
Everyone's talking about how beautiful and amazing you are. I'm even writing songs about all the cool stuff you do.
The amazing things you do are basically front-page news. I could write a whole book about how great you are.
Everyone knows how good you are; your reputation for doing the right thing is spreading everywhere.
God is super merciful and full of grace. He doesn't get mad easily and he's got so much love to give.
God is good to everyone, no exceptions. Everything he does is just dripping with grace.
All of creation gives you a round of applause, God; your people give you a shout-out.
They talk about how glorious your kingdom is, and they can't stop talking about your power.
They're letting the whole world know how powerful you are for good, and how incredibly awesome your kingdom is.
Your kingdom is forever; you're not going anywhere.
God always keeps his promises, and everything he does is full of grace.
God helps people up when they're down on their luck, and gives a fresh start to those who are about to give up.
All eyes are on you, waiting expectantly; you give them their food right on time.
You're so generous, it's almost ridiculous. You shower your love on every living thing.
Everything God does is right—love is his signature move.
God is right there, listening to everyone who prays, as long as they're being real about it.
He does what's best for those who respect him—he hears their cries for help and saves them.
God has the backs of everyone who loves him, but it's game over for those who don't.
I can't stop praising God. Let every living thing bless his holy name, from now until forever!

Psalms.title: Don't Trust Humans, Trust God!
paragraphs: Hallelujah! Yo, my soul, praise God! I'm gonna praise God my whole life, singing songs to my God as long as I'm alive.

Don't put your trust in so-called "experts" who don't know the first thing about real life, about saving your soul. They're just people, and they can't save you. When they die, all their big plans die with them. Instead, get help from the God of Jacob. Put your hope in God and you'll be seriously blessed! God made the sky, the earth, the sea, and every fish in it. He always keeps his promises. He stands up for people who are treated unfairly, and he feeds the hungry. God sets prisoners free, gives sight to the blind, and helps people who have fallen. God loves good people, protects foreigners, and takes care of orphans and widows. But he'll make quick work of the wicked.
God is in charge—always. The God of Zion is God forever! Hallelujah!

Psalms.title: God's Got This: He's in Control of Everything
paragraphs: Hallelujah! Seriously, it’s awesome to sing praises to our God. Praise is beautiful, and it just feels right.

God’s the one rebuilding Jerusalem and bringing back all the scattered people of Israel. He’s there for the brokenhearted, patching up their wounds. He’s got all the stars counted and knows each one by name. Our Lord is so great, like, his power is off the charts, and you can’t even begin to grasp how much he knows and does. He lifts up the people who’ve been knocked down and throws the wicked into the trash.

God’s the one rebuilding Jerusalem and bringing back all the scattered people of Israel. He’s there for the brokenhearted, patching up their wounds. He’s got all the stars counted and knows each one by name. Our Lord is so great, like, his power is off the charts, and you can’t even begin to grasp how much he knows and does. He lifts up the people who’ve been knocked down and throws the wicked into the trash.

Sing a thank-you song to God, and bust out your instruments for him. He’s the one who fills the sky with clouds, gets the rain ready for the earth, and makes the mountains green with grass. He feeds the cows and even the baby crows when they cry out. He’s not impressed by a powerful horse or how big someone’s muscles are. What really gets God’s attention is people who respect him and trust in his unfailing love.

Sing a thank-you song to God, and bust out your instruments for him. He’s the one who fills the sky with clouds, gets the rain ready for the earth, and makes the mountains green with grass. He feeds the cows and even the baby crows when they cry out. He’s not impressed by a powerful horse or how big someone’s muscles are. What really gets God’s attention is people who respect him and trust in his unfailing love.

Jerusalem, go worship God! Zion, praise your God! He’s made your city safe and has blessed all your kids. He keeps everything peaceful inside your borders and puts the best food on your tables. He sends out his commands to the world—and man, they get there fast! He lays down snow like a white blanket, scatters frost like it’s ash, and throws hail like he’s feeding birds. Who can even handle his winter? But then he says the word, and it all melts. He just breathes, and suddenly it’s spring again.

Jerusalem, go worship God! Zion, praise your God! He’s made your city safe and has blessed all your kids. He keeps everything peaceful inside your borders and puts the best food on your tables. He sends out his commands to the world—and man, they get there fast! He lays down snow like a white blanket, scatters frost like it’s ash, and throws hail like he’s feeding birds. Who can even handle his winter? But then he says the word, and it all melts. He just breathes, and suddenly it’s spring again.
He talks to Jacob’s family the same way, giving his powerful words to Israel. He’s never done that for any other nation; they’ve never heard his commands. Hallelujah!

Psalms.title: The Ultimate Praise Anthem
paragraphs:
Hallelujah! Praise God from the heavens, praise him from the highest heights.
Praise him, all you angels; praise him, all you heavenly warriors.
Praise him, sun and moon; praise him, all you shining stars.
Praise him, you highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
Let them praise the name of the LORD, for he commanded and they were created.
He set them in place for ever and ever; he gave a decree that will never pass away.

Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,
lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,
you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,
kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,
young men and women, old men and children.

Let them praise the name of the LORD, for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.
He has raised up a horn for his people, the praise of all his saints, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Hallelujah!

Psalms.title: Praise Party & Sword Dance!
paragraphs: Ayy, let's go! Sing a brand-new banger for God, and praise Him with the whole squad of people who love Him. The whole nation of Israel should celebrate their Creator, and all of Zion’s kids should be hyped about their King. Let them praise His name with some sick dance moves, get the band together, and make some epic music! And for real, why? Because God is super into His people, and He blesses humble folks with the awesome gift of salvation!

Let all the true fans of God shout out in praise, singing from wherever they are. Yell out the highest praises to God, and get ready with your swords, like a wild sword-dance—it's a sign that God's about to get back at the nations that don't follow Him, a warning that punishment is coming. Their kings will be chained up and thrown in jail, and their leaders will be locked up for good. The judgment written about them will happen for real—and everyone who loves God will have a place of honor! Ayy, let's go!

Psalms.title: The Ultimate Praise Sesh
paragraphs: Let's gooo! Give it up for God in His house, and even when you're just chilling outside. Praise Him for all the powerful things He's done, and for how mind-blowingly great He is. Praise Him with a loud trumpet, and with some chill guitar vibes. Praise Him with castanets and dancing, and with the banjo and flute. Praise Him with crashing cymbals and a booming bass drum, and with fiddles and mandolins. Basically, if you're breathing, you should be praising God! Let's gooo!

Proverbs.title: God's Wisdom vs. Clout Chasers
paragraphs: Yo, these are the wise words from Solomon, who was King David's son and the king of Israel. He wrote this stuff down so we can learn how to live a good life, understand the big picture, and know what's up. It's basically a life manual for doing the right thing, being fair, and acting justly. It helps clueless people learn the ropes and gives young people a reality check. Even wise, experienced folks can learn a thing or two from this. It's some next-level wisdom to really get your head around.
The first step to getting smart is respecting God. Only fools would ignore that kind of wisdom and knowledge.

Listen up, my friend, and pay attention to what your dad tells you. Don't forget the lessons you learned from your mom. Their advice is like a crown of victory or some serious bling on your fingers. My dude, if your sketchy friends try to get you to do dumb stuff, just don't. If they're like, "Yo, let's go cause some trouble, jump some old guy, and take his stuff. We'll get so much loot and split it all,"—for real, don't even give them the time of day. They're heading for a bad ending and will mess up everything they touch. You wouldn't rob a bank in broad daylight, right? Well, that's basically what they're doing to themselves. When you're all about getting more and more, you actually become less of a person.
Lady Wisdom is out in the streets, shouting for everyone to hear. She's making a speech in the town square. She's standing in the middle of traffic, at the busiest intersection, calling out:

"You simpletons! How long are you gonna stay clueless? You cynics! How long are you gonna keep that negative attitude? You idiots! How long will you refuse to learn? Turn your life around! I can give you a fresh start. Look, I'm ready to pour out my spirit on you and tell you everything I know. But I've been calling out, and you've been ignoring me. I've reached out, but you've ghosted me."

"Since you just laugh at my advice and think my guidance is a joke, how am I supposed to take you seriously? I'll be the one laughing when you're in trouble! What if your whole world comes crashing down? What if a disaster hits and your life is a total wreck? You'll need me then. You'll call for me, but I won't answer. You can look all you want, but you won't find me."

"Because you hated knowledge and didn't want anything to do with fearing God, because you wouldn't take my advice and ignored all my offers to help you, well, you made your bed, now lie in it. You wanted to do your own thing—so how's that working out for you? Don't you see what happens, you simpletons, you idiots? Being careless will get you killed; being complacent is basically suicide. If you listen to me, then you can chill. You can relax now—you're in good hands."

Proverbs.title: How to Not Get Played
paragraphs: My friend, for real, take what I'm saying to heart. Lock in on my advice and protect it like it's your most valuable possession. Actually listen for wisdom, and make it your goal to really understand things. Seriously, if you make insight your number one priority and don't give up, hunting for it like buried treasure, I promise you'll get what it means to have a healthy respect for God. You'll actually start to know Him.

Here's the deal: God is the one who gives out wisdom. He doesn't hide knowledge or understanding. He's got a huge stash of common sense for people who are trying to live right, and he's like a personal bodyguard for those who are real and sincere. He watches over everyone who's trying to be honest and gives extra protection to the ones who are loyal to him.

So once you get this, you'll be able to see what's right and fair, and find the best paths in life. Wisdom will be like your best friend, and knowledge will be your cool companion. Good sense will be your lookout, and insight will watch your back. They'll keep you from taking wrong turns or following the terrible advice of people who are already lost themselves. You know, the losers who think being evil is a game and celebrate doing messed-up things. They're on a path to nowhere, just wandering around in circles.

This wisdom will also save you from the player, the smooth-talker who tries to trap you. The one who cheated on her partner and completely forgot the promises she made to God. Her lifestyle is a dead end; every step she takes is a step closer to disaster. Anyone who gets with her never seems to make it back to a good life.

So, stick with good people. Keep your feet on the paths that have been proven to be good. The people who live with integrity are the ones who will last and build a good life here. The corrupt ones will be wiped out, and the dishonest will be gone for good.

Proverbs.title: The Ultimate Life Hack Guide
paragraphs: Yo, my friend, don't just forget everything I've taught you. Like, actually take my advice to heart. It'll help you live a super long and awesome life, for real.
Never let go of Love and Loyalty. Keep them close, like a chain around your neck. Tattoo them on your heart. That's how you get a good rep with God and with people.

Trust God with your whole heart. Don't try to figure everything out on your own. Listen for God's voice in everything you do, everywhere you go. He's the one who'll keep you on the right path. Don't get cocky and think you know it all. Run to God! Run from all the bad stuff! Your body will literally glow with health, and you'll feel alive down to your bones! Honor God with everything you have; give him the first and the best of what you've got. Your bank account will be overflowing, and your life will be popping. But hey, don't get mad when God has to correct you; don't get all sulky about it. He does it because he loves you, just like a dad who's super proud of his kid.

You're seriously blessed when you find Lady Wisdom and become friends with Madame Insight. She's worth way more than any amount of money in the bank; being her friend is better than a huge paycheck. She's more valuable than all the fancy stuff you could ever want; nothing even comes close. With one hand she gives you a long life, and with the other, she gives you respect. She's got a beautiful way about her, and her life is just so complete. She's like the Tree of Life to anyone who hangs on to her. Hold on tight—and you'll be blessed!
God used Lady Wisdom to create the Earth, and with Madame Insight, he set up the heavens. They knew exactly when to make rivers and springs flow, and when to make the dew fall from the sky at night.

My friend, hold on to Clear Thinking and Common Sense for dear life; don't lose sight of them for a second. They'll keep your soul alive and well, and they'll keep you looking good. You'll be able to go about your life safely, without getting tired or tripping up. You'll be able to chill and take naps without a worry in the world, and you'll sleep great at night. No need to freak out over every little thing, or when people say the world is ending. Because God will be right there with you; he'll keep you safe and sound.

Never just walk away from someone who needs help; you're God's hands for that person. Don't tell your neighbor 'maybe later' or 'hit me up tomorrow' when you've got the cash right there in your pocket. Don't try to scam your neighbor when they're just sitting there, trusting you.

Don't walk around with a chip on your shoulder, always looking for a fight. Don't try to be like those people who just push their way through life. Why be a bully? You might ask, 'Why not?' Because God can't stand people with twisted minds. He respects those who are straightforward and honest.

God's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous. He'll give proud doubters the cold shoulder, but if you're down on your luck, he's right there to help you out. Living wisely gets you honor; living foolishly just makes you look like a clown.

Proverbs.title: The Ultimate Guide to a Goated Life
paragraphs: Aight, listen up, my crew. Your dad's dropping some real talk, so tune in if you wanna know how to actually live. I'm giving you solid advice, so don't just let it go in one ear and out the other.

Back when I was a kid, my dad's favorite and my mom's pride and joy, he'd sit me down and basically drill this into my head: "Lock this in your heart. Do what I say—and you'll live! Drop everything and get that Wisdom! Go hunt for some Understanding! Don't you forget a single word I'm telling you. Don't even drift a little bit. Never ghost Wisdom—she's your life's bodyguard. Love her, and she'll always have your back. For real, above all else, do this: Get Wisdom! Put this at the very top of your to-do list: Get Understanding! Embrace her, and trust me, you won't regret it. Never let her go—she'll make your life epic. She'll deck out your life with grace and make your days beautiful."

My dude, for real, take my advice; it'll add years to your life. I'm laying out the GPS directions to Wisdom Way, drawing you a map to the Road of Righteousness. I don't want you getting stuck in dead-end streets or wasting your time taking wrong turns. Hold on tight to good advice; don't loosen your grip. Guard it like your life depends on it—because it does! Don't even think about taking the Wicked Bypass; don't even step a foot on that road. Stay way clear of it; give it a ton of space. Take a detour and just keep it moving.

Evil people are lowkey restless unless they're stirring up trouble. They can't even get a good night's sleep unless they've made someone's life miserable. Messing things up is like their food and drink, and violence is their drug of choice.

The path of people living right glows with light; the longer they live, the brighter it shines. But the road of people doing wrong just gets darker and darker—they can't see a thing and end up falling flat on their faces.

My friend, listen up close to what I'm saying; really tune your ears to my voice. Keep my message right in front of you at all times. Focus up! Learn it by heart! People who find these words truly live, like for real live; they're bursting with health, body and soul.

Keep a super close watch on your heart; that's where your whole life gets its start. Don't be two-faced; ditch the careless talk, the little white lies, and all the gossip. Keep your eyes locked straight ahead; ignore all the crazy distractions on the side. Watch where you're going, and the road ahead will smooth out for you. Don't look right or left; just leave all that evil stuff in the dust.

Proverbs.title: Don't Fall for the Trap Queen
paragraphs: Ayo, listen up. I'm about to drop some serious wisdom, so pay attention. This is the real deal, and if you listen, you'll learn how to make good choices and stay out of drama.

This girl might seem super sweet and her words are like honey, but trust me, it's a trap. Before you know it, you'll be left with a bitter taste, a whole lot of pain, and a broken heart. She's on a one-way trip to destruction, and she's trying to take you with her. She's clueless about what's real and has no idea what she's doing with her life.

So for real, my dude, listen up and don't just brush this off. Stay far away from a girl like that, like, don't even go near her part of town. You don't want to throw away your awesome life and waste it on people who couldn't care less about you. Why let randoms use you and take what's yours? You don't want to look back at your life with a bunch of regrets, just a mess of bad choices, thinking, 'Man, I should've listened. Why was I so stubborn? Why didn't I pay attention to the people who were trying to help me? Now my life is a wreck and I have nothing to show for it.'
There's a saying, 'Drink from your own water bottle, not someone else's.' It's true. If you don't, you'll come back to find your own bottle empty and gross.

Your own 'spring water' is for you and you only, not for everyone to have a sip. Be grateful for your own fountain. Love the person you married when you were young. She's amazing, like an angel and a rose. Never stop loving her and never take her for granted. Why would you give up something real and lasting for a cheap thrill with someone who doesn't care about you?

And for real, God sees everything you do. He knows every move you make. Your bad choices will catch up to you and you'll be tripping over your own feet in the dark. A life without self-control leads to death. Your dumb decisions will trap you in a dead end.

Proverbs.title: Don't Be a Fool: Life Hacks from Proverbs 6
paragraphs: Yo, my friend, if you've co-signed a loan for your neighbor or gotten tangled up in a deal with someone you barely know, and you've basically promised your life away and are now stressing big time, listen up. Don't just sit there, you gotta get out of that mess ASAP. You're basically in their control! Go, look desperate, beg if you have to. Don't wait, there's literally no time to waste. Run like you're being chased, fly like a bird escaping a trap!

Seriously, you lazy bum, go look at an ant. Just watch it for a sec; it'll teach you something. No one has to boss it around. It works hard all summer, stocking up on food for the winter. So how long are you gonna sleep in and do nothing? When are you getting out of bed? A little nap here, another one there, a day off here, another there, just chilling... you know what that leads to? A broke life. Poverty will be your new roommate, and it's not moving out.

Shady people and total liars talk out of both sides of their mouths. They give each other secret winks, tap their feet, and cross their fingers behind their backs. Their twisted minds are always scheming up something bad, always starting drama. But a disaster is coming for them, a total wreck, and their lives will be ruined with no way to fix it.
Here are six things God absolutely hates, and a seventh that He can't stand:

eyes that look down on everyone, a tongue that tells lies, hands that hurt innocent people, a heart that dreams up evil plans, feet that run to do wrong, a witness who lies in court, and someone who starts fights in their own family.

(It's so important, it's worth saying twice) eyes that look down on everyone, a tongue that tells lies, hands that hurt innocent people, a heart that dreams up evil plans, feet that run to do wrong, a witness who lies in court, and someone who starts fights in their own family.

My friend, listen to your dad's advice; don't ignore what your mom taught you. Keep their words with you always, like a necklace you never take off. When you're walking, they'll guide you; when you're sleeping, they'll protect you; when you wake up, they'll give you wisdom for the day. Good advice is like a flashlight, solid teaching is a light, and being corrected is the road to real life.

They'll keep you away from the wrong kind of person, from the smooth talk of someone trying to tempt you. Don't get caught up in fantasizing about their looks, and don't fall for their flirty eyes. You might think a hookup is cheap, but getting involved with the wrong person can cost you everything—it can eat you alive. For real, can you hold fire in your lap and not get your clothes burned? Can you walk on hot coals and not get blisters? It's the same thing when you mess with someone else's partner. If you touch them, you're gonna pay the price. No excuses. Being hungry isn't an excuse for a thief to steal; when they're caught, they have to pay it all back, even if it means losing everything they own. Cheating is just a brainless move. It destroys your soul and yourself. You can expect to get beat up, get a black eye, and have your reputation totally ruined. A jealous husband is like a ticking time bomb of rage; he'll be out for revenge and won't show any mercy. Nothing you can say or pay will make it right; no amount of money or apologies will calm him down.

Proverbs.title: Don't Fall for the Ultimate Thirst Trap
paragraphs: Yo, my dude, listen up and lock in what I'm telling you. Seriously, treasure these instructions. If you do what I say, you'll be living your best life. My teaching is as precious as your own eyes—so guard it! Write it on the back of your hands, etch it into your heart. Treat Wisdom like she's your sister, and make Insight your bestie. They'll have your back and protect you from the Temptress—that girl with the smooth talk and honeyed words who's always trying to slide into your DMs.

So, I was chilling at my window, looking out through the blinds, just watching the world go by. I saw this clueless young guy, totally without a clue, walking down the street where she lives and turning onto her path. It was getting dark, that time between evening and night when everything gets shadowy. And right on cue, this woman comes up to him. She was waiting for him, dressed to kill, you know? She was bold and loud, the type who can't sit still and is always out and about, never at home. You'd see her on the streets, at the mall, posted up on every corner.

I was at my window, peeking through the shutters, watching the clueless crowd. I saw this young guy, zero common sense, turn the corner to her street and head for her house. It was dusk, the sun was down, and it was getting real dark. Then, this woman meets him—she was lying in wait, dressed to seduce. She was brazen, couldn't stay put, always roaming. Never home. Always on the streets, at the mall, posted up on every corner.

She throws her arms around him, gives him a kiss, and grabs his arm like she owns him, saying, 'I've got a whole feast ready. I just made my offerings today, paid up all my vows. So I came out looking for you, hoping I'd run into you—and here you are! I've got fresh, clean sheets on my bed, super colorful and imported. My room smells amazing, like spices and exotic perfumes. Come on, let's just love all night. It'll be epic. My husband's out of town on a business trip and won't be back for like a month.'

She wraps her arms around him, kisses him, and boldly takes his arm, saying, 'I've got a feast ready to go—I made my offerings today, all my vows are paid. So I came looking for you, hoping to see you—and here you are! I've got fresh, clean sheets on my bed, colorful imported linens. My bed smells amazing with spices and exotic fragrances. Come on, let's make love all night, an ecstatic night of lovemaking! My husband's not home; he's on a business trip and won't be back for a month.'

Next thing you know, she's got him wrapped around her finger, totally mesmerized by her sweet talk. He's following her like a puppy, like a calf being led to the slaughterhouse. He's like a deer walking into a trap, about to get hit with an arrow. He's like a bird flying straight into a net, with no idea its freedom is over.

She had him eating out of her hand, totally bewitched by her smooth talk. Before he knew it, he was trailing behind her like a calf on its way to the butcher, or like a deer lured into a trap only to be shot. He was like a bird flying into a net, not realizing its life was about to be over.

So listen up, my friends. Take what I'm saying seriously. Don't mess around with a woman like that. Don't even walk through her neighborhood. She's taken down countless victims; she's the end of so many guys. Her house is like a gateway to hell; she'll set you up with a coffin and a funeral shroud.

So, my friends, listen to me. Take my words seriously. Don't play around with a woman like that; don't even go near her neighborhood. Countless guys have fallen for her games; she's been the downfall of so many. Her house is a one-way ticket to hell, and she'll get you fitted for a coffin.

Proverbs.title: Wisdom Spills the Tea on How to Live Your Best Life
paragraphs: Yo, can you hear Lady Wisdom shouting out? Can you hear Madame Insight making some noise? She's right there at the main crossroads, the busiest spot in town. Right in the middle of the city square, where everyone's at, she's yelling, 'Yo, everyone, I'm talking to you! All you clueless people out there, get a grip and learn some common sense! You blockheads, it's time to level up! You better listen up, 'cause I'm about to drop some serious knowledge on how to live your best life. My mouth only speaks the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth—I can't stand even a hint of evil. Every word I say is legit and straight-up; no twisted or shady stuff. If you've got an open mind, you'll see it's all facts; if you're ready for the truth, you'll get it instantly. You should want my life-lessons more than you want to get rich, and knowing God is way better than any high-paying job. Seriously, Wisdom is worth more than all the expensive stuff you could ever want; nothing you could wish for is even in the same league.

I'm Lady Wisdom, and I'm basically besties with Sanity; Knowledge and Discretion are my neighbors. Fearing God means hating evil, and I absolutely despise all of that—pride, arrogance, and all that crooked talk. I've got the best advice and common sense on lock; I'm both Insight and the power to actually use it. With my help, leaders can actually rule, and lawmakers can make fair laws. With me, governors can govern, and so can anyone else in a position of real authority. I love the people who love me; if you're looking for me, you'll find me. Wealth and glory are my sidekicks, along with some serious honor and a great reputation. What I give you is worth way more than a huge paycheck, like, a ridiculously huge one; the rewards you get from me are better than any bonus you can imagine. You can find me on Righteous Road—that's my street—at the corner of Justice Avenue, handing out life to everyone who loves me, and I mean armloads of it!

God, in his infinite wisdom, made me first—the OG, the blueprint—before he did anything else. I was created a super long time ago, way before the Earth was even a thing. I showed up on the scene before the oceans, before the springs, rivers, and lakes. Before the mountains were even sculpted and the hills were formed, I was already there, a newborn. Long before God laid out the horizons of the Earth and got into the nitty-gritty of the soil and the weather, and before he put the sky in its place, I was there. When he drew the map and set the boundaries for the wild oceans, built the huge dome of the sky, and set up the fountains that fed the ocean, when he drew a line for the sea and put up a 'no trespassing' sign, and then laid out the foundations of the Earth, I was right there with him, making sure everything was perfect. Day after day, I was there, cheering him on, always loving his company, totally amazed by the world of things and creatures, and so happy about the human family.

So, my dear friends, listen up; the people who follow my ways are seriously blessed. Live a disciplined life and be wise; don't waste your precious life. Blessed is the man, blessed is the woman, who listens to me, who's awake and ready for me every morning, alert and responsive as I start my day. When you find me, you find life, like, real life, not to mention God's total approval. But if you do me wrong, you're only hurting yourself; when you reject me, you're basically playing with fire, and you're gonna get burned.

Proverbs.title: Wisdom vs. Folly: Choose Your Squad
paragraphs: Yo, so there's this super cool chick, Lady Wisdom. She's built this amazing house, like, it's got seven pillars and everything. She's prepped a massive feast: we're talking roasted lamb, the best wine, and a table that looks like it's straight out of a magazine with all the fancy silverware and flowers. She's sent out her crew and is now standing in the middle of town, shouting out to everyone who can hear: "Yo, you feelin' lost? Like you don't know what's up with life? Come hang with me, for real, I'm having a dinner party! I've got this incredible spread—fresh bread, roast lamb, top-shelf wine. Ditch your confusion and actually *live*! Come on, let's walk down this path to a life that actually means something."

But look, if you try to talk sense to some arrogant hater, you're just gonna get shut down. Try to call out someone's bad choices, and they'll come right back at you. So don't even waste your breath on someone who just wants to mock everything; you'll just get hurt. But it's a whole different story if you give advice to people who actually care about living right—they'll totally appreciate you for it. Share what you know with wise people, and they'll get even wiser. Tell good people what you know, and they'll get something out of it. A smart life starts with respecting God. You get real insight by knowing the Holy One. Lady Wisdom says, "It's because of me that your life gets deeper and you get to live a long, full life." So, if you live wisely, wisdom will be all up in your life. But if you make fun of life, life's gonna make fun of you right back.

And then you've got this other woman, this total party girl, Madame Prostitute. She's loud, clueless, and just messes around. She's just sitting on her front porch on the main street, and when people walk by, just trying to live their lives, she yells out, "Yo, you feelin' lost? Like you don't know what's up? Sneak away with me, I'll show you a good time! Nobody will find out—it'll be the best time of your life." But what they don't see are all the skeletons in her closet. All her guests? They end up in a real bad place.

Proverbs.title: Wise vs. Foolish: The Ultimate Showdown
paragraphs: A wise kid makes their dad proud, but a foolish kid is a major bummer for their mom.
Money you get from cheating won't get you anywhere, but living an honest life makes you a legend forever.
God's got the back of honest people, so they won't starve. But for the wicked, He'll make sure their cravings are never satisfied.
Being lazy will make you broke, but hard work brings in the cash.
It's smart to get your work done when you have the chance, but it's dumb to slack off when you should be grinding.
Living a good and honest life brings on the blessings, but the words of the wicked are like a dark hole of negativity.
A good life is remembered forever, but a wicked life leaves behind a nasty legacy.
A wise person listens to advice, but a fool is just going to mess everything up.
If you're honest, you can live without a worry in the world. But if you're shady, you'll definitely get caught.
Avoiding eye contact is a sign that trouble's coming, but being open and honest with people leads to peace.
The words of a good person are like a refreshing spring of water, but the words of the wicked are a pit of nastiness.
Hatred is always starting drama, but love is all about squashing the beef and moving on.
You'll hear some real wisdom from someone who's actually smart, but a clueless person just needs a reality check.
Wise people are always learning, and that's the real treasure. But know-it-alls just talk and talk, and it's a total waste of time.
Rich people feel safe because of their money, but for the poor, their lack of money is their downfall.
The reward for being a good person is an awesome life, but a bad person just ends up with a whole lot of sin.
If you live a disciplined life, you're on the right track. But if you ignore advice, you're going to be lost for good.
Liars secretly hold on to their hate, but fools are out there spreading rumors for everyone to hear.
The more you talk, the more you're probably lying. Wise people know when to keep their mouths shut.
What a good person has to say is worth listening to, but the wicked just run their mouths and say nothing of value.
A good person's words can be a feast for a lot of people, but people who just talk nonsense are empty inside.
It's God's blessing that makes you truly rich, and nothing you do can top that.
A fool thinks causing trouble is a good time, but a smart person finds joy in wisdom.
The worst fears of the wicked will come true, but good people will get what they've been hoping for.
When a storm hits, the wicked are wiped out. But good people are standing on solid ground and don't even flinch.
A lazy worker is nothing but a headache. They're like vinegar in your mouth or smoke in your eyes.
Respecting God will give you a long and full life, but a wicked life is a short and miserable one.
The hopes of good people end in a party, but the plans of the wicked just blow up in their faces.
God is a solid foundation for a life lived right, but he's not impressed with a half-hearted effort.
Good people are here to stay—they can't be shaken. But the wicked are here one day and gone the next.
A good person's words are like a fresh stream of wisdom, but a foul mouth is like a disgusting swamp.
The words of a good person are a breath of fresh air, but the words of the wicked just pollute everything.

Proverbs.title: Real Ones vs. Fakers: The Ultimate Guide to Life
paragraphs: God is lowkey not a fan of cheating when you're doing business; he loves it when everything is fair and square.
Prideful people are headed for a major L, but the humble ones stand strong.
The integrity of honest people keeps them on the right path, but the sneakiness of crooks will be their own downfall.
A fat bank account won't help you when life gets messy, but living a life of integrity can get you through anything.
Good character makes life a smooth ride; a wicked life is a rough one.
Good character is your best defense; crooks get caught up in their own toxic desires.
When a wicked person dies, that's it for them—game over, no more second chances.
A good person gets saved from a lot of trouble, while a bad person walks right into it.
The careless words of the godless can destroy people, but the wisdom of the godly saves them.
When things go well for good people, the whole city celebrates; when the wicked crash and burn, the city has a party.
A city thrives when righteous people bless it, but evil talk can turn it into a ghost town real quick.
Talking trash about others is just heartless; a person with good sense knows when to stay quiet.
A gossip can't be trusted with a secret, but a person of integrity will never spill the tea.
Without good leadership, people lose their way; the more wise advice you get, the better your chances of success.
Making deals with strangers is a good way to get burned; if you keep your cool, you'll avoid making dumb decisions.
A graceful woman earns respect, but violent men only care about money.
When you're kind to others, you're helping yourself; when you're cruel, you're only hurting yourself.
Bad work gets you a bad outcome; good work gets you a solid reward.
Choose to be loyal to God and his people and you'll truly live; chase after evil and you'll end up with nothing.
God can't stand people with twisted hearts, but he absolutely loves those who have integrity.
Bet on this: the wicked will not get away with it, and God's people will come out on top.
A beautiful face on a person with an empty head is like a gold ring in a pig's snout. It's a total waste.
The desires of good people lead to good things, but the ambitions of the wicked end in anger and frustration.
The world of the generous person keeps getting bigger, while the world of the stingy person keeps getting smaller.
The one who blesses others will be blessed in return; those who help others will be helped themselves.
People will curse those who are greedy and hoard things for themselves, but they'll bless everyone who is fair and generous.
The one who looks for good will find it; but if you study evil, you'll become evil.
A life that's all about money and possessions is a dead-end; a life centered on God is like a tree that's flourishing and full of life.
If you take advantage of your family, you'll end up with nothing; it's just a stupid way to live, and everyone knows it.
A good life is like a tree that bears fruit; a violent life destroys people.
If even good people barely make it, what do you think will happen to the wicked?

Proverbs.title: Real Talk: How to Win at Life (and Not Be a Clown)
paragraphs: If you're into self-improvement, you've gotta be open to feedback. It's pretty dumb to brush off advice that could make you better.
A good person gets to feel God's approval, which is an awesome feeling. On the other hand, God wants nothing to do with people who are always scheming and being sneaky.
You can't build a solid life on a shaky foundation, it's like trying to stand in a swamp. But when your life is rooted in God, you're on solid ground and can't be moved.
A supportive partner can make their spouse feel alive and full of energy. But a partner who is cold and unfeeling is like a disease that slowly eats away at you from the inside.
The thoughts of good people lead to fairness and justice. But the plans of messed-up people are all about creating chaos and corruption.
The words of wicked people are like traps that can lead to death. But the words of good people can save lives.
Wicked people and their plans eventually fall apart and amount to nothing. But the families and homes of good people stay strong and last.
A person who speaks with wisdom and common sense will be respected. But people who are all talk and no substance are looked down on.
It's way better to be a normal person who works for a living than to act like you're a big shot but actually be broke and starving.
Good people are even kind to their pets and animals. But when bad people try to be 'nice,' it's usually fake and they end up being cruel anyway.
If you stick with your work and do your job, you'll always have what you need. But chasing after silly get-rich-quick schemes is just a waste of time.
Whatever wicked people build will eventually crumble and fall apart. But the things that good people create have deep roots and will keep growing and bringing life.
The trash that bad people talk will get them into trouble. But the conversations of good people keep them safe and out of drama.
There's a deep satisfaction that comes from speaking wise and helpful words. And when you do good work, that's its own reward.
Fools are stubborn and just do whatever they feel like, without thinking. But wise people are smart enough to listen to advice.
Fools have a short temper and blow up over the smallest things. But smart people know how to let insults go and not let it get to them.
When a good person tells the truth, it helps everyone see things clearly. But liars just create confusion and deception.
Using your words carelessly can hurt people as much as a weapon. But the words of the wise can bring healing and make things better.
The truth will always last. But lies have a short shelf life; they're here one day and gone the next.
Coming up with evil plans will mess you up in the end. But making plans that bring peace will bring you joy.
No real harm can happen to a good person. But wicked people are constantly dealing with the trouble they create for themselves.
God can't stand liars. But he loves to be around people who keep their promises and are true to their word.
Smart people don't feel the need to show off everything they know. But fools can't help but broadcast their foolishness to everyone.
People who work hard will find that their work gives them freedom. But lazy people feel like their work is a prison.
Worrying all the time will just weigh you down. But a single encouraging word can lift you up and make a huge difference.
A good person can get through tough times and come out okay. But the life of a wicked person is a magnet for disaster.
A lazy person's life will feel empty and unfulfilling. But if you're willing to get up and work hard, you'll get things done.
Good people are on a path that leads straight to a full life. But the path of sin is a detour that takes you straight to destruction.

Proverbs.title: Wise Choices vs. Foolish Mistakes: The Ultimate Guide
paragraphs: Smart kids listen to their parents' advice; the ones who don't just do their own thing.
Good people enjoy having helpful, deep conversations; bullies just try to force their way through life.
Watch what you say, it can literally save your life. One careless comment could ruin everything.
The lazy person wants everything but gets nothing. The one who hustles actually has something to show for it.
A good person hates lying. A bad person is all about trash talk and just makes themselves look bad.
Living right keeps you on the right path. Sin is like a ditch that the wicked fall into.
Trying to look rich when you're not is just an empty life. But living a simple life is actually a full one.
The rich can get sued for all they're worth, but if you're poor, you don't have to worry about those kinds of threats.
The lives of good people are like brightly lit streets, super clear and safe. The lives of the wicked are like dark, sketchy alleys.
Know-it-alls who think they're always right just start drama. Wise people actually listen to each other's advice.
Money that comes easy, goes easy. But if you build your wealth slowly and steadily, it'll actually last.
When you keep getting disappointed, it really messes with your head. But when something good finally happens, it can totally turn your life around.
If you ignore God's Word, you're gonna pay for it. But if you respect his commands, you'll be rewarded.
The advice of a wise person is like a fountain of life. It can save you from making some deadly mistakes.
Thinking things through leads to a gracious life. But for liars, life is a rough road.
A person with common sense lives a smart life. Fools just go around making a mess of things with their silliness.
An unreliable messenger can mess things up big time. But a trustworthy one brings healing and makes things right.
If you refuse to be corrected, you'll end up with nothing. But if you can take criticism, you'll live a respected life.
When you follow your heart and do what's right, you'll thrive. Fools who are bent on doing evil hate anything that has to do with their soul.
If you hang out with wise people, you'll become wise too. But if you hang out with fools, get ready to watch your life fall apart.
Trouble always finds sinners. But people who are loyal to God get a good life in the end.
A good person leaves a legacy for their grandkids. But the wealth that bad people get through shady means will eventually end up in the hands of good people.
The farms of the poor can get taken by the bank, or they can lose everything to crooked lawyers.
If you don't discipline your kids, it's like you don't even love them. If you really love your children, you'll correct them when they're wrong.
People who desire what is good will be satisfied. But the wicked are never happy, they always want more.

Proverbs.title: Wise Life Hacks vs. Epic Fails
paragraphs: A wise woman builds up her home, but a foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
Living an honest life shows you respect God; a messed-up life is like a slap in His face.
Silly talk just gets you eye-rolls, but wise words earn you respect.
If you don't have cattle, you won't have any crops. A big harvest needs a strong ox to do the heavy lifting.
A truthful witness never lies, but a liar makes a living out of it.
Cynics search everywhere for wisdom but never find it. But if you're open-minded, it's right there in front of you.
Stay away from fools. You won't learn anything from them, and they're a waste of your time and words.
The wisdom of smart people keeps them on the right path, but the foolishness of fools leads them straight into a ditch.
Fools laugh at what's right and wrong, but living a moral life is the way to be favored.
If you're not there for your friends when they're going through tough times, you won't be there for the celebrations either.
The lives of people who do wrong are like falling-apart shacks, but living a holy life is like building a huge cathedral.
There's a way of life that seems fine, but if you look closer, it's a highway to hell. Sure, it looks like fun, but all that laughing will end in a broken heart.
A mean person gets what they deserve, and a kind person gets grace.
Someone who's gullible will believe anything, but a smart person thinks carefully about every word.
The wise are careful and avoid trouble, but fools are reckless and just charge ahead.
People with short tempers do stupid things they'll regret, and cold-hearted people get left out in the cold.
Foolish people live in a fantasy world, but wise people have their feet on the ground.
Eventually, evil will have to bow down to good, and the wicked will have to respect those who are loyal to God.
Nobody wants to be around a loser, but everyone loves a winner.
It's a crime to ignore a neighbor who needs help, but showing compassion to the poor is a huge blessing.
Isn't it obvious that people who plot evil lose in the end, while those who are thoughtful win love and trust?
Hard work always pays off, but just talking about it won't get you anywhere.
The wise get wiser, but fools just get more foolish every day.
A truthful witness can save lives, but spreading lies betrays people.
Fearing God gives you confidence and makes the world a safe place for your kids.
The fear of God is like a spring of fresh water that keeps you from drinking from poisoned wells.
A good leader has loyal followers; without them, leadership means nothing.
Being slow to anger shows deep understanding, but a quick-tempered person is just collecting stupidity.
A healthy mind leads to a healthy body, but out-of-control emotions will rot your bones.
When you take advantage of the powerless, you're insulting your Creator. But when you're kind to the poor, you're honoring God.
The evil that bad people do leaves them out in the cold, but the integrity of good people creates a safe place to live.
Wisdom lives in a heart that understands, but fools don't even get a chance to say hello.
Being devoted to God makes a country strong, but avoiding God leaves people weak.
Hard work gets you praise, but lazy work gets you a chewing out.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk vs. Fake Talk: The Ultimate Guide
paragraphs: A chill response can totally defuse a fight, but a harsh comeback will just make things explode.
Wise people drop gems of knowledge like it's nothing, but fools are just out here leaking nonsense 24/7.
God's got his eyes on everything, no cap. He sees the good, the bad, and everything in between.
Kind words are lowkey healing, but mean words can seriously mess you up.
People who don't care about what's right won't take advice from anyone, but it's a total pro-gamer move to actually listen to correction.
The lives of people who are ride-or-die for God are seriously flourishing. But a life that's all over the place will go broke, fast.
Smart people spread real knowledge with what they say. Fools? They're just empty inside, there's nothing to them.
God can't stand it when people are fake-holy. He's all about those real, from-the-heart prayers.
A wasted life is just gross to God. He loves the ones who are sprinting towards the finish line.
If you wander off God's path, you're signing up for a rough time. And if you hate his rules, you're basically walking into a dead end.
Even the underworld has no secrets from God—you really think he can't read what's in your heart?
Know-it-alls hate being told they're wrong, so they avoid hanging out with anyone who's actually wise.
A happy heart makes your face light up, but a sad heart makes it feel impossible to get through the day.
Smart people are always hungry for more truth. Fools just snack on whatever dumb trend is popular.
A miserable heart means a miserable life. But a cheerful heart? That's a non-stop party.
A simple life where you respect God is way better than being rich and stressed out all the time.
It's better to share a piece of bread with people you love than to have a fancy steak dinner with people you hate.
Hotheads are always starting fights, but someone who's calm and collected keeps the peace.
The path for lazy people is a mess of thorns, but for those who get stuff done, it's a smooth ride.
Smart kids make their parents proud. Lazy ones just embarrass them.
Clueless people treat life like it's a joke. People with insight get what it's about and actually make something of it.
Ignore good advice and watch your plans totally fail. Take good advice and watch them succeed. It's that simple.
A good conversation is such a vibe. And saying the right thing at the right time? That's beautiful.
The life of a thoughtful person is always leveling up—it's a complete 180 from heading down to hell.
God completely wrecks the plans of arrogant people, but he's got the backs of those who have nothing.
God can't stand evil plots, but he loves putting graceful and beautiful words on display.
A greedy person will tear a community apart. But those who refuse to take advantage of others will truly live.
People who are loyal to God give answers that feel like prayers. The wicked just spew garbage.
God keeps his distance from the wicked, but he's listening closely to the prayers of his people.
A sparkle in your eye means your heart is happy, and good news makes you feel on top of the world.
If you want to live a good life, you gotta listen to good advice. That's how you become an honored guest among the wise.
A life with no discipline is a small, weak life. But a life lived for God is huge and full of possibilities.
Respecting God is like a masterclass in how to live. First you learn to be humble, and then you get the glory.

Proverbs.title: God's Plan > Your Plan
paragraphs: You can map out your whole life, but God's the one who gives the final green light.
We might think our motives are pure, but God sees the real deal behind everything we do.
Commit your work to God, and watch your plans actually happen.
God literally made everything for a reason. Even the wicked have a role to play—getting what's coming to them.
God can't stand proud and arrogant people. Seriously, he will take them down a peg or two.
Guilt gets erased by love and truth. And a healthy respect for God is like a shield against doing dumb stuff.
When God is on your side, even your biggest haters will end up wanting to be your friend.
It's way better to be broke and right with God than rich and on the wrong path.
We can dream up the life we want, but it's God who makes it possible to live it out.
A good leader inspires people, doesn't mislead them or use them.
God is all about fairness and honesty in your hustle. Your work is His work.
Real leaders hate seeing things done the wrong way; their leadership is built on doing what's right.
Good leaders want to hear the truth, and they value the people who are real with them.
A leader with no self-control is a walking disaster. It's smart to keep your distance.
But a leader who's kind and steady is like a breath of fresh air, bringing life to everyone.
Wisdom is worth way more than money. Getting insight is better than getting a raise, any day.
The path of a good person avoids all kinds of evil. Watch your step, and you'll save your life.
Pride comes first, then a total crash. The bigger your ego, the harder you're gonna fall.
It's better to be humble and hang with the poor than to be living it up with the rich and famous.
If you take life seriously and trust God, things will work out for you. It's a fact.
A wise person is known for their insight, and speaking kindly makes you even more respected.
Real wisdom is like a fresh spring of water. Fools? They're just making things harder for themselves.
Wise people make so much sense. Every time they talk, their reputation gets a boost.
Kind words are like honey—sweet to the soul and good for your body.
There's a way of life that seems totally fine, but if you look closer, it's a dead-end street leading to destruction.
Your own appetite pushes you to work. Being hungry makes you grind even harder.
Mean people love to spread nasty gossip. Their words sting and burn.
Troublemakers are always starting fights, and gossip can wreck the best of friendships.
Shady people who are trying to get ahead will even turn on their own friends. They're ruthless.
A person with shifty eyes is plotting something bad. A clenched jaw? That's a sign that trouble is coming.
Gray hair is a crown of glory, an award you get for living a life loyal to God.
Having self-control is better than being the strongest person in the room. It's more powerful than any political influence.
You can cast your vote and make your moves, but God has the final say in everything.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk on How to Win at Life
paragraphs: Honestly, a simple meal in peace is way better than a fancy feast full of drama.
A smart assistant who can handle a wild kid gets treated like one of the family.
Just like fire purifies silver and gold, God uses tough situations to shape us.
Shady people live for toxic gossip, and liars are always listening for the tea.
Making fun of people who are struggling is a direct insult to God. And if you're happy when others fail, that's some bad karma coming your way.
Grandparents are proud of their grandkids, and kids should be proud of their parents.
You don't expect a fool to drop wisdom, and you definitely shouldn't expect leaders to be dishonest.
A gift is like a rare gem; it's awesome from any angle.
Letting go of a grudge strengthens a friendship. But if you obsess over a small thing, you'll lose a friend. It's that simple.
A quiet word of advice to a sensible person works way better than yelling at a fool.
People who are just looking for trouble will find it. Guaranteed.
It's literally safer to face a mama bear who's lost her cubs than a fool who's committed to their foolishness.
If you repay good with evil, expect that evil to come right back at you.
Starting a fight is like a small leak in a dam. You need to stop it before everything explodes.
God really hates it when people make villains look like heroes and heroes look like villains.
Seriously? A fool trying to buy wisdom? They wouldn't even know it if they saw it.
Real friends stick with you through everything, and family has your back in tough times.
It's just dumb to think you can get something for nothing, or to get into debt you can't handle.
Someone who loves causing trouble is basically asking for it. Building a huge wall is like sending an invitation to a burglar.
If your motives are bad, you're not going to get a good result. And if you're always talking out of both sides of your mouth, you're just asking for double the trouble.
Having a foolish kid is a total nightmare. It's zero fun being the parent of an idiot.
A positive attitude is actually good for your health. Being gloomy all the time will just leave you exhausted.
Corrupt people take bribes secretly and have zero respect for justice.
Smart people find wisdom right in front of them. Fools are always looking for it everywhere else.
A disrespectful, dumb kid is a huge headache for a father and a major disappointment for a mother.
It's just wrong to punish people for doing the right thing, or to blame good people for what criminals do.
Someone who's truly wise doesn't talk a lot. An understanding person stays chill.
Even a fool can seem wise if they just keep their mouth shut. As long as they're quiet, people might think they're smart.

Proverbs.title: Words Have Power, Choose Wisely
paragraphs: People who isolate themselves and only look out for number one are basically dissing everyone else trying to work together.
Fools aren't interested in actually understanding things; they just want to show off and hear themselves talk.
When bad stuff happens, shame is right there with it. And thinking life is worthless? That's a worthless thought itself.
A person's words can be like a rushing river, but real wisdom is like a deep, fresh spring bubbling up.
It's messed up to let guilty people off the hook or to be extra hard on those who are innocent.
The words of a fool are just asking for a fight. Seriously, someone should just put a filter on them.
Fools get wrecked by their own big mouths; their words literally crush their spirit.
Listening to gossip is like binging on junk food. Do you really want to fill your head with that kind of trash?
Being lazy and doing a sloppy job is just as bad as straight-up trashing the place.
God's name is like a fortress. Good people can run to it and be totally safe.
The rich think their money is a shield, like they're living in a high-security mansion. They're just imagining it, though.
Pride comes right before you totally wipe out, but being humble is what leads to getting respect.
Trying to answer before you've even listened is just dumb and super rude.
A strong spirit can get you through tough times, but if your spirit is broken, what can you even do?
Smart people are always learning, always keeping their ears open for new insights.
A gift can really get you noticed; it can even get you a meeting with important people.
The first person to speak in an argument always sounds right—until the other person starts asking questions.
Sometimes when you have a super tough choice to make, the only way to decide is to basically flip a coin.
Do someone a solid and you'll have a friend for life. That's a bond you can't break.
Good words are as satisfying to your mind as good food is to your stomach. A great conversation feels as good as a great meal.
Words have the power to kill or to give life. They can be poison or they can be fruit—it's your choice.
If you find a great partner, you've found a great life—and even better, you've got God's approval.
People without much money ask for things politely, but the rich just bark out their answers.
Friends can come and go, but a real one, a true friend, sticks with you like family.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk: How NOT to Mess Up Your Life
paragraphs: It's way better to be poor and keep it real than to be a rich person nobody can trust.
Being super eager without knowing what you're doing is just pointless. If you rush, you'll mess up.
People wreck their own lives with their dumb decisions, but then they turn around and blame God for it. Like, what?
Having a lot of money is like a magnet for friends, but if you're poor, people avoid you like you've got the flu.
Lying under oath will not go unpunished. You wouldn't just let a liar walk free, would you?
Everyone wants to be around someone who's generous; they all want to be friends with the person who gives stuff away.

When you've got bad luck, even your own family ghosts you. Yeah, even your best friends act like they don't know you. If they see you coming, they'll literally cross the street to avoid you. Out of sight, out of mind, for real.
If you get smart, you're doing yourself a huge favor. Keep a level head, and you'll end up with a good life.
Anyone who tells lies will get caught, and anyone who spreads rumors is totally screwed.
Fools shouldn't be living in luxury, just like it's not right for employees to be bossing around their managers.
Smart people know when to keep their mouths shut. The coolest thing you can do is forgive and forget.
Leaders with a bad temper are like angry dogs, but the good-natured ones are like a refreshing morning.
A kid who doesn't care about their responsibilities will drive their parents crazy. A nagging spouse is as annoying as a dripping faucet that never stops.
You can inherit a house and land from your parents, but a spouse who's actually cool to be around? That's a gift straight from God.
If you're lazy, your life is gonna fall apart. Lazy people end up with nothing to eat.
Follow the rules and you'll keep your life. Living carelessly will get you killed.
Being kind to the poor is like giving a loan to God, and trust me, God pays back his debts with interest.
Discipline your kids while you still can. If you just let them do whatever they want, you're basically ruining them.
Let angry people deal with the consequences of their own anger. If you try to step in and fix it, you'll probably just make things worse.
Listen to good advice and be open to correction—that's how you get wise and live a good life.
We're always coming up with new ideas and plans, but at the end of the day, it's God's plan that actually happens.
It's normal to want to make money, but it's better to be poor than to be a liar.
The fear of God is life itself. It's a full and peaceful life, with no bad surprises.
Some people are so lazy they'll stick a fork in their food but won't even bother to lift it to their mouth.
Punish the people who are rude and disrespectful—make an example out of them. Who knows? Maybe someone will actually learn something from it.
Kids who are mean to their parents are a total embarrassment and a disgrace.
If you stop listening, my friend, and just go off and do your own thing, you'll be in over your head before you know it.
A witness with no morals makes a joke out of justice. The words of the wicked are full of evil.
People who don't show respect will have to learn it the hard way. Sometimes, the only thing that gets a fool's attention is a slap in the face.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk on How to Not Mess Up Your Life
paragraphs: Wine makes you act up, and beer makes you wanna fight—being a sloppy drunk isn't a good look, for real.
A leader with a short fuse is like a growling dog—get on their bad side, and they'll snap at you.
It's a sign of a real one to dodge drama, but fools are always looking for a fight.
A farmer who's too lazy to plant in the spring is gonna have an empty pantry in the fall. Duh.
Figuring out what's right is like tapping into a deep well inside you; a wise person knows how to draw from it.
Everyone's out here claiming to be super loyal and loving, but like, where are they actually at?
People who are tight with God and live honest lives make things way easier for their kids down the line.
A good leader who knows what's up keeps an eye out for anything sketchy or fake. 'Cause let's be real, who can you trust to be 100% on it all the time?
Fudging the numbers on a price tag or your expense report? Yeah, God's not a fan of that. At all.
Eventually, you can tell what a young person is really about by what they do, not just what they say. Actions speak louder, you know?
Ears that hear and eyes that see—we got our basic gear from God himself!
Don't get too cozy with your bed, or you'll end up broke. Get up and get going, and you'll have food to eat.
The shopper's like, "This is trash, I'll do you a favor and take it," then walks off bragging about the steal they got.
Sipping from the cup of knowledge is way better than dripping in gold and jewels. Lowkey, it's the ultimate flex.
If you're loaning money to a stranger, you better get some collateral. And be super careful about taking something a random person has pawned.
Bread you stole might taste sweet for a minute, but you'll end up with a mouth full of dirt. Not worth it.
Figure out your goals by asking for advice, then go for it with all the help you can get.
Gossips can't keep their mouths shut, so don't spill your secrets to someone who's known for running their mouth.
If you curse out your own parents, your light's gonna go out, and you'll be left in the dark. That's heavy.
A huge win at the start doesn't mean you're guaranteed a happy ending.
Don't ever be like, "I'm gonna get you back for that!" Just wait on God; He'll handle it.
God seriously hates it when people cheat in business; messing with the scales is just messed up.
Every step we take is guided by God; otherwise, how would we even know where we're going? It's wild when you think about it.
Making a promise without thinking it through is a total trap; you'll be wishing you could take it back later.
A wise leader checks things out carefully and then gets rid of all the haters and fools.
God's in charge of our lives, watching and checking out everything, inside and out. No cap.
Love and truth make a leader legit; solid leadership is built on a foundation of loving with integrity.
Being young and strong is cool and all, but having gray hair gives you a different kind of respect when you're older.
A good butt-kicking can get rid of the bad vibes; sometimes a tough lesson is what you need to really learn.

Proverbs.title: Life Hacks from the GOAT
paragraphs: A good leader is like a stream of water that God controls. He can literally point it wherever He wants it to go.
We try to make ourselves look good on the outside, but God’s checking out what’s really going on in our hearts.
Actually living a good life and being fair to people is way more important to God than just going to church and pretending to be holy.
Being arrogant and full of yourself? That’s a major red flag. It’s basically the signature move of wicked people, and yeah, it’s a sin.
If you actually plan things out, you’ll get ahead. But if you’re always rushing and scrambling, you’ll just fall further behind. Lowkey, it's about working smart, not just hard.
So you lied and cheated your way to the top? Congrats, I guess. Your reward is a whole lot of nothing and a one-way ticket to your own downfall. Wild.
Wicked people are literally drowning in their own stuff because they’re too selfish to share it with anyone who needs it.
When you have mixed motives, your life gets messy and complicated. But when your intentions are pure, you’re on a straight path.
Honestly, it's better to live by yourself in a tiny, busted apartment than in a huge mansion with a spouse who’s always nagging you.
Some people just love starting drama. They have zero empathy for their friends or anyone else around them.
Fools have to mess up and learn the hard way. Wise people? They just listen and learn from others.
Someone who’s loyal to God can see right through a wicked person’s schemes and totally ruin their evil plans.
If you ignore the cries of the poor, don’t be surprised when no one listens to you when you’re in trouble.
A secret gift can calm someone down who’s super irritable. A thoughtful present can cool off a heated argument.
Good people are stoked when justice is served, but for people who do evil, it’s a terrible day.
If you wander off the right path, you’ll end up hanging out with a bunch of ghosts. No cap.
You're addicted to thrills? Your life is probably pretty empty. Chasing pleasure will never satisfy you.
When a bad person plots against a good person, it always backfires. The plotter gets what’s coming to them in the end.
It’s better to live in a tent in the middle of nowhere than with a spouse who’s always angry and complaining.
Wise people have valuable things stored away safely in their homes. Fools put everything they own out on the front lawn for a yard sale.
If you go looking for what’s right and kind, you’ll find life itself—a glorious life!
One wise person can take down a whole city of armed soldiers. Their defenses, that they trusted so much, will just crumble.
Watch what you say and hold your tongue. You’ll save yourself a ton of drama.
You know the type—cocky, disrespectful, and always running their mouth. They’re just a bunch of hotheads with no self-control.
Lazy people eventually die of hunger because they refuse to get up and do any work.
Sinners are always wanting what they don’t have. But people who are loyal to God are always giving away what they do have.
The religious stuff that wicked people do is disgusting to God. It’s even worse when they do it just to get ahead.
A liar’s testimony is never convincing. But someone who speaks the truth is always respected.
Shady people are always faking it. But honest people are confident in every step they take.
No matter how clever, smart, or sneaky you are, you can’t outsmart God.
Do your best, be prepared for the worst, and then trust God to bring the victory.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk: How to Win at Life
paragraphs: A good rep is way better than being loaded; being a chill person is better than having a fat bank account.
The rich and the poor are basically the same—God made 'em both!
A smart person sees trouble coming and dodges it; a clueless person just walks right into it and gets wrecked.
If you're humble and respect God, you'll get blessings, respect, and a life that's actually satisfying.
Shady people walk a sketchy path, full of potholes and mud; if you know what's good for you, you'll stay far away from it.
Get your kids on the right track, and when they're older, they won't get lost.
The poor are always getting bossed around by the rich, so don't go into debt and let them own you.
If you plant sin, you'll harvest a bunch of weeds, and your bully-like anger will just fizzle out.
Generous people are blessed because they share their food with the poor.
Kick out the drama-starters and things will chill out; you need a break from all the arguing and complaining!
God loves people who are real and speak from the heart; good leaders want to be friends with them too.
God is super passionate about protecting knowledge, but He's not about that fake life.
The lazy person says, “There’s a lion outside! If I go out, I'll get eaten!”
The words of a shady person are like a black hole; you'll fall right in if you're not on good terms with God.
Young people are into some dumb stuff and trends; the only way to fix it is with some tough love and discipline.
If you take advantage of the poor or suck up to the rich—either way, you'll end up broke.

Listen up to my wisdom; for real, take to heart what I'm about to teach you. You'll love how real it is deep down; you'll be able to talk about it with confidence. To make sure you're trusting in God, I'm laying it all out for you right now. I'm giving you thirty solid principles—rules to live by that have been tested. Trust me—this is the real deal, and it'll keep you straight with the people who sent you.
Don't step on the poor just because they're poor, and don't use your power to crush the weak, because God will have their back; the life you took, He'll take from you and give back to them.
Don't hang out with angry people; don't chill with hotheads. A bad temper is contagious—don't get infected.
Don't bet on some fantasy, risking your house on a long shot. The time will come when you have to pay up, and you'll be left with nothing but the clothes on your back.
Don't secretly move the property lines that your ancestors set up a long time ago.
Check out people who are good at what they do—skilled people are always in demand and respected; they don't have to take a backseat to anyone.

Proverbs.title: King Solomon's Guide to Not Messing Up
paragraphs: When you get a dinner invite from someone important, use your manners. Don't just wolf down your food or talk with your mouth full. And for real, control your appetite; don't stuff yourself.
Don't burn yourself out just trying to get rich; learn to chill. Money can honestly disappear in a second. It's like it grows wings and just flies away.

Don't take food from a cheapskate; don't expect them to be generous. They're as stingy with you as they are with themselves. They'll say, 'Go on, eat! Drink!' but they totally don't mean it. The tiny portion will make you sick when you realize the whole thing was just for show.
Don't waste your breath trying to explain things to fools; they'll just make fun of your wise words.
Don't secretly move property lines or scam orphans out of their land. They have a super powerful Defender who will totally have their back.
Get serious about learning and listen up to advice that's been tested and proven true.
Don't be scared to discipline your kids; a spanking isn't going to kill them. Actually, a good spanking might save them from something way worse than death.
My kid, if you grow up to be wise, I'll be so incredibly happy. My heart will literally be dancing and singing when you speak the truth.
Don't even for a second be jealous of people who don't care about God. Instead, be all about respecting God 24/7. That's where your real future is. Then you won't end up with nothing.

Hey, listen up, my kid—get wise and get your life pointed in the right direction. Don't get wasted on too much wine or get fat from eating too much. Drunks and gluttons end up broke, sleeping their lives away in old, ragged clothes.

Listen respectfully to your dad who raised you, and don't ignore your mom when she gets old. Buy the truth—don't ever sell it. Buy wisdom, education, and insight. Parents are so happy when their kids turn out well; wise kids make their parents proud. So make your dad happy! Make your mom proud!
My kid, I need your full attention. Please, just do what I'm showing you.
A prostitute is like a bottomless pit; a woman who sleeps around can get you into deep trouble, fast. She'll take everything you have; she's worse than a whole gang of thieves.

Who's always down and depressed? Who's always full of self-pity? Who's always getting into fights for no reason? Whose eyes are all red and blurry? It's the people who stay up all night drinking, who take their drinking way too seriously. Don't just look at how fancy the wine is. Judge it by the hangover it gives you—the killer headache, the sick stomach. You really want to be seeing double and slurring your words, stumbling around like a drunk sailor? You'll be like, 'They hit me, but I didn't feel it. They beat me up, but whatever.' And then you'll say, 'As soon as I can think straight, get me another drink!'

Proverbs.title: Life Hacks from the Wisest Dude Ever
paragraphs: Don't be jealous of bad people or even want to hang out with them. All they think about is stirring up drama and making trouble.
Building a life is like building a house: you need wisdom to build it, understanding to make it strong, and knowledge to fill it with awesome things.
Being smart is way better than being strong; brains beat brawn any day. To win at life, you need a solid game plan and a squad of wise advisors.
Deep talks are totally lost on fools; they're clueless when the conversation gets real.
The person who's always scheming something shady gets a reputation as a major troublemaker. Fools are basically sin-making machines, and cynics just ruin beautiful things.
