If you fall apart when things get tough, you weren't that strong to begin with.
Help people who are in trouble; don't just stand by. If you say, 'Not my problem,' do you really think that's a good excuse? God is watching, and He's not impressed by your weak excuses.
Just like honey is good for you, knowledge and wisdom are good for your soul. Get them, and your future is secure, your hope is solid.

Don't mess with good people's lives or try to one-up them. No matter how many times they get knocked down, people who are loyal to God get back up. The wicked, on the other hand, end up face-planting.
Don't laugh when your enemy fails; don't get hyped about their downfall. God might see it, get annoyed, and decide to help them instead.
Don't waste your time on show-offs or wish you had what the wicked have. They have no future; they're on a one-way street to nowhere.
Respect God and your leaders; don't be a rebel. Your life can get turned upside down without any warning, and you won't see it coming.
It's just plain wrong to let injustice slide.
Anyone who defends a guilty person will go down in history as a bad guy, but whoever calls out the wicked will be thanked and rewarded.
An honest answer is as comforting as a warm hug.
Get your work done first, then you can chill.
Don't gossip about your neighbors behind their backs. Seriously, no slander. And don't ever say, 'I'm gonna get you back for what you did to me.'

I saw a lazy person's field and a slob's vineyard the other day. They were totally overgrown with weeds and the fences were all broken. It made me think, and I learned a lesson: a little nap here, a little break there, and before you know it, you're broke and poverty is your new roommate.

Proverbs.title: Solomon's Life Hacks, Pt. 2
paragraphs: Yo, here are some more wise words from Solomon, written down by King Hezekiah's crew.
God loves hiding little secrets in the world, and scientists get a kick out of finding them. It's like a huge game of hide-and-seek.
A legit leader's understanding is crazy wide and deep, like the sky or the ocean. They just get it.
You gotta get the gunk out of silver to make something beautiful. Same with leaders - get rid of the shady people, and you'll have a government you can actually trust, one that makes God look good.
Don't be that person trying way too hard to be the center of attention. It's way better to be invited to the VIP section than to get kicked out for trying to sneak in.
Don't just assume the worst. There's probably a good reason for what you saw, so chill for a sec.
If you're in a heated argument, don't go spilling secrets. That tea will get everywhere, and then no one will ever trust you again.
Saying the right thing at the right time is like a perfectly chosen accessory. And when a wise friend calls you out, it's like they're giving you a sick piece of gold jewelry.
Friends who actually do what they say they'll do are as refreshing as an ice-cold drink on a blazing hot day. No cap.
Someone who talks a big game but never delivers is like a sky full of storm clouds that never actually rains. Just a whole lot of noise.
If you're patient and don't give up, you can get through to anyone. A gentle word can break down the toughest walls.
When someone gives you a whole box of chocolates, don't eat it all at once or you'll get sick. Same with friends - don't overdo it and hang out 24/7, or they'll get tired of you real quick.
Anyone who spreads lies about their friends is basically a walking disaster waiting to happen.
Trusting someone who's known for backstabbing is like chewing on a tooth that's already killing you. It's just asking for more pain.
Trying to cheer someone up with happy songs when they're feeling down is like pouring salt on a wound. Just... don't.
If you see your enemy is hungry, buy them some food. If they're thirsty, get them a drink. Your kindness will totally throw them off, and God will have your back.
A cold north wind means a storm is coming, and a gossipy person means you're about to see some angry faces.
It's honestly better to live by yourself in a tiny, busted apartment than in a mansion with someone who never stops complaining.
Getting a message from a friend you haven't heard from in forever is as refreshing as a cold drink when you're totally exhausted.
A good person who lets a bad person walk all over them is like a clean spring that's been turned to mud.
It's not a good look to eat candy all day, and it's not good for you to constantly be chasing praise and glory.
Someone with no self-control is like a house that's been completely wrecked, with no doors or windows to protect it.

Proverbs.title: Spitting Facts About Fools & Lazy People
paragraphs: Giving props to a fool is as pointless as wishing for a snow day in July or for rain when it's time to harvest.
You shouldn't be scared of a curse you don't deserve, any more than you'd be scared of a little bird flying by.
Horses need a whip, sailboats need a rudder, and fools, well, they need a good old-fashioned reality check.
Don't even try to argue with a fool's nonsense; you'll just end up looking like a fool, too.
But when you do have to answer a fool, keep it simple so they don't get a big head and think they're smart.
Trusting a fool to deliver a message is like asking for trouble. Seriously, just don't.
A proverb coming from a fool is as useless as a wet noodle.
Giving a fool a position of honor is like trying to build a marble pillar on a foundation of mud bricks. It's just not gonna work.
Asking a moron to drop some wisdom is like handing a drunk person a scalpel. It's a disaster waiting to happen.
Hiring a fool or a drunk is basically shooting yourself in the foot.
Just like a dog goes back to its own vomit (gross, I know), a fool just keeps repeating their same old dumb mistakes.
You see that person who thinks they're the smartest one in the room? A fool has more potential than them, no cap.
Lazy people will make up any excuse to not do anything, like, "I can't go outside, there are tigers in the streets!" and then just roll back over in bed.
Just like a door just swings back and forth on its hinges, a lazy person just turns over and over in their bed.
A lazy person might get as far as putting their fork in the food, but they're too lazy to actually lift it to their mouth.
These dreamers think they're so important and smarter than everyone else, even a whole university faculty.
Jumping into a fight that has nothing to do with you is as dumb as grabbing a mad dog by the ears.
People who mess up on purpose and then say, "Just kidding, I didn't mean it!" are worse than someone who starts a forest fire and just walks away.
When you run out of wood, the fire dies. When the gossip stops, the drama ends.
A person who loves to argue is like throwing gasoline on a fire.
Listening to gossip is like eating junk food. Do you really want that garbage in your system?
Smooth talk from someone with a bad heart is like a pretty glaze on a cracked, useless pot.

Your enemy might act like your best friend, shaking your hand and being all nice, but they're just plotting against you. Don't fall for their sweet talk; they're just waiting for the right moment to backstab you. No matter how well they hide their true colors, eventually, everyone will see them for who they really are.
What goes around comes around. Malice will come back to bite you, and spite is a boomerang.
Liars hate the people they lie to, and people who flatter you are just trying to mess up your trust.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk on Friends, Haters, and Getting Your Life Together
paragraphs: Don't go bragging about your plans for tomorrow; you literally have no idea what's gonna happen.
Let other people hype you up; don't be the one tooting your own horn.
Let other people hype you up; don't be the one tooting your own horn.
Trying to carry a giant log on your shoulders while lifting a massive rock is nothing, and I mean NOTHING, compared to how draining it is to deal with a fool.
Trying to carry a giant log on your shoulders while lifting a massive rock is nothing, and I mean NOTHING, compared to how draining it is to deal with a fool.
Anger is a beast, and rage is a flood, but for real, who can even handle jealousy?
Anger is a beast, and rage is a flood, but for real, who can even handle jealousy?
Getting called out to your face is way better than getting fake love that's never actually real.
Getting called out to your face is way better than getting fake love that's never actually real.
The tough love from a real one is worth it; the kisses from an enemy will mess you up, no cap.
The tough love from a real one is worth it; the kisses from an enemy will mess you up, no cap.
When you're full, you'll even turn down dessert. But when you're starving, you'd eat anything.
When you're full, you'll even turn down dessert. But when you're starving, you'd eat anything.
People who can't stay put and are always bouncing around are like birds that can't find a nest.
People who can't stay put and are always bouncing around are like birds that can't find a nest.
Just like lotion and a good scent make you feel good, a real friendship is super refreshing for your soul.
Just like lotion and a good scent make you feel good, a real friendship is super refreshing for your soul.
Don't ditch your friends or your parents' friends and run back to your family whenever things get hard. A friend who's close by is way better than family that's far away.
Don't ditch your friends or your parents' friends and run back to your family whenever things get hard. A friend who's close by is way better than family that's far away.
Get smart, my dude, and make me proud. Then I won't be stressing about anything the world throws at me.
Get smart, my dude, and make me proud. Then I won't be stressing about anything the world throws at me.
A smart person sees trouble coming and avoids it. A clueless person just walks right into it and gets wrecked.
A smart person sees trouble coming and avoids it. A clueless person just walks right into it and gets wrecked.
If you're loaning money to a stranger, make sure you get something as a guarantee. Be super careful about taking something from someone who's just passing through.
If you're loaning money to a stranger, make sure you get something as a guarantee. Be super careful about taking something from someone who's just passing through.
If you wake up your friend super early by yelling 'RISE AND SHINE!', it's gonna sound more like a curse than a friendly wake-up call.
If you wake up your friend super early by yelling 'RISE AND SHINE!', it's gonna sound more like a curse than a friendly wake-up call.
A nagging partner is like a leaky faucet that just won't stop dripping. You can't turn it off, and you can't escape it.
A nagging partner is like a leaky faucet that just won't stop dripping. You can't turn it off, and you can't escape it.
You use iron to sharpen iron, and in the same way, one friend sharpens another.
If you take care of your apple trees, you'll get to eat the apples. If you respect your boss, you'll get respect back.
If you take care of your apple trees, you'll get to eat the apples. If you respect your boss, you'll get respect back.
Just like water shows you your own face, your face shows what's in your heart.
Just like water shows you your own face, your face shows what's in your heart.
Hell is never satisfied, and lust is the same way, it just never stops.
Hell is never satisfied, and lust is the same way, it just never stops.
You test how pure silver and gold are by putting them in fire. You test people's hearts by giving them a little bit of fame.
You test how pure silver and gold are by putting them in fire. You test people's hearts by giving them a little bit of fame.
You can try to beat the foolishness out of a fool, but it's never gonna work.
You can try to beat the foolishness out of a fool, but it's never gonna work.

Know every single one of your sheep by name; take really good care of your flock. Don't just assume they'll always be there, 'cause nothing lasts forever, you know? And then, when you've harvested all the crops and stored them away, you can make sweaters from the lamb's wool and sell your goats for some cash. You'll have plenty of milk and meat to get your family through the winter.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk on Living Right vs. Getting Wrecked
paragraphs: Bad people are always paranoid, ready to bolt even when no one is chasing them. But good people are chill and confident, bold like lions.
When the country is a mess, everyone acts like they have the answers. But it takes a truly smart leader to actually fix things.
When a bad person with power picks on the poor, it's like a hailstorm that destroys all the crops. Total disaster.
If you ignore God's rules, you're basically saying yes to all kinds of messed-up stuff. But if you love God's rules, you'll fight to protect them.
Evil people just don't get what's right. But those who look for God understand it completely.
It's way better to be poor and honest than to be rich and a liar.
If you follow God's law, you'll get a reputation for being wise. But if you hang out with a wild crowd, you're just going to embarrass your parents.
If you get rich by cheating people, eventually someone who is a friend to the poor will come and give it all back to them.
If you refuse to listen to God, He's not going to listen to your prayers either.
If you lead good people down the wrong path, you're going to end up in a bad place. But if you do good things, you'll get rewarded for it.
Rich people think they're so smart, but a poor person with discernment can see right through their act.
When good people get promoted, it's a party for everyone. But when bad people are in charge, everyone hides.
You can't just hide your mistakes and expect to get away with it. You find forgiveness by owning up to them and quitting them.
A person with a soft heart is blessed, but a person with a hard heart is headed for a hard life.
A wicked ruler oppressing the poor is as scary as a roaring lion or a charging bear.
A leader who is clueless is also super abusive. But a leader who hates corruption has a bright future ahead.
A murderer who is haunted by guilt is basically doomed. You can't help them.
Live an honest life and you'll be safe and sound. But a crooked life will lead to ruin.
Work hard in your own field, and you'll have plenty of food. But if you just party all the time, you'll end up with nothing.
Hard work and consistency totally pay off. But those get-rich-quick schemes are just scams.
Playing favorites is never a good look. You can cause a lot of damage in ways that seem small.
A stingy person who's trying to get rich quick has no idea they're about to be broke.
In the long run, people appreciate it more when you call them out on their stuff than when you just flatter them all the time.
Anyone who robs their parents and says, 'What's the big deal?' is worse than a gangster.
A greedy person just starts drama, but trusting in God brings peace.
If you think you know everything, you're a fool. Real survivors learn from others.
Be generous to the poor and you'll never be in need. But if you ignore them, you'll get a ton of hate.
When bad people take over, good people go into hiding. But when the crooks get kicked out, it's safe for everyone to come out again.

Proverbs.title: Real Talk: How to Not Wreck Your Life
paragraphs: If you're one of those people who just hates being corrected and gets even more stubborn, a day's gonna come when your life just falls apart, and it'll be too late for anyone to help.
When good people are in charge, everyone's stoked, but when a bad leader is running things, everyone's miserable.
If you love being wise, you make your parents proud. But if you're hanging out with the wrong crowd, you're just gonna break their trust.
A leader with good judgment makes everything stable and secure; a leader who just uses people leaves a trail of destruction.
That neighbor who's always complimenting you is probably up to no good; they're likely just setting you up to take advantage of you.
Bad people get caught in their own traps, while good people see it coming, dodge it, and are glad they got away.
The righteous person actually gets what it's like to be poor; a heartless person has absolutely no clue.
A crew of cynics can bring down a whole city, but a group of wise people can chill everyone out.
When a wise person tries to argue with a fool, they just get laughed at and hit with sarcasm. It's a total waste of time.
Violent people hate honest folks, but moral people have their backs.
A fool just blurts out everything they're feeling, but a wise person thinks it over quietly first.
When a leader pays attention to toxic gossip, all their staff get infected with that same bad energy.
The poor person and the person who oppresses them have one thing in common: God gave them both the gift of sight.
When a leader makes sure to treat the poor and voiceless fairly, their authority gets stronger and they earn mad respect.
A little discipline teaches you wisdom; a spoiled kid just ends up embarrassing their parents.
When messed-up people are in charge, crime goes way up, but the good guys will get to see them fall in the end.
Discipline your kids, and you'll be so glad you did—they'll grow up to be awesome people to be around.
If people can't see what God's up to, they just end up tripping over themselves. But if you pay attention to what He shows you, you're seriously blessed.
It takes more than just words to get workers to listen; they'll just go in one ear and out the other.
Peep those people who always talk before they think—even a total idiot is better off than them.
If you let people walk all over you, you'll eventually just be forgotten.
Angry people stir up drama, and hot-headed people cause all sorts of trouble.
Pride will make you fall flat on your face, but being humble sets you up for honor.
If you team up with a criminal, you're basically turning on yourself. When things go down and people are crying for justice, you'll get cursed out too if you're too scared to speak up.
Being scared of what other people think will totally paralyze you. But trusting in God is the ultimate protection from that.
Everyone's trying to get on the leader's good side, but real justice only comes from God.
Good people can't stand to see deliberate evil; and wicked people can't stand to see genuine goodness.

Proverbs.title: 30 Things That Are Actually Mind-Blowing
paragraphs: The skeptic was like, "There's no God! No God! I can do whatever I want! I'm more animal than human; so-called human intelligence is beyond me.

"I totally failed 'wisdom.' I see no evidence of a holy God. Has anyone ever, like, climbed into Heaven and taken charge? Or grabbed the winds and controlled them? Or gathered the rains in a bucket? Or marked out the ends of the earth? Just tell me his name, and his sons' names. Come on, tell me!"
The believer replied, "Every promise of God is legit; he protects everyone who runs to him for help. So don't try to correct him; he might call you out and expose your lies."

And then he prayed, "God, I'm asking for two things before I die; please don't say no—Keep lies from my lips and liars out of my life. Give me just enough food to live on, not too much and not too little. If I'm too full, I might get arrogant and say, 'God? Who needs him?' If I'm poor, I might steal and bring shame to the name of my God."
Don't go tattling on your coworkers behind their backs; they'll accuse you of being sneaky, and then you'll be the one who looks guilty.
Don't curse your father or forget to bless your mother.
Don't think you're looking sharp when you haven't showered in weeks.
Don't be stuck-up and think you're better than everyone else.
Don't be greedy and cruel like a wolf, tearing into the poor and feasting on them, shredding the needy to pieces and leaving them for nothing.
A freeloader has twin daughters named "Gimme" and "Gimme more."
There are three things that are never satisfied, actually four that never say, "That's enough, thank you!"—
Hell, a barren womb, a parched land, and a forest fire.
An eye that disrespects a father and despises a mother—that eye will be plucked out by wild vultures and eaten by young eagles.
Three things blow my mind, no, four things I'll never get—
how an eagle soars in the sky, how a snake slithers over a rock, how a ship sails the ocean, and why teenagers act the way they do.
Here's how a prostitute works: she has sex with her client, takes a bath, and then asks, "Who's next?"
Three things are too much for even the earth to handle, yeah, four things that shake its foundations—
when a janitor becomes the CEO, when a fool gets rich, when a prostitute is voted "woman of the year," and when a "side chick" replaces a faithful wife.
There are four small creatures that are the wisest of the wise—

ants—they're weak, but they stock up plenty of food for the winter; marmots—they're vulnerable, but they build their homes in solid rock; locusts—they have no leader, but they swarm over a field like an army; lizards—they're easy to catch, but they can sneak into a king's palace.
There are three who walk with dignity, four that are impressive to watch—
a lion, the king of beasts, who bows to no one; a proud, strutting rooster; a billy goat; and a king leading a royal procession.
If you're dumb enough to show off by offending people and being rude, don't be shocked when someone punches you in the face. Just like churning milk makes butter, stirring up anger leads to a fight.

Proverbs.title: Mom's Guide to Being a King & Finding a Queen
paragraphs: The advice King Lemuel got from his mom—some serious wisdom bombs:
"Listen up, my son, the one I prayed for! What are you even doing? Don't waste your potential on girls who are only after status, the kind that ruin leaders.
"Listen up, my son, the one I prayed for! What are you even doing? Don't waste your potential on girls who are only after status, the kind that ruin leaders.

"Leaders can't be out here making fools of themselves, getting wasted on wine and beer. If they're hungover, they can't tell right from wrong, and that ends up hurting the people who rely on them. Alcohol should be for people who are in serious pain, like a sedative for those who are suffering and feel like they're already dying.

"Leaders can't be out here making fools of themselves, getting wasted on wine and beer. If they're hungover, they can't tell right from wrong, and that ends up hurting the people who rely on them. Alcohol should be for people who are in serious pain, like a sedative for those who are suffering and feel like they're already dying.
"You need to speak up for those who can't speak for themselves, for the rights of all the outcasts. Be a voice for justice! Defend the poor and people who have nothing."
"You need to speak up for those who can't speak for themselves, for the rights of all the outcasts. Be a voice for justice! Defend the poor and people who have nothing."

Finding a truly good woman is rare, and she's worth way more than diamonds. Her husband trusts her 100%, and he never regrets it. She's never petty and always treats him with kindness, her whole life. She's a savvy shopper, finding the best materials, and she actually enjoys making things. She's like a cool merchant ship, bringing back unique and amazing things from far away. She's up before the sun, making breakfast for her family and getting her day organized. She'll check out a piece of land and buy it, then use her own savings to plant a garden. First thing in the morning, she's dressed and ready for work, rolling up her sleeves and excited to get going. She knows her work has value, so she's not in a rush to clock out. She's a pro at all the home-related skills, a master of homemaking. She's always ready to help someone in need and reaches out to the poor. She doesn't stress when it snows because her family's winter clothes are all patched up and ready. She makes her own clothes, and they're not just functional—she wears stylish, colorful outfits. Her husband is a big deal, a respected leader in the community. She even has a side hustle, designing and selling clothes and sweaters to local shops. Her style is classic and well-made, and she's optimistic about the future. When she talks, she has something smart to say, and she says it with kindness. She keeps a close eye on her household, making sure everyone is being productive. Her kids look up to her and praise her, and her husband brags about her, saying, "A lot of women do amazing things, but you're on a whole other level!" Charm can be fake, and beauty doesn't last. The woman who truly deserves praise is the one who respects God. Give her the credit she deserves! Let her life be filled with praise.

Ecclesiastes.title: Is Life Basically Pointless? Solomon's Hot Take
paragraphs: Yo, so these are the thoughts of the 'Quester,' who was King David's son and the king in Jerusalem.

He basically said, 'Everything is smoke. Just a puff of smoke.' For real, he felt like everything was pointless. Like, what do you even get from all the hard work you put in your whole life? You grind and grind, and for what?

One generation is out, the next one is in, but the world just keeps on spinning. Nothing really changes. The sun comes up, the sun goes down, and then it just does it all over again. The wind blows south, then north, just swirling around and around, doing its thing. All the rivers flow into the ocean, but the ocean never gets full. The water just goes back to where it started and flows again. Honestly, it's all kinda boring. Super repetitive. You can't really find any deep meaning in it. It's boring to watch and boring to listen to. Whatever has happened before is gonna happen again. There's legit nothing new in this world. It's the same old story, year after year. If someone's like, 'Yo, check this new thing out!'—don't even get excited. It's probably been done before. Nobody remembers what happened in the past, and nobody in the future will remember what we're doing now. Don't expect to leave a legacy or whatever.

So yeah, you can call me the Quester. I was the king of Israel in Jerusalem, and I made it my mission to figure everything out. I looked into everything that happens on this planet. And let me tell you, it's not all that great. God made life pretty tough, no cap. I've seen it all, and it's like trying to catch smoke or chase the wind.
Life is like a twisted-up rope you can't straighten out, or a math problem that just doesn't add up.

I told myself, 'Look, I'm smarter and wiser than any king who was in Jerusalem before me. I've got all this wisdom and knowledge.' But in the end, I realized that even chasing wisdom and knowledge is just as pointless. It's all just chasing the wind.
The more you know, the more problems you have. The more you understand, the more it hurts.

Ecclesiastes.title: My Epic Search for Meaning (and Fun)
paragraphs: I was like, "Alright, let's just go all out and have some fun. Let's see what pleasure is all about." But honestly, it was all for nothing. Just a bunch of smoke.

My take on the whole "fun" lifestyle? It's pretty crazy and pointless. And trying to be happy all the time? Who even needs that? I tried to figure out how absurd life is with some wine and all the brainpower I had. I really wanted to find something useful for us to do in the short time we have on this planet.

And man, I did some epic stuff. I built huge houses, planted vineyards, and designed these awesome gardens and parks with all kinds of fruit trees. I even made pools to water all the trees. I bought a bunch of slaves, and they had kids, so I got even more slaves. I had more cows and sheep than anyone in Jerusalem before me. I stacked up so much silver and gold, stuff I got from kings and kingdoms. I had a whole choir to sing for me, and the best part? A bunch of gorgeous girls.

I was seriously ballin'. I was way more successful than anyone who came before me in Jerusalem. And the crazy thing is, I kept a clear head through it all. I got everything I wanted; I never told myself no. I just went for it, whatever I felt like doing. I squeezed every last drop of fun out of every single thing I did. That was my reward for all my hard work.

But then I took a good, hard look at everything I had done, all the sweat and effort I put in. And you know what I saw? Nothing but smoke. It was like trying to catch the wind. There was no point to any of it. Seriously, nothing.

Then I started thinking about what it means to be smart versus being dumb. I mean, what can you even do after you've been a king? It's a tough act to follow. You just do what you can, and that's it. But I did realize that being smart is better than being dumb, just like light is better than darkness. But in the end, it doesn't even matter. The smart people know where they're going, and the dumb people are just stumbling around in the dark, but they all end up in the same place. We all have the same fate.

When I realized that I have the same fate as a fool, I had to ask myself, "Then what's the point of being so wise?" It's all just smoke, man. Nothing but smoke. The smart and the dumb both just disappear. In a couple of days, everyone forgets about them. Yep, the smart and the dumb both die. That's it.
I hate life. From what I can see, everything that happens on this earth is just a bad deal. It's all smoke and trying to catch the wind.

And I hated everything I had worked for and collected on this earth. I can't take any of it with me. I have to leave it all to whoever comes after me. And who knows if they'll be worthy or worthless? They'll just take over everything I worked so hard for. It's all smoke.

That's when I just gave up. I gave up on hoping for anything on this earth. What's the point of working so hard if you just have to give everything to someone who didn't even try? It's all smoke. A bad deal from start to finish. So what do you really get from a life of hard work? Just pain and sadness all day long. You can't even get a good night's sleep. It's all just smoke.

The best thing you can do is just have a good time and do your best to get by. That's how I see it. It's all up to God. Whether we eat or not, it's all in His hands. God might give wisdom, knowledge, and joy to the people He likes, but sinners are stuck with a life of hard work, and in the end, they just have to give everything they earned to the people God likes. It's all just smoke and trying to catch the wind.

Ecclesiastes.title: There's a Time for Everything, No Cap
paragraphs: Basically, there's a right time for everything, a specific season for every single thing on earth:

A time to be born and a time to die,
A time to plant and a time to pull up what you planted,
A time to kill and a time to heal,
A time to tear down and a time to build up,
A time to cry and a time to laugh,
A time to be sad and a time to dance,
A time to scatter stones and a time to gather them,
A time to hug and a time to not hug,
A time to search and a time to give up,
A time to hold on and a time to let go,
A time to tear and a time to mend,
A time to be quiet and a time to speak up,
A time to love and a time to hate,
A time for war and a time for peace.

So, what do people really get from all their hard work? I've seen the grind God has given us. He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also put eternity in the human heart, but we're still lowkey in the dark; we can't fully figure out what God has been doing from the beginning to the end. I know that there is nothing better for people than to be happy and to do good while they live. That everyone should eat and drink and find satisfaction in all their work—this is a gift from God.
I know that everything God does will last forever; you can't add to it or take anything from it. God does it so that people will revere him.
Whatever is, has already been, and what will be, has been before; and God will call the past to account.

And I saw something else under the sun: In the place of judgment—wickedness was there, in the place of righteousness—wickedness was there. I said to myself, “God will bring into judgment both the righteous and the wicked, for there will be a time for every activity, a time for every deed.” I also said to myself, “As for humans, God tests them so that they may see that they are like the animals.”

For real, the fate of humans and the fate of animals is the same. As one dies, so dies the other. They all have the same breath; humans have no advantage over animals. It's all meaningless, like smoke. All go to the same place; all come from dust, and to dust all return. Who knows if the human spirit goes upward and if the spirit of the animal goes down into the earth? So I saw that there is nothing better for a person than to enjoy their work, because that is their lot. For who can bring them to see what will happen after them?

Ecclesiastes.title: Why Going Solo is a Total Fail
paragraphs: So then I looked at all the messed-up, unjust stuff that happens in the world. I saw victims crying their eyes out with no one to comfort them, and the people with power just crushing them, with no one to step in and help. It made me think, lowkey, the dead are better off than the living who are still dealing with all this. But honestly, the luckiest person is the one who was never even born, who never had to see all the garbage that goes down on earth.
Then I noticed how much of people's hard work and ambition is just because they're jealous of someone else. What a total waste. It's like trying to catch smoke. Or spitting into the wind.
The fool just kicks back and does nothing, but that laziness is basically a slow-motion way to ruin your life.
It's way better to have one handful of stuff and be chill, than two fistfuls and be stressed out all the time. That's just more chasing smoke.
It's way better to have one handful of stuff and be chill, than two fistfuls and be stressed out all the time. That's just more chasing smoke.

I turned my head and saw another example of something totally pointless: this one person, completely alone—no kids, no family, no friends—but still grinding 24/7, obsessively trying to get more and more. They never even stop to ask, "Why am I working this hard and never having any fun? And who am I even doing this for?" More smoke. A really bad deal.

Honestly, having a buddy is way better than rolling solo. You can share the work and share the rewards. If one of you falls, the other is there to help you up. But if you're alone and you fall, you're in big trouble.
Plus, two people sleeping in one bed keeps you warm. If you're alone, you'll just be shivering all night.
Plus, two people sleeping in one bed keeps you warm. If you're alone, you'll just be shivering all night.
By yourself, you're an easy target. With a friend, you can stand up to anything. And if you can get a third person? A squad of three is basically unbreakable.
By yourself, you're an easy target. With a friend, you can stand up to anything. And if you can get a third person? A squad of three is basically unbreakable.

A poor but wise kid is way better off than an old, foolish king who has no clue what's going on. I saw a kid just like that who started with nothing, went from rags to riches, and everyone was hyped for him to be the new king. But even with all that, the excitement didn't last. People got bored and lost interest. See? It's all just smoke. Totally pointless, like spitting into the wind.

Ecclesiastes.title: Don't Just Talk, Live It
paragraphs: Yo, when you go to God's house, be real. Go there to actually listen and learn. That's way better than just going through the motions with some sacrifice, which honestly just makes things worse.

Don't just run your mouth or say stuff without thinking. And for real, don't be so quick to tell God all your grand plans. He's the one in charge, not you. So, less talk, more listening. It's that simple.
Working too much will mess up your sleep, and talking too much just makes you look like a fool.

When you make a promise to God, you better keep it. No excuses. God isn't impressed by empty words. If you say you're gonna do something, do it. It's way better to not make a promise at all than to make one and then flake.
Don't let your words get you into deep trouble. When you're held accountable, you can't just be like, "Oops, my bad, didn't mean it." Why would you want to make God mad and have him come after you?
But for real, when all the fake stuff, daydreams, and empty chatter fade away, you've still got this solid truth: Respect God.

And don't get too bent out of shape when you see poor people getting treated like trash, and justice being a total joke everywhere. It's like a pyramid of corruption, from the low-level guys all the way to the top. It's a messed-up system, and you can't really do anything about it. But hey, at least the earth is real and provides for everyone—even a shady king gets food from the fields.
If you're all about money, you'll never have enough. If you're obsessed with being rich, you'll never be satisfied. It's all just chasing smoke.
The more stuff you get, the more people show up trying to take it. And what's the point of that? Getting robbed in broad daylight? No thanks.
Putting in a good, honest day's work means you'll sleep like a baby, whether you had a fancy dinner or just some ramen. But a rich person with a full stomach just lies awake stressing.

I've seen some seriously bad luck go down: a guy saves up a ton of money, way more than he needs, and then loses it all in some sketchy business deal. He has a kid but has nothing to give him. He came into the world with nothing, and he'll leave with nothing. That's some tough luck, for real. He came with nothing, he leaves with nothing. So what was the point of working so hard for a paycheck that just disappears like smoke? Just to live a miserable life in the dark?

So, after checking out how things work on this planet, I've figured out the best way to live: take care of yourself, have some fun, and do your best at whatever job you've got for as long as God lets you live. That's pretty much it. That's what we get. Yeah, we should totally enjoy what God gives us, both the good stuff and the ability to actually enjoy it. Just accept what you're given and find joy in your work. It's a gift from God! God gives us joy in the here and now. It's pointless to sit around worrying about how long you're gonna live.

Ecclesiastes.title: Rich & Miserable? What's the Point?
paragraphs: I've been taking a good, hard look at how things are, and let me tell you, it's pretty messed up. And you can tell people are feeling it.

For example, there are these people God totally blesses with everything—money, property, a killer reputation—basically everything they've ever dreamed of. But then, God doesn't even let them enjoy any of it. Some random person swoops in and gets to have all the fun with their stuff. It's just... pointless. A total ripoff.

Like, imagine someone has a ton of kids and lives a super long life but never actually enjoys it—even if they get a huge funeral at the end. Honestly, I think a baby that was never born is better off. It comes into the world and leaves without a name, never seeing or knowing anything, but it's still in a better spot than anyone who's alive.
Even if you lived for a thousand years—or even two thousand!—what's the point if you never actually enjoyed your life? Don't we all just end up in the same place anyway?
We're always grinding to feed our own desires, but our souls are left feeling empty.

So, what advantage does a wise person really have over a fool, or over some poor person who's just scraping by? The best you can do is grab what you can, while you can. Don't just sit around assuming something better will show up later. It's all just smoke in the end. Totally pointless, like spitting into the wind.
Whatever's gonna happen, happens. Your destiny is already set. You can't argue with fate.

The more you talk, the more meaningless it all becomes. And who's better off for it? Who even knows what's best for us in this short, fleeting life we live? And who can possibly tell us what's going to happen next?

Ecclesiastes.title: Real Talk: Wisdom vs. Hype
paragraphs: Having a good rep is way better than being loaded. Your last day says more about you than your first.
You'll have more 'aha' moments at a funeral than at a party. I mean, that's everyone's final destination, right? You might actually learn something real there.
It's actually better to cry it out than to laugh it off. Sure, your face gets all puffy, but it's like a deep clean for your soul.
Wise people aren't afraid to deal with the tough stuff, like pain and sadness. But fools? They just waste their time on pointless fun.
Getting called out by someone wise is way more valuable than getting praised by a bunch of fools.
The laughter of fools is super shallow, like the sound of twigs burning up fast. It's all just smoke, no real substance.
Being cruel can make even the smartest person dumb, and it can break even the strongest spirit.
Endings are lowkey better than beginnings. Sticking with something is more impressive than just starting it.
Don't lose your cool so fast. Getting angry always comes back to bite you. You can tell who the fools are by the drama they're always in.
Don't be that person always saying, 'Man, things were so much better back in the day.' That's not a wise question to ask.

Wisdom is even better when you've got some money to go with it, especially if you get both while you're young. It's like double protection: wisdom and wealth! Plus, wisdom gives you this extra energy.
Just look at what God has made. Who could possibly straighten out all the crazy, beautiful curves and angles of His creation?
When life's good, enjoy it. When it's bad, take a look at yourself. God gives us both good and bad days so we don't take anything for granted.

I've seen it all in my short, kinda weird life—I've seen good people die young, and I've seen terrible people live super long lives. So don't burn yourself out trying to be perfect, and don't get a big head thinking you're so wise. Trust me, it won't get you anywhere. But don't go wild being bad, either. And don't be reckless. Why die for no reason?
It's best to see both sides of things. Someone who respects God deals with all of reality, not just the parts they like.
One wise person with wisdom is stronger than ten powerful leaders in a city.
There's not a single person on earth who is 100% good, who is totally pure and never messes up.

Don't listen in on other people's conversations. What if they're gossiping about you and you hear something you wish you hadn't? You've done it too, right? Said stuff behind someone's back you wouldn't say to their face?

I really tried to get wise, I put everything into it. I wanted to be wise, but it was just out of my reach, like, way out there and super deep. Does anyone ever really figure it out? I went all in, studying and trying to find the meaning of life. I also wanted to understand what evil, stupidity, and craziness were all about.

Here's something I found out: a woman can be a real trap, full of schemes to get you. If you're lucky, you'll get away from her; but if you're not paying attention, you'll get caught. At least, that's what I've seen while I've been trying to make sense of everything. But I still haven't found the wisdom I was looking for. I couldn't find one man or woman in a thousand who was worth it. But I did see one good thing: God made us all good and straight, but we're the ones who have made a huge mess of things.

Ecclesiastes.title: Life's Not Fair, But Here's the Hack
paragraphs: Honestly, being wise is lowkey the best. Like, actually getting the point of life? It just makes your eyes sparkle and you're way chiller in how you talk and act.

Look, just do what the leader says. You promised you would, so don't start stressing and second-guessing when things get tough or annoying. You're on their team, not the other way around. The boss has the final say, and you can't just be like, 'Yo, what are you even doing?' Following orders isn't gonna kill you; a smart person just gets it done right away. There's a right time and a right way for everything, even if we mess it up most of the time. And for real, nobody knows what's coming next. Who's gonna tell us?
You can't control the wind or trap it. You don't get to decide when you die. You can't just pause a war mid-battle. And if you do messed-up stuff, that same energy isn't gonna save you.
I saw all this while I was trying to make sense of the world. As long as people have the power to hurt each other, it's just gonna be like this.

I once saw these seriously bad dudes get a fancy funeral on sacred ground. Then everyone went back to town and said all this super nice stuff about them—in the exact same place where those guys did all their dirt! It's all just a bunch of nonsense, for real.
Because people who do bad things don't get their karma right away, everyone else starts to think they can get away with anything.

Even when someone messes up a hundred times and lives a long life getting away with it, I'm still sure that the best life is for people who respect God and live like they know He's watching. The person who does wrong won't have a truly 'good' life. No matter how long they live, their days will be empty and pointless, like a shadow—all because they don't respect God.

Here’s something that happens all the time that is totally wild: Good people get the punishment that bad people deserve, and bad people get the rewards that good people deserve. I'm telling you, it makes zero sense. Total nonsense.

So, I'm all for just enjoying life. The best thing we can do on this earth is to eat, drink, and have a good time. That's our reward for all the hard work we have to do in the short time God gives us here.

When I decided to go all-in on wisdom and really look at everything happening on earth, I realized that even if you stayed up 24/7 and never blinked, you'd still never figure out what God's plan is. You can search as hard as you want, but you won't get it. No matter how smart you are, you'll never understand the full story.

Ecclesiastes.title: Life's Crazy, So Just Live It
paragraphs: Alright, so I've been thinking about all this stuff, like, really digging deep. And here's the tea: good people, wise people, everything they do is basically in God's hands. But honestly, whether they're getting love or hate, they have no clue what's coming next.

It's pretty wild, right? Everyone ends up in the same boat—the good, the bad, the nice, the mean, people who go to church and people who don't. It's lowkey messed up that everyone has the same fate. No wonder people are so obsessed with drama and go off the rails. Life just leads to death. The end.

But hey, if you're still breathing, you've got a shot. Like they say, 'a live dog is better than a dead lion.' At least when you're alive, you know you're gonna die. The dead? They know nothing, get nothing. They're just... gone. Nobody even remembers them. All their crushes, their beefs, their dreams—poof, vanished. They've left zero mark on the world.

So, for real, just live your life! Eat your food like it's the best thing ever, drink your drink with a happy heart. God's actually cool with you having a good time. Dress up every day. Go all out with colors and cool accessories. Enjoy life with the person you love, every single day of this crazy ride. Each day is a gift from God, and it's all you get for the grind of being alive. So make every day count! Whatever comes your way, just go for it, 100%. This is your one and only shot, 'cause in the grave—where you're definitely headed—there's no work, no thoughts, nothing.
I was walking around the other day and had this realization about how things are on Earth—

The fastest runner doesn't always win, the strongest fighter doesn't always come out on top, the smartest person isn't always happy, the cleverest person isn't always rich, and the most talented person doesn't always get the praise. Sooner or later, we all get hit with bad luck.
You can't see trouble coming. It's like fish getting caught in a net or birds in a trap. People get snagged by random, bad stuff all the time.
You can't see trouble coming. It's like fish getting caught in a net or birds in a trap. People get snagged by random, bad stuff all the time.

One time, I was watching how wisdom plays out in the real world, and I saw something that really made me think. There was this tiny town with hardly anyone in it. A powerful king attacked it, setting up all his gear to take it over. But there was this poor but super-wise guy in the town who saved everyone with his wisdom. And you know what happened? He was totally forgotten right after. (I guess 'cause he was just some poor dude.)
But still, I'm telling you, being wise is way better than being strong, even if that poor wise guy got ignored and forgotten.
The quiet advice of a wise person is way more powerful than the shouting of some fool in charge.
Wisdom is better than weapons, but one hothead can mess everything up for everyone.
Wisdom is better than weapons, but one hothead can mess everything up for everyone.

Ecclesiastes.title: Big Brain Moves vs. Epic Fails
paragraphs: You know how a single dead fly can make a whole bottle of fancy perfume smell nasty? Well, it's the same with a little bit of foolishness—it can totally wreck a ton of wisdom.
Being wise points you in the right direction, but being stupid leads you down the wrong path. It's that simple.
Even when a fool is just walking down the road, they have no clue where they're going. The way they walk just screams, "Hey, look, it's that fool again!"
If your boss gets mad at you, don't just quit. Staying calm can actually chill them out and fix the situation.

Here’s something messed up I’ve seen in the world, a mistake that’s on the people in charge: they give important jobs to clueless people, while the smart, experienced ones get pushed to the side. I’ve seen newbies living the high life, while the veterans who know what they're doing are basically ignored.
Be careful: the trap you set for someone else might be the one you get caught in. And watch out, because the person you're scheming with might just turn on you.
Heads up: quarrying stones is dangerous, and chopping down trees is risky. Always be alert.
Remember this: if your ax is dull, you're gonna have to work way harder. It's better to use your brain so you don't have to use as much muscle.
If a snake bites you before the snake charmer can do their thing, what's the point of calling them afterward? It's too late.
When a wise person talks, it's always smooth and helpful. But when a fool talks, they just end up destroying themselves. They start by saying something dumb and finish by spewing crazy, evil stuff.
Fools talk way, way too much, just blabbering on about things they know nothing about.
A hard day's work leaves a fool so exhausted that they can't even figure out how to get back home.

It's bad news for a country when its king is like a clueless kid and its leaders party all night. But it's awesome for a country when its king is mature, and the leaders are responsible and don't just get wasted all the time.
If you're lazy, your house is gonna fall apart. A lazy person's roof is always gonna leak.
Life's about having fun with friends (laughter and bread) and enjoying the good times (wine), but let's be real—money is what makes everything happen.

Don't talk trash about your leaders, not even in your head. And don't say bad things about powerful people, even when you're alone in your room. Somehow, that kind of talk always gets out. It's like little birds hear your gossip and spread it everywhere.

Ecclesiastes.title: YOLO, But Make It Smart
paragraphs: Go ahead, be generous with what you have—it's like a spiritual investment that pays off big time. No cap.
Don't be a hoarder; share your stuff and be a blessing to people. You never know what tomorrow holds, so make today count.

When the clouds are full, it's gonna rain. When a tree falls, that's where it lies. Stop overthinking and waiting for the perfect conditions. Just do the work. Stop staring at the sky and get on with your life.
Think about it—you can't fully explain the miracle of a baby forming in the womb, right? In the same way, you're not gonna understand every single thing God is doing. It's a mystery, and that's okay.
Get up and get to work in the morning, and stay on your grind until the evening. Don't just watch the clock. You never know which effort will be the one that leads to success in the end.

Man, waking up to a new day is lowkey the best feeling. It's awesome to be alive. Even if you live a super long life, don't take a single day for granted. Soak up every good moment, because tough days will come too. And honestly, most of the stuff that happens is temporary, like smoke.

To all the young people out there: make the most of your youth. Enjoy your energy. Follow your heart's passions. If something seems right, go for it. But just remember, there are still rules. You're accountable to God for everything you do.
So live freely and enjoy life—you're not young forever. Youth disappears as fast as a puff of smoke.

Ecclesiastes.title: Remember Your Creator Before It's Too Late
paragraphs: Yo, make sure you remember your Creator while you're still young, before the tough years hit and you start losing your energy. Before your eyesight gets blurry, the world looks fuzzy, and you're stuck inside by the fire during the cold winters.

When you get old, your body isn't on your side anymore. Your muscles get weak, your grip loosens, and your joints get all stiff. It's like the curtains are drawn on the world. You can't just go wherever you want, whenever you want. Everything just kind of stops. The normal sounds of the house disappear. You get woken up by birds chirping. Forget about hiking up mountains; that's not happening. Even just walking down the street can feel terrifying. Your hair turns white like apple blossoms, sitting on top of a super fragile, weak body. Yeah, you're on your way to your forever home, and your friends are already starting to plan your funeral.

Life is beautiful, but it's over in a flash. The precious and amazing life we have ends. Our bodies go back to the ground they came from, and our spirits go back to God who gave them to us in the first place.
It's all smoke, just smoke. The Teacher says everything is smoke.

Besides being wise himself, the Teacher also taught other people what he knew. He carefully considered, studied, and put together a ton of proverbs. The Teacher tried his best to find the perfect words to write down the simple truth.
The words of the wise push us to live a good life. They're like nails hammered in tight, holding our lives together. They come from God, the one Shepherd who guides us.

But hey, my friend, when it comes to anything more than this, just chill. People will never stop publishing books, and studying all the time will just wear you out until you're useless. So, here's the final, most important thing:
Respect God and do what he tells you.
And that's it. Eventually, God is going to bring everything we've ever done out into the light and judge it all based on what our secret intentions were, whether they were good or bad.

Song of Solomon.title: My Crush is a Total King
paragraphs: The ultimate song, Solomon's banger of a song!
Just kiss me already, like for real! Your love hits different, way better than any drink. Even just saying your name feels so good, like a chill stream. No wonder everyone's obsessed with you.

Let's just go, you and me. Run away together, just us and my king. We'll have the best time, singing and making amazing memories. Seriously, your love is top-tier, better than the fanciest stuff. It's so obvious why everyone loves you.

Hey girls of Jerusalem, I know I look a little rough around the edges, kinda sun-burnt like one of those desert tents, but I've still got it. Don't judge me for my tan. My brothers were being jerks and made me work outside all day, so I had to take care of the farm instead of myself.
Seriously, where are you at? I miss you like crazy. Tell me where you're working, where you take your sheep for their lunch break. Why do I have to feel so left out, like I'm not in your circle?
If you don't know, you, the most beautiful girl out there, it's cool. Just hang with your sheep, lead them to the good spots. Stick with your shepherd friends.

You remind me of one of Pharaoh's super sleek and fancy horses. Those earrings look amazing on you, and that necklace totally highlights your neck. I'm gonna make you some custom jewelry, gold and silver, to really show off how beautiful you are.

When my king, my lover, was lying next to me, my perfume filled the whole room. His head on my chest was like a bag of the best-smelling spices. My guy is like a whole bouquet of wildflowers, picked just for me from the fields of En Gedi.
Oh, my friend! You're so beautiful! And your eyes are so pretty—like doves!
And you, my love—you're so handsome! And our bed is like a secret spot in the forest. We've got a roof of cedar trees and walls of cypress, and it all smells so fresh and green.

Song of Solomon.title: My Man is on Another Level
paragraphs: I’m just a wildflower from the plains of Sharon, a regular lotus from the valley pools.
He says, “A lotus blooming in a swamp of weeds—that’s you, my girl, compared to everyone else.”

And my man? He’s like a legit apricot tree in a forest of boring ones; he just stands out from all the other guys. All I want is to chill in his shade and just soak up his amazing love. He brought me to this huge feast, but lowkey, it felt like I was the only thing he was looking at!
OMG, I need some snacks, stat! Apricots, raisins—anything. I’m literally about to pass out from all this love. His left hand is under my head, and his right arm is wrapped around my waist.
OMG, I need some snacks, stat! Apricots, raisins—anything. I’m literally about to pass out from all this love. His left hand is under my head, and his right arm is wrapped around my waist.
Yo, a quick PSA for all my girls in Jerusalem, I swear on all the deer and gazelles out there: don’t force love, don’t rush it. Just let it happen when the time is right and you’re actually ready.
Yo, a quick PSA for all my girls in Jerusalem, I swear on all the deer and gazelles out there: don’t force love, don’t rush it. Just let it happen when the time is right and you’re actually ready.

OMG, look! Listen! It’s my man! Do you see him coming? He’s literally vaulting over mountains and leaping over hills. He’s graceful like a gazelle, strong like a young buck. Look at him, right there, peeking through the gate, totally focused and ready. He’s here, and he’s talking to me!

OMG, look! Listen! It’s my man! Do you see him coming? He’s literally vaulting over mountains and leaping over hills. He’s graceful like a gazelle, strong like a young buck. Look at him, right there, peeking through the gate, totally focused and ready. He’s here, and he’s talking to me!

He says, “Get up, my beautiful love, let’s go! Look around—winter is finally over, the rain is gone! Flowers are blooming everywhere. The whole world is basically singing! The birds are going crazy in the forest. The lilacs smell amazing, and the cherry blossoms are popping off. So get up, my dear, my beautiful love—come with me! My shy dove, stop hiding. Come out so I can see you and hear your voice. Your voice is so calming and your face is, no cap, stunning.”
And then I’m like, “You gotta protect us from the foxes, the sneaky foxes that are trying to ruin our perfect little garden.”
My man is mine, and I’m his. He’s chilling in our garden all night, just enjoying the flowers until the sun comes up and the darkness fades.
My man is mine, and I’m his. He’s chilling in our garden all night, just enjoying the flowers until the sun comes up and the darkness fades.
Come back to me, my love. Be like a gazelle, leap like a wild deer on those amazing mountains!
Come back to me, my love. Be like a gazelle, leap like a wild deer on those amazing mountains!

Song of Solomon.title: I Searched ALL NIGHT For My Lost Love... And You Won't BELIEVE What Happened Next!
paragraphs: I was just tossing and turning all night, couldn't sleep. I was missing my guy like crazy. It actually hurt that he wasn't there. So I was like, 'I can't just lie here,' and I got up and started wandering around the city, checking every street and alley. I was desperate to find him! I looked everywhere, but he was nowhere. Then the night guards found me while they were on patrol. I asked them, 'Have you guys seen the one I love?' And you won't believe it, right after I left them, I found him! I found my love. I just grabbed him and hugged him so tight, and I wasn't letting go until I got him back to my place, safe and sound.
Okay, listen up, all my girls in Jerusalem, I'm telling you, for real: don't rush into love. Don't try to force it. It'll happen when it's supposed to happen, when you're actually ready for it.
Okay, listen up, all my girls in Jerusalem, I'm telling you, for real: don't rush into love. Don't try to force it. It'll happen when it's supposed to happen, when you're actually ready for it.

Whoa, what's that coming from the desert? It's kicking up a ton of dust and smells amazing, like a mix of sweet and spicy. Look! It's Solomon's royal ride, with sixty of Israel's most elite soldiers guarding it. These guys are seriously armed and ready for anything. King Solomon had this carriage custom-made from the best cedar wood. It had a silver frame, a gold roof, and purple cushions. The inside was all detailed leather. So fancy.

Whoa, what's that coming from the desert? It's kicking up a ton of dust and smells amazing, like a mix of sweet and spicy. Look! It's Solomon's royal ride, with sixty of Israel's most elite soldiers guarding it. These guys are seriously armed and ready for anything. King Solomon had this carriage custom-made from the best cedar wood. It had a silver frame, a gold roof, and purple cushions. The inside was all detailed leather. So fancy.
Come on, girls of Jerusalem, you have to see this! Everyone in Zion, don't miss out! It's my king, my love, all dressed up for his wedding, looking so happy. His heart is just bursting with joy!

Song of Solomon.title: He's Lowkey Obsessed With Her Beauty
paragraphs: Wow, you're seriously stunning, my love. Your eyes behind your veil are like gentle doves, and your hair flows like a whole flock of goats cascading down a sunny hill. Your smile? It's so full and expressive, strong and clean. Your lips are a vibrant red, and your mouth is just so elegant and inviting. Even veiled, your cheeks are soft and glowing.

The way you carry yourself, that smooth, graceful neck—it makes everyone turn their heads. Seriously, total awe and admiration. And your chest is like two young deer, twins of a gazelle, just hanging out among the first spring flowers.

The sweet scent of your body, the soft, spicy curves—it's all calling to me, and I'm coming. I'll stay right here until the sun comes up and the night fades away. You are beautiful from head to toe, my dear love, beyond compare, like, absolutely flawless.

Come with me, my bride, let's leave Lebanon. Get away from your high mountain hideout. Ditch that wilderness retreat where you're hanging out with lions and panthers are your bodyguards. You've completely stolen my heart, my dear friend. You just looked at me, and I was a goner. One glance and I was hopelessly in love. Your love is so beautiful, my dear, dear friend—way better than the most expensive wine, and your scent is more exotic than the rarest spices. Your kisses are literally honey, my love, and every word you say is something to be savored. Your clothes smell like the great outdoors, that fresh scent of the high mountains. My dear lover and friend, you're like a secret garden, a private, pure spring. Body and soul, you're a paradise, a whole orchard of juicy fruits—ripe apricots and peaches, oranges and pears; nut trees and cinnamon, and all kinds of fragrant woods; mint and lavender, and every aromatic herb; a garden fountain, sparkling and splashing, fed by fresh springs from the Lebanon mountains.
Wake up, North Wind! Get a move on, South Wind! Breathe on my garden, let its spicy fragrance fill the air.
Oh, please let my lover come into his garden! Yes, let him eat all the best, ripe fruits.

Song of Solomon.title: I Messed Up & Lost My Man... Help Me Find Him!
paragraphs: I went to my garden, my best friend and my everything! I took in all the amazing smells, had the best food and drinks.
Yo, let's celebrate, everyone! Cheers to life and love!
I was totally knocked out, but my dream felt so real. Then I heard my guy knocking and calling for me!
“Babe, let me in! You're my everything. I'm out here freezing and soaking wet from the night.”
And I was like, “But I'm already in my PJs and all clean for bed. You want me to get all gross again?”

But he just kept knocking, and honestly? It was kinda turning me on. I got up to let him in, totally ready for him. I was so excited as I unlocked the door. But when I opened it... he was gone. He'd gotten tired of waiting and bounced. My heart, like, actually broke. I felt so awful. I ran outside to find him, but he was nowhere. I yelled out his name, but got nothing back. Then the night guards found me while they were on patrol. They totally beat me up and ripped my clothes. Can you believe that? The guys who are supposed to be protecting the city!
So I'm begging you, all my girls in Jerusalem, if you see my man, please tell him I'm crazy about him and I need him.
And they were like, “Okay, but what's so special about this guy? Why are you so obsessed that you need our help?”

My man is lowkey glowing, he's so healthy and radiant! He's literally one in a million. There's no one like him! He's golden, perfect, with the sickest black curls. His eyes are like, soft and bright, but super deep, you know? Like you could get lost in them. His face is all rugged and his beard smells like fresh herbs. His voice is so warm and makes you feel safe. He's got these quiet, beautiful muscles under his skin. His body is like a work of art, so smooth and strong. He's tall and stands strong, like a huge tree. A total mountain of a man, smelling like wood and stone. His words are like kisses, and his kisses are like words. Everything about him is just... wow. He's amazing.
That's my man, that's my guy, my Jerusalem crew.

Song of Solomon.title: She's a Total Knockout
paragraphs: So where'd your crush go, girl? Where on earth could he be? Want us to help you find him?

Nah, it's cool. My guy is already on his way to his garden, just chilling among the flowers, checking out all the colors and shapes. I'm his and he's mine. He's all about those sweet-smelling flowers.

My dear, beautiful friend and lover, you're as gorgeous as Tirzah, the city of pure joy, as lovely as Jerusalem, the city of dreams. You're like a waking dream, totally stunning. Your beauty is almost too much for me—I'm in deep. This is next level! I can't even process it. Your hair is like a whole flock of goats flowing down a sunny hill, just shimmering. Your smile is so real and big—so expressive and strong and bright. And when your face is veiled, your cheeks are still so soft and glowing.

For real, there's no one like her on this planet. Never has been, never will be. She's a one-of-a-kind woman. My dove is absolute perfection, pure and innocent like the day she was born, and her mom was so happy to have her. Everyone who saw her was like, 'Wow!' and couldn't stop admiring her—all the parents, neighbors, and friends. They all blessed and praised her.

For real, there's no one like her on this planet. Never has been, never will be. She's a one-of-a-kind woman. My dove is absolute perfection, pure and innocent like the day she was born, and her mom was so happy to have her. Everyone who saw her was like, 'Wow!' and couldn't stop admiring her—all the parents, neighbors, and friends. They all blessed and praised her.
'Has anyone ever seen anything this amazing? She's as fresh as the sunrise, as lovely as the moon, as radiant as the sun, and as breathtaking as a galaxy-filled night sky.'
'Has anyone ever seen anything this amazing? She's as fresh as the sunrise, as lovely as the moon, as radiant as the sun, and as breathtaking as a galaxy-filled night sky.'

One day I was just walking through the orchard, looking for signs of spring, you know? Checking for buds about to pop, waiting for everything to be ripe and ready. And then, out of nowhere, my heart just got carried away, lost in some seriously deep thoughts.

One day I was just walking through the orchard, looking for signs of spring, you know? Checking for buds about to pop, waiting for everything to be ripe and ready. And then, out of nowhere, my heart just got carried away, lost in some seriously deep thoughts.
'Dance, dance, dear Shulammite, our angel-princess! Dance, so we can just stare at your amazing grace! Everyone wants to see the Shulammite do her victory dance of love and peace.'
'Dance, dance, dear Shulammite, our angel-princess! Dance, so we can just stare at your amazing grace! Everyone wants to see the Shulammite do her victory dance of love and peace.'

Song of Solomon.title: He's Whipped and He Knows It
paragraphs: Dang, you're so fine from head to toe. The way you move is straight-up queenly. Your legs are so sleek and elegant, like they were sculpted by a pro artist. Your waist is like a perfectly shaped goblet, just waiting to be filled with the best wine. Your skin is so smooth, like a field of wheat blowing in the wind. And your chest... wow, like two baby deer, twins even. Your neck is like a smooth, curved piece of ivory. Your eyes are so bright and full of secrets. Seriously, you're the definition of feminine! Your whole vibe just makes everyone turn their heads and pay attention. When I see big, beautiful mountains, I get this feeling of wanting to climb them, and honestly? You make me feel the same way. You've ruined me for anyone else, for real. Your beauty, inside and out, is just perfect, my love, my best friend. You stand so tall and graceful, like a palm tree, and your breasts are like a bunch of sweet dates. I'm not gonna lie, I'm thinking, 'I'm gonna climb that palm tree! I'm gonna get my hands on that fruit!' Oh yeah! Your chest is gonna be like clusters of sweet fruit for me, your breath is gonna smell fresh like mint, and your kisses will be like the best wine ever.

Yeah, and your kisses are amazing too—they flow right from your lips to mine. I belong to my man. I'm everything he wants. I'm his whole world! C'mon, babe—let's just get out of here and wander through the countryside. We can crash at some random little inn, then wake up super early and listen to the birds. Let's go find some wildflowers, see the blackberry bushes starting to bloom, and check out all the fruit trees with their flowers. And right there, I'll give all of myself to you, all my love.
The smell of love is all around us, like we're surrounded by this vibe of new life and growth. All this fruit, fresh and dried, that I've been saving just for you, my love.

Song of Solomon.title: Love is Unstoppable, No Cap
paragraphs: I so wish you were my actual brother, like, the one who shared my mom's milk. Then I could kiss you right out in public and nobody would bat an eye. I'd lead you by the hand straight to my mom's house, where she raised me. I'd give you my special spiced wine to drink and kiss your cheeks.

Just imagine! His left hand is cradling my head, and his right arm is wrapped around my waist! But yo, a little PSA for all my girls in Jerusalem: Don't try to force love or stir it up before it's time. You gotta wait until it's ripe and you're actually ready.
Who's this coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her man like that?
I woke you up under the apricot tree, right where your mom went into labor with you. Yeah, under that exact tree, she gave birth to you.

Put me like a seal over your heart, like a signet ring on your finger. Because love is as strong as death, and passion is as intense as the grave. It's a blazing fire, a legit flame from God. No amount of water can quench love; no floods can sweep it away. If someone tried to buy love with all their money, they'd be totally laughed at. My brothers used to stress about me:

'Our little sister, she doesn't have any boobs yet. What are we gonna do with her when guys start asking her out? She's like a wall, so we'll build a silver tower to protect her. She's like a door, so we'll board her up with cedar planks.'
Well, dear brothers, I am a wall, but now my breasts are like towers. And when my lover sees me, he knows he's found total satisfaction.

Solomon has a vineyard at Baal Hamon, and he rents it out to others. Each one has to bring in a thousand silver coins. But my own vineyard is all mine, and I'm in charge of it. You can have your thousand coins, Solomon, and let the renters keep their two hundred!
Hey you, chilling in the gardens, my friends are listening for your voice. Let me hear it too!
Run to me, my love! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.

Isaiah.title: God's Beef with His People
paragraphs: Okay, so this is the vision Isaiah, son of Amoz, had about Judah and Jerusalem. This all went down when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.

God's laying out his case, and he's calling on heaven and earth to be the jury. He's like, "Yo, I raised these kids, gave them everything, and they just straight up turned on me. Even an ox knows its owner, and a donkey knows who feeds it, but Israel? My own people? They're clueless. It's a total shame. These guys are God-dropouts, just weighed down by their own baggage of bad choices. A whole crew of villains, a gang of vandals. My people have ghosted me, their God, turned their backs on the Holy One of Israel, and just walked away without a second thought.

"Honestly, why do I even bother trying with you guys? You're so stubborn. It's like you're intentionally running into brick walls. Your whole being is fighting against you. From your feet to your head, nothing is right. You're covered in wounds, bruises, and nasty sores that are just left there—no one's cleaning them, no one's bandaging them up. Your country is a wreck, your cities are burned to the ground. Foreigners are taking over your land right in front of you, and it's just a pile of rubble left by barbarians. Daughter Zion is all alone, like a beat-up shack on a dead-end road, like a rundown shanty on the wrong side of town, or a sinking ship everyone's bailed on. Lowkey, if God of the Angel Armies hadn't left a few of us, we'd be totally wiped out like Sodom, completely doomed like Gomorrah.
"So listen up, you leaders who are basically schooled by Sodom. Pay attention to God's revelation, you people who are learning from Gomorrah.

"For real, why all these sacrifices?" God is asking. "You think I'm not sick of all the burnt offerings, the rams, and the fat calves? You think I want all this blood from bulls, lambs, and goats? When you show up in my house, who even told you to act like this, running all over the place, doing whatever? It's just chaos in the place where you're supposed to worship.

"Just stop with the fake worship. I can't stand your pointless religious games. All your monthly meetings, weekly Sabbaths, special get-togethers—meetings, meetings, and more meetings—I can't take it anymore! Meetings for this, meetings for that. I hate them! You've completely worn me out! I'm so over your religion, religion, religion, especially when you just keep on sinning. Next time you put on a big prayer show, I'm gonna be looking the other way. It doesn't matter how long or loud you pray, I'm not listening. And you know why? Because you've been tearing people apart, and your hands are covered in blood. Go home and wash up. Get your act together. Clean up your lives from all the evil stuff so I don't have to see it anymore. Say no to what's wrong. Learn to do good. Fight for justice. Help out people who are struggling. Stand up for the homeless. Go to bat for those who can't defend themselves.

"Come on. Sit down. Let's talk this through." This is God's message: "If your sins are as red as blood, they'll be as white as snow. If they're crimson red, they'll be like wool. If you're willing to listen and obey, you'll live like kings. But if you're stubborn and refuse, you'll die like dogs." No cap. God said it.

OMG, can you even believe this? The city that was once so pure has become a total sellout! It used to be all about justice, everyone was a good neighbor, and now they're all at each other's throats. Your money is fake. Your wine is watered down. Your leaders are traitors who hang out with criminals. They'll do anything for money and take whatever they can get. They never stand up for the homeless or defend those who need help.

So, this is the official decree from the Master, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, the Strong One of Israel: "That's it! I'm gonna get these oppressors off my back. I'm getting back at my enemies. I'm about to lay down the law, get all the junk out of your life, and clean you up. I'm going to set up honest judges and wise counselors for you, just like it was in the good old days. Then you'll be called 'The City That Does Right' and 'The Real-Deal City.'" God's right ways will make Zion right again. His right actions will bring back his lost kids. But it's game over for the rebels and God-traitors, a dead end for anyone who walks out on God. "All your messing around in those sacred tree groves is gonna make you look so dumb, and all that fooling around in those god and goddess gardens you thought was so cool. You'll end up like an oak tree losing all its leaves, like a garden with no water, all withered and brown. The 'Strong Man' will turn out to be nothing but dead twigs, and his 'great work' will be the spark that starts a fire that burns it all down to nothing but smoke."

Isaiah.title: God's Mountain is the GOAT, No More War!
paragraphs: Here’s the vision Isaiah had about Judah and Jerusalem:

Okay, so check it. A day is coming when the mountain with God's house on it will be THE mountain, like, towering over all the others. People from every country will be streaming towards it. They'll be like, 'Yo, let's go up to God's mountain, to the house of Jacob's God. He'll teach us his ways so we can live how we're supposed to.' The real tea is gonna come from Zion; God's message is gonna broadcast from Jerusalem. He'll sort out all the drama between countries and make things fair for everyone. They'll trade their swords for garden tools and their spears for farming equipment. No more country-on-country beef; they won't even train for war anymore. So let's go, fam of Jacob, let's live in God's light.

God, you've bounced on your people, the family of Jacob, and it's because they're into all this fake religion, sketchy Philistine magic, and weird pagan stuff. Their world is all about getting rich, having endless stuff, and all the latest gadgets. And the idols—so many idols of all shapes and sizes. These people literally make their own gods and then bow down to them. It's a total mess, they're face-down in the mud. Just leave them be, God. They're not even worth forgiving.
