They’ll return to Zion cheering, with endless joy on their faces, so hyped and ecstatic they can’t even stand it—and you won’t hear any moaning or groaning.

“It’s me. I’m the one comforting you. So why are you so scared? Of some person who’s just gonna die anyway? Some poor human who’s gonna turn to dust? You totally forgot about me, your God, the one who made you, who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth. And now you’re here, shaking like a leaf because some bully is throwing a fit and thinks he can destroy the world. But what’s gonna happen to his tantrums? Nothing. The prisoners will be set free before you know it. They’re not gonna die. They won’t even go hungry. Because I am God, your God, the one who stirs up the sea and makes the waves crash. My name is the Lord of Angel Armies. I give you the words to say, and I personally protect you, even while I’m creating new heavens, setting the earth on a firm foundation, and telling Zion, ‘Yo, you’re my people!’”

So wake up! Get the sleep out of your eyes! Get on your feet, Jerusalem! You drank the cup God gave you, that strong drink of his anger. You chugged the whole thing down to the last drop, and now you’re staggering around, totally wasted. And there was no one to help you get home. None of your so-called friends or your own kids would even take your hand and help you to bed. You got hit with a double whammy of trouble—does anyone even care? Violence and ruin, starvation and death—is anyone gonna comfort you? Your kids have all passed out, lying in the streets like stunned animals, knocked out by the strong drink of God’s anger, the fury of your God.

So listen up, you who are suffering with a massive headache, you who have a hangover that isn’t even from alcohol. Your Master, your God, has something to say. Your God is defending his people: “Look, I’ve taken back that cup of drink that made you stumble. You’re done drinking from that jug of my anger. I’ve handed it over to your abusers, the ones who told you, ‘Get on the ground so we can walk all over you!’ And you had to do it. You lay flat on the ground, and you became the dirt they walked on.”

Isaiah.title: God's Epic Comeback for His People
paragraphs: Yo, wake up! Let's go, Zion! Get your best 'fit on, Jerusalem, you're the holy city! All the haters who aren't about God have been kicked out. They're not part of this journey. So get up, brush off the dust, captive Jerusalem! Break free from your chains, daughter of Zion!
God is saying, "You were sold for like, nothing. So I'm buying you back for nothing."

The Master, God, also says, "A long time ago, my people went to Egypt and were basically strangers there. Then Assyria came and bullied them. And now, what's this?" This is God's official decree. "My people are getting dragged off again for no good reason. These tyrants are just running around, celebrating, while my name gets dragged through the mud 24/7. But it's time for my people to know who I am, what I'm really about—and yeah, that I have something to say. And here I am!"

How awesome is it to see the messenger's feet on the mountains, bringing the good news, telling everyone that it's all good, that good times are coming, announcing salvation, and telling Zion, "Your God is in charge!" Listen! Your lookouts are shouting, like a massive thunderclap, all in sync. They're literally seeing with their own eyes God returning to Zion. So break out in song! Even the ruins of Jerusalem should be booming, "God has comforted his people! He's redeemed Jerusalem!" God has rolled up his sleeves, and all the nations can see his holy, jacked arm. Everyone, from one end of the earth to the other, is seeing him do his thing, his salvation work.

Get out of there! Seriously, leave that place! Don't look back. Don't get contaminated by grabbing their stuff. Just go, but go clean. You gotta stay pure while you worship, carrying God's holy things. But for real, you don't have to sprint. You're not running away from anyone! God is leading you out, and the God of Israel is your rear guard, watching your back.

"Just watch my servant, he's about to have a major glow-up! He'll be exalted, standing tall, head and shoulders above everyone. But it wasn't always like this. At first, everyone was shook. He didn't even look human—his face was so messed up, you couldn't even recognize him. But now, nations all over the world will be in awe, totally speechless when they see him. Kings will be shocked into silence. Because what they've never heard of, they'll see with their own eyes. What was once unthinkable will be right in front of them."

Isaiah.title: He Took the Hit for Us
paragraphs: Seriously, who would've believed what we saw? Like, who would have guessed God's rescue plan would look like this?

This servant grew up in God's eyes like a weak little plant in a super dry field. There was nothing about him that made you look twice. He was totally overlooked and ignored, a guy who was always suffering and knew pain up close. People would literally turn away when they saw him. We all looked down on him, thought he was a total nobody. But the truth is, he was carrying our pain—all our brokenness and all the stuff wrong with us. We thought God was punishing him for his own screw-ups. But it was our sins that messed him up, that tore him apart and crushed him. Our sins! He took the punishment that made us whole. His bruises are what healed us. We're all like sheep who've wandered off and gotten lost. We've all gone our own way, done our own thing. And God put all our sins, everything we've ever done wrong, on him.

He was beaten and tortured, but he didn't say a word. Like a lamb being led to the slaughter or a sheep getting sheared, he just took it all in silence. Justice was a joke, and he was led away—and did anyone even get what was really going on? He died without even thinking about himself, beaten to a pulp for the sins of my people. They buried him with criminals, threw him in a rich guy's tomb, even though he'd never hurt anyone or said a single lie.

But this was God's plan all along, to crush him with pain. The deal was that he'd offer himself for our sins, and then he'd see new life come from it—tons and tons of life. And God's plan will totally succeed because of him.

After all that terrible suffering, he'll see that it was all worth it and be glad he did it. Through everything he went through, my righteous servant will make a lot of people right with God, because he's carrying the weight of their sins. That's why I'm going to give him the highest honor and the best of everything. Because he faced death and didn't even flinch, and he hung out with the lowest of the low. He took on the sins of everyone and stood up for all the outcasts.

Isaiah.title: God's Epic Comeback Plan for You
paragraphs: Yo, even if you feel totally left out and like you've got nothing, it's time to celebrate! Start singing, even if you've never had a reason to before. God's saying you're about to have more blessings than you can even handle, way more than the people who seem to have it all. So get ready! Make space for all the good stuff coming your way. Think bigger! You're gonna need way more room for your crew 'cause it's about to get huge. You're gonna be so influential, taking over places and rebuilding what was broken. Don't even stress, you're not gonna be embarrassed. Don't hold back, you won't fail. You'll forget all the cringey stuff from when you were younger, and the pain of being alone will just fade away. Because the one who made you? He's basically your forever person, and his name is God, the commander of all the angel armies! The one who saves you is the Holy One of Israel, and he's the God of the whole world. You felt like you got ghosted, totally heartbroken, but God's welcoming you back with open arms. Like someone who got married young and then got left, but now you're wanted back," says your God.
Your Redeemer God says:

"I had to leave for a sec, but it was just for a moment. Now, I'm coming back with so much love and compassion. I was really mad for a second and had to turn away, but that's over now. I'm here for you with a love that's not going anywhere.

"This whole situation is like Noah's flood all over again. Back then, I promised that I'd never flood the whole world again. And now, I'm promising that I'm not gonna be angry or call you out anymore. Even if the mountains literally get up and walk away, and the hills crumble, my love for you is staying put. My promise of peace is solid." The God who has your back is saying this, for real.

"This whole situation is like Noah's flood all over again. Back then, I promised that I'd never flood the whole world again. And now, I'm promising that I'm not gonna be angry or call you out anymore. Even if the mountains literally get up and walk away, and the hills crumble, my love for you is staying put. My promise of peace is solid." The God who has your back is saying this, for real.

"To the city that's been through it, beat down by storms and feeling low-key ignored: I'm about to give you a major glow-up. I'm rebuilding you with turquoise stones, your foundations with sapphires, your towers with rubies, your gates with jewels, and all your walls with precious stones. All your kids will be taught by God himself—like, what a GOATed mentor, right? You'll be built strong, on a foundation of what's right. You'll be safe from any trouble—nothing to be scared of! No terror will even get close. If anyone tries to start beef with you, don't think for a second that I sent them. And if they do attack, it's not gonna work. I'm the one who created the blacksmith who makes weapons, and I'm also the one who created the destroyer. But no weapon that could hurt you has ever been made. Anyone who tries to call you out in court will be exposed as a liar. This is the inheritance for God's crew. I'll make sure everything works out for you in the end." That's a decree from God himself.

I'm rebuilding you with turquoise stones, your foundations with sapphires, your towers with rubies, your gates with jewels, and all your walls with precious stones. Anyone who tries to call you out in court will be exposed as a liar. This is the inheritance for God's crew. I'll make sure everything works out for you in the end." That's a decree from God himself.

Isaiah.title: God's Free Upgrade is Legit
paragraphs: "Yo, anyone who's thirsty, come get some water! You broke? No worries, come on and get some food! Seriously, get your drinks, wine, milk—it's all on the house, no money needed! Why are you wasting your cash on junk food and stuff that doesn't even last? Just listen up, for real: eat the good stuff, the best stuff. Pay attention, come here, and listen to what I'm saying, 'cause these words will give you life. I'm making a promise to you that'll last forever, the same kind of solid, real love I showed David. I made him a big deal, a leader for all the nations, and now it's your turn. You're gonna call over nations you don't even know, and they'll come running to you because of me, your God, 'cause the Holy One of Israel thinks you're awesome."

"Look for God while He's around, pray to Him while He's close. If you're doing bad stuff, just stop. If you're thinking bad thoughts, change your mind. Come back to God, 'cause He's super merciful. Come back to our God, 'cause He's always ready to forgive, no cap."

"My thoughts are not like your thoughts. The way I do things is not how you do things," says God. "Just like the sky is way, way higher than the earth, my ways are way beyond your ways, and my thoughts are way beyond your thoughts. Think about it—rain and snow come down from the sky and don't go back up until they've watered the ground, making plants grow and giving seeds to farmers and food to everyone. That's how it is with my words. They won't come back to me without doing something. They'll do exactly what I sent them to do, and they'll get the job done."

"So you're gonna go out full of joy, and you'll be led to a life that's totally complete. The mountains and hills will be cheering you on, like they're singing. All the trees will be clapping for you. Instead of prickly weeds, you'll have huge, amazing trees. Instead of thorny bushes, you'll have tall, strong pines. These will be like a huge sign for me, for God, a living, breathing reminder of me that will last forever."

Isaiah.title: God's Open Invite is Lowkey GOATED
paragraphs: God's message is this:

'Yo, look out for each other. Do the right thing, and do it for the right reasons, 'cause my rescue mission is about to drop. You're super blessed if you're in on this, if you're all about it. That means respecting the Sabbath, not messing it up, and just, like, not doing messed-up stuff. And for real, don't ever let anyone who's not from around here but is trying to follow God feel like they're second-rate, like they don't belong. And anyone who's been through some physical stuff, don't let them think they're 'damaged goods' and can't be part of this.'
For God says:

'To those who've been through it physically but still keep my Sabbaths, choose what I'm about, and hold on tight to my promises, I'm gonna give you a place of honor in my family and my city. Like, even more honor than my own sons and daughters. I'm talking permanent VIP status that never gets canceled.'

'And for all the outsiders who are now rolling with me, serving me, loving my name, and wanting to be my crew—everyone who respects the Sabbath and holds on to my promises—I'm gonna bring you to my holy mountain and make you joyful in my house of prayer. You're totally welcome to worship just like the insiders, bringing your own offerings to my altar. Oh yeah, my house of worship will be known as a house of prayer for everyone.' This is the official word from the Master, God himself, who's gathering all the scattered people of Israel: 'I'm gonna gather even more people, bringing them in with the ones who are already here.'

'And for all the outsiders who are now rolling with me, serving me, loving my name, and wanting to be my crew—everyone who respects the Sabbath and holds on to my promises—I'm gonna bring you to my holy mountain and make you joyful in my house of prayer. You're totally welcome to worship just like the insiders, bringing your own offerings to my altar. Oh yeah, my house of worship will be known as a house of prayer for everyone.' This is the official word from the Master, God himself, who's gathering all the scattered people of Israel: 'I'm gonna gather even more people, bringing them in with the ones who are already here.'
A call to the wild animals: Come get 'em. Come on, you savage beasts, and devour!

'Cause Israel's lookouts are totally blind, the whole squad. They have no clue what's happening. They're like guard dogs that don't even know how to bark, just lazy dogs dreaming in the sun. But man, they're hungry dogs, they know how to eat. Super greedy dogs who are never satisfied. And these are supposed to be Israel's shepherds! They know nothing, understand nothing. They're all just looking out for themselves, taking whatever they can get. 'Come on,' they say, 'let's party. Let's go get wasted!' And tomorrow will be just the same: 'Let's live it up!'

Isaiah.title: God's REAL Talk vs. Fake Religion
paragraphs: Meanwhile, good people are dying and literally no one cares. God-fearing people get taken away, and it's like nobody even notices. The thing is, these good people are finally out of their misery and at peace. They lived good, dignified lives, and now they're finally resting.

But you guys... children of a witch, for real... come over here. You sons of a slut, daughters of a whore. What gives you the right to be mocking people, sneering, and sticking your tongue out? Do you even get how messed up you've become? A whole generation of rebels and liars. You're out there satisfying your desires wherever you find a bit of shade, doing whatever you want. You're sacrificing your own kids in any random spot—any cave or crack in the rock is good enough for you. You grab stones from the creek to set up your weird sex-and-religion shrines. You've basically chosen your own downfall. Your so-called 'worship' is gonna be what ruins you. You've climbed up high mountains to do your gross sex-and-death rituals. Behind closed doors, you've got your collection of precious little gods and goddesses. You've totally abandoned me, gone all out, stripped down, and made your bed a place of worship. You've hopped into bed with so-called 'sacred' prostitutes and loved every second of it, obsessing over their naked bodies. You pour fancy oils on your king-god and load up on perfumes for yourselves. You send people out to find the newest religious trend, sending them all the way to hell and back. You completely wear yourselves out trying every new and different thing, and you never realize what a total waste it is. You always seem to find the energy for the latest fad, never getting tired of trying out new religions.

Who even convinced you to chase after all this nonsense, leaving me completely forgotten, like you never even knew me? Just because I don't scream and cause a scene, you think I don't exist? I'm going to lay out, piece by piece, all your so-called 'righteous' attempts at religion and show you how ridiculous it all is. Go on, cry out to your collection of fake gods for help. A little puff of wind will blow them all away. They're just smoke, absolutely nothing.
But anyone who runs to me for help will get the land as their own; they'll end up owning my holy mountain!
Someone's saying: 'Build it, build it! Make a road! Clear the path, get the rocks out of the way for my people to travel.'

A message from the God who is high and mighty, who lives forever, whose name is Holy: 'I live in the highest and holiest places, but I'm also right there with those who are feeling low and crushed. And what I do is breathe new life into them, get them back up on their feet. Because I'm not going to drag people into court forever; I'm not going to stay angry for all time. If I did, people would just lose hope. The very souls I created would get exhausted and give up. I was angry, really angry, because of Israel's sins. I hit him hard and turned away in my anger, but he just kept on being stubborn and doing his own thing. When I looked again and saw what he was up to, I decided to heal him, lead him, and comfort him, creating a new way for the mourners to praise. Peace to those far away, and peace to those who are near,' says God—'and yes, I will heal them. But the wicked are like a stormy sea that can't calm down. Its waves just churn up garbage and mud. There is no peace,' God says, 'for the wicked.'

Isaiah.title: God's Real Fast vs. Your Fake One
paragraphs: “Yo, shout it out! Don't hold back, make it loud like a trumpet blast! Tell my people what they're doing wrong, confront my family, Jacob, with their sins. They're always busy with worship and love learning about me. They look like a nation of good people, following the law and honoring God. They ask me, ‘What’s the right thing to do?’ and love having me on their side. But they also complain, ‘Why do we fast and you don’t see it? Why do we humble ourselves and you don’t even notice?’
“Well, here’s the tea:

“The main point of your ‘fast days’ is to make a profit. You push your workers way too hard. You fast, but at the same time you're arguing and fighting. You fast, but you're ready to throw punches. The way you're fasting won't even get your prayers heard. Do you think this is the kind of fast I want: a day to show off how humble you are? To put on a serious face and walk around in black like you're so holy? You call that fasting, a fast day that I, God, would actually like?

“This is the kind of fast day I'm looking for: to break the chains of injustice, stop exploiting workers, free the oppressed, and cancel debts. What I want to see you do is: share your food with the hungry, invite the homeless poor into your homes, give clothes to those who are cold and have nothing, and be there for your own families. If you do this, things will get bright for you, and your life will turn around in an instant. Your good deeds will lead the way for you. The glory of God will protect you. Then when you pray, God will answer. You’ll call for help and I’ll say, ‘Here I am.’

“If you stop being unfair, stop blaming the victims, and stop gossiping about other people's sins, if you're generous to the hungry and help those who are down, your life will start to shine in the darkness, and your darkest moments will become bright as the sun. I will always guide you. I’ll give you a full life even in the driest places—you'll be strong and healthy. You’ll be like a garden that's always watered, a spring that never runs out of water. You’ll use the ruins of your past to build something new, and rebuild on the old foundations. You’ll be known as the people who can fix anything, restore old ruins, rebuild and renovate, and make the community a great place to live again.

“If you're careful on the Sabbath and don’t use my holy day for your own benefit, if you treat the Sabbath as a day of joy, God’s holy day as a celebration, if you honor it by not doing your usual business, not making money, not running around—then you’ll be able to truly enjoy God! Oh, I’ll make you soar high above everything. I’ll let you enjoy the inheritance of your ancestor Jacob.” Yes! God himself said so!

Isaiah.title: God's Epic Rescue Mission
paragraphs: Yo, for real, God isn't weak. He can totally still save you. And He's not ignoring you; He can still hear. The issue isn't God, it's you. Your messed-up choices created this huge gap between you and God. Your sins are basically blocking His reception so He can't hear you. Your hands are literally covered in blood, your fingers are dripping with guilt. You're constantly lying, and your tongue is always muttering messed-up stuff. Nobody stands up for what's right, and no one plays fair. You all trust in empty illusions, you tell lies, you cook up trouble and end up with more sin. It's like you're hatching snake eggs and weaving spider webs. Eat one of those eggs and you die; crack one open and a snake pops out. Those spider webs are useless for making clothes. You can't wear that stuff! All you do is weave wickedness and hatch violence. You're all racing to do evil, trying to be the first to murder someone. You plan and breathe evil, leaving a trail of wrecked lives behind you. You know nothing about peace and even less about justice. The paths you're on are all twisted and jacked up. There's no peace for anyone who walks down those roads.

So basically, we're super far from being fair, and we're not even close to living right. We're desperate for light but we just keep falling into darkness. We want things to be bright, but we're just stumbling through the night. We're like blind people, inching along a wall, groping around without a clue. We're shuffling around in broad daylight like we're dead but somehow still walking. We're no better than bears groaning and no worse than doves moaning. We're looking for justice, but there's zero sign of it. We're looking for salvation, but there's not even a hint.

Our screw-ups are piled up right in front of you, God, and our sins are calling us out. Our wrongdoings are staring us in the face; we know exactly what we've done: dissing and denying God, not following our God, spreading fake news, starting drama, being full of lies, and whispering malicious things. Justice gets shut down, and righteousness is kicked to the curb. Truth is tripping up in the streets, and honesty is nowhere to be found. Goodness is MIA. Anyone who tries to stop doing evil just gets beat up and robbed.

God looked and saw all this evil on the horizon—so much evil and not a single sign of justice. He was shocked by what He saw: not one person was around to fix this awful situation. So He did it Himself. He took on the job of Salvation, powered by His own Righteousness. He put on Righteousness like a suit of armor, with Salvation as His helmet. He wore Judgment like a coat and threw a cloak of Passion over His shoulders. He's going to make everyone pay for what they've done: fury for His haters, and payback for His enemies. Even the faraway islands will get what they deserve. In the west, they'll respect God's name, and in the east, they'll respect His glory. Because He'll show up like a flash flood, whipped into a raging torrent by the wind of God.
'I'll show up in Zion as the Redeemer, for all the people of Jacob who turn away from their sins.' That's God's decree.

'As for me,' God says, 'this is my promise to them: My Spirit that I've put on you and the words that I've given you to speak, they're not going to leave your mouths, or your children's mouths, or your grandchildren's mouths. You will keep repeating these words and will never stop.' Those are God's orders.

Isaiah.title: Jerusalem's Epic Glow Up is GOATED
paragraphs: Yo, Jerusalem, get out of bed! Time to wake up and catch some rays. God's glory is seriously shining on you. The rest of the world is basically in airplane mode, total darkness, but God's light is hitting you like a sunrise. Nations are gonna flock to your light, and kings will be drawn to your brightness. Just look up and look around! Watch everyone gathering and coming to you: your sons from miles away, and your daughters getting a ride from their nannies. Seeing them will make you smile so big, your heart will feel like it's gonna burst. All your people are coming home from overseas for a huge reunion, a massive harvest of exiles from all over. And you'll see endless camel caravans, young camels from Midian and Ephah, rolling in from Sheba with tons of gold and frankincense, telling everyone how great God is. Plus, a ton of flocks from Kedar and Nebaioth will be brought as offerings to my altar, making my amazing Temple look even more epic.

“What's that in the distance? A cloud on the horizon, like a huge flock of doves? It's a fleet of ships from faraway islands, the legendary Tarshish ships, bringing your kids home from all over. They're loaded with silver and gold, all in the name of your God, the Holy One of Israel, who's making you look absolutely splendid. Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will help you out with your worship. I was mad and I hit you hard, but now I want to be good to you. Your city gates will always be open, 24/7, with wealth pouring in from every nation, and their kings will be like your delivery guys. Any nation that doesn't get on board will be totally wrecked. The best wood from Lebanon—cypress, oak, and pine—will be brought to make my Sanctuary look incredible, making the place where I rest my feet glorious. The kids of the people who bullied you will come and bow down to you. Everyone who ever dissed you will be kissing your feet. They'll call you 'City of God,' 'Zion of the Holy One of Israel.' Not long ago, you were hated and ignored, a total ghost town. But now, I've made you famous and awesome forever, a place that brings joy to everyone. You'll be nourished by nations and royalty, and you'll know for sure that I, God, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Champion of Jacob. I'm giving you a major upgrade—no more hand-me-downs! Gold instead of bronze, silver instead of iron, bronze instead of wood, and iron instead of stones. I'm putting Peace in charge of your country and Righteousness as your leader. You won't hear about crime in your land anymore, no more robberies or vandalism. You'll name your main street 'Salvation Way' and have 'Praise Park' in the center of town. You won't need the sun during the day or the moon at night anymore. God will be your light forever, and your God will cover you in splendor. Your sun will never set, and your moon will never go away. I will be your eternal light. Your sad days are over. All your people will be living right, and they'll own the land forever. They're like a new plant that I planted with my own hands to show off my glory. The smallest family will become a huge clan, and the weakest person will become a strong nation. I am God. When the time is right, I'll make it happen, and it'll be fast.”

Isaiah.title: God's Epic Glow-Up Plan
paragraphs: The Spirit of God, the Master, is on me because God himself chose me. He sent me to tell the down-and-out the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, to announce freedom to everyone who feels trapped, and a clean slate for all prisoners. God sent me to announce the year of his grace—basically a huge party celebrating God taking down our enemies—and to comfort everyone who's mourning. He sent me to look after everyone who's sad in Zion, to give them flower crowns instead of ashes, happy vibes instead of sad news, and a spirit of praise instead of a feeling of giving up. They'll be called 'Oaks of Righteousness,' planted by God to show off his glory. They're going to rebuild the old ruins, and raise up a new city from the wreckage. They'll start over on the ruined cities, taking the rubble left behind and making it brand new. You'll hire outsiders to watch your flocks and foreigners to work your fields, but you'll get the title 'Priests of God,' and be honored as ministers of our God. You'll enjoy the best of what other nations have, and you'll be dripping in their glory. Because you got a double dose of trouble and way more than your fair share of hate, your inheritance in the land will be doubled and your joy will last forever.

'Because I, God, am all about fair play and I hate cheating and crime, I'll pay you what you're owed, on time and in full, and I'll make a forever promise with you. Your kids will be famous everywhere. Your children in other countries will be instantly recognized as the people I have blessed.'

I'm going to sing for joy in God, just explode with praise from the bottom of my soul! He dressed me up in a suit of salvation, and decked me out in a robe of righteousness, like a groom in a tux or a bride in her sparkly tiara. Because just like the earth bursts with spring wildflowers, and a garden is overflowing with blossoms, the Master, God, makes righteousness bloom and puts praise on display for all the nations to see.

Isaiah.title: Jerusalem's Epic Glow Up
paragraphs: Yo, when it comes to Zion, I just can't stay quiet. For Jerusalem, I'm not holding back until her goodness shines like the sun and her rescue is like a blazing torch. All the other nations will see how good you are, and their leaders will see your glory. You're gonna get a new name directly from God. You'll be like a sick crown in God's hand, a super fancy cup held up by your God. Nobody's gonna call you 'Rejected' anymore, and your home won't be called 'Ruined' either. You'll be 'Hephzibah' (which means 'My Delight'), and your land will be 'Beulah' (meaning 'Married'). That's because God is super into you, and your land is gonna be like a huge wedding party. Just like a guy marries his girl, your creator is marrying you. And just like a groom is stoked about his bride, your God is so happy with you.

I've put guards on your walls, Jerusalem. They're on it 24/7, praying, shouting out, reminding God of his promises. They're not gonna give him a break until he does what he said he would, until he makes Jerusalem famous, like the 'City of Praise'.

God made a serious promise, and he's not backing down. He said, 'I'm never again gonna let your enemies raid your food storage and take your stuff. And foreigners won't be drinking the wine you worked so hard to make. Nope. The farmers who grow the food will get to eat it and thank God for it. And the winemakers will drink their wine in my holy places.'

Alright, head out the gates. Let's go! Get the road ready for everyone. Build the highway, get it done! Clear out all the junk, and raise a flag high so everyone can see it! And yeah, God has sent a message to the whole world: 'Tell Zion, 'Look! Your Savior is coming, and he's ready to do what he promised.' And Zion will get all new names: 'Holy People,' 'God's Redeemed,' 'Sought-After,' and 'City That's Not Abandoned.'

Isaiah.title: God's EPIC Comeback & The People Who Forgot
paragraphs: The watchmen are like, “Yo, who’s that coming from Edom? From Bozrah, with the drip all dyed red? Who are you, looking so fire, walking in with all that power?”
“It’s me. I say what’s real, and I’m a beast at saving people.”
“Aight, but for real, why are your clothes so red? Like you’ve been stomping on grapes or something?”

“I’ve been doing this all by myself. No one was there to back me up. I was so mad, I stomped on them like grapes; I was raging, I trampled them. Their blood went everywhere, my clothes are soaked. I was out for revenge. It was time to set things right. I looked for someone to help, but there was no one. I was shook, not a single person stepped up. So I just did it myself, my anger was my fuel. I trampled people because I was so mad, crushed them in my rage, and their blood just soaked the ground.”

I’m gonna list out all the awesome things God has done, all the stuff He deserves praise for. All the crazy generous things God’s done, His major goodness to Israel—He showed so much compassion, His love was on another level. He was like, “For sure, these are my people, my kids who would never do me dirty.” So He became their Savior. In all their struggles, He was struggling too. He didn’t send some rando to help them. He did it Himself, in person. Out of His own love and pity, He saved them. He rescued them and carried them for a super long time.
But then they switched up on Him; they made His Holy Spirit sad. So He turned on them, became their enemy, and fought them.

Then they started remembering the old days, back when Moses, God’s servant, was around: “Where’s the one who brought the shepherds of his flock up out of the sea? And what happened to the One who put His Holy Spirit in them? Who was right there with Moses, split the sea in front of them, and got famous forever for it, and led them through the deep, muddy water like it was nothing, like a horse on a flat road? Like a bunch of cows being led to a field, the Spirit of God gave them a break.”

That’s how you led your people! That’s how you got so famous! Look down from heaven, look at us! Look out the window of your holy and awesome house! What happened to your passion, your famous power moves, your deep pity, your compassion? Why you holding back? You’re our Father. Abraham and Israel are long gone. They wouldn’t even know who we are. But you’re our living Father, our Redeemer, famous since forever! Why, God, did you let us wander from your ways? Why did you make us so cold and stubborn that we stopped worshiping you like we should? Come back for us, your servants. You own us! We’re yours! For a little while your holy people were living good, but now our enemies have trashed your holy place. For a long time now, you’ve been ignoring us. It’s like you never even knew us.

Isaiah.title: God, Are You Gonna Leave Us on Read?
paragraphs: Yo, God, if you would just rip open the sky and come down, the mountains would totally shake. Like when a forest fire starts, or when water starts boiling like crazy. Your enemies would be shook and every country would be trembling. You've done some wild things we never saw coming, came down and made the mountains quake. Seriously, since the beginning of time, nobody has ever seen or heard of a God like you who shows up for those who wait for you. You connect with people who are actually happy to do the right thing and remember how you work. But you've been so mad at us. We messed up and just kept messing up for way too long. Is there even any hope for us? Can we be saved? We're all infected with sin, totally contaminated. Even our best tries are like dirty, greasy rags. We're like dried-up leaves in the fall, just blown away by the wind because of our sin. Nobody's even trying to pray to you or reach out, because you've turned your back on us and left us to deal with our own mess.

But still, God, you're our Father. We're the clay and you're the potter; you made all of us. Please don't be so mad at us, God. Don't keep a record of everything we've done wrong. Remember, we're your people—all of us. Your holy cities are like ghost towns now. Zion is a ghost town, and Jerusalem is just a field of weeds. Our holy and beautiful Temple, where our ancestors used to praise you, was burned to the ground. All our beautiful parks and gardens are ruined. After all this, are you just going to sit there and do nothing, God? Aren't you going to say something? Haven't you let us suffer long enough?

Isaiah.title: God's Epic Refresh: New Heaven, New Earth, No More Cringe
paragraphs: I’ve been making myself available to people who weren’t even asking, ready to be found by those who didn’t even look. I kept saying, ‘Here I am, right here!’ to a nation that was straight up ignoring me. I reached out day after day to a crew that turned their backs on me, people who were constantly making wrong turns and insisting on doing things their own way. They get on my last nerve, being rude to my face 24/7, inventing their own DIY, potluck-style religion. They hang out in tombs overnight trying to get messages from the dead, eat forbidden food, and drink some sketchy witch’s brew. Then they have the nerve to say, ‘Keep your distance. Don’t touch me. I’m holier than you.’ These people are so cringe, I can’t stand their vibe. Look, I’ve got the receipts—their sins are all written down in front of me. I’m done with this. I’m going to pay them what they’ve earned for their sins. And for their parents’ sins lumped in? That’s a bonus,” says God. “Because they’ve been practicing their blasphemous worship, mocking me at their hillside shrines, I’m about to unleash the consequences and pay them back in full for their actions.
God’s Message:

“But hold up, just because there are a few bad apples doesn’t mean the whole batch is ruined; there are still plenty of good ones left. So I’m going to protect those in Israel who actually listen to me. I’m not going to destroy the whole nation. I’ll bring out my true descendants from Jacob and the heirs of my mountains from Judah. My chosen ones will inherit the land, and my servants will move in. The awesome valley of Sharon in the west will be a pasture for their flocks, and the valley of Achor in the east will be a place for their herds to chill. This is for the people who actually bothered to reach out to me, who wanted me in their lives, and who made an effort to find me.

“But as for you who ghosted me, your God, who forgot about the holy mountains, who throw dinner parties for Lady Luck and host cocktail hours for Sir Fate… well, you played yourselves. Your fate? It’s death. Because when I invited you, you left me on read; when I spoke, you tuned me out. You did the very things I said were evil and chose what I hate.”
Therefore, this is the Message from the Master, God:

“My servants will eat, but you’ll be starving. My servants will drink, but you’ll be thirsty. My servants will be celebrating, while you’ll be hanging your heads in shame. My servants will laugh from pure joy, but you’ll be crying from a broken heart, wailing from a crushed spirit. Your name will become a curse word that my chosen people use. I, God, will put you to death and give my servants a new name. Then whoever gives a blessing in the land will do it in my faithful name, and whoever makes a promise will swear by my faithful name, because all the old troubles are gone and forgotten, totally out of my sight.

“Now, pay close attention: I’m creating a new heaven and a new earth. All the old troubles, chaos, and pain will be a thing of the past, completely forgotten. Look forward with joy. Get hyped for what I’m creating: I’m going to create Jerusalem to be pure joy and my people to be a total delight. I’ll find joy in Jerusalem and delight in my people. You won’t hear sounds of crying in the city anymore, no more cries of pain. No more babies dying young or old people not living a full life. Turning 100 will be the new normal—anything less will feel like you got cheated. People will build houses and actually live in them. They’ll plant fields and eat the food they grow. No more building a house just for someone else to take it over, no more planting fields for enemies to raid. My people will live as long as trees, and my chosen ones will get satisfaction from their work. They won’t work for nothing, and they won’t have their kids snatched away from them. They are a generation blessed by God, and their kids and grandkids are blessed too. Before they even call out to me, I’ll answer. While they’re still speaking, I’ll have already heard them. The wolf and the lamb will graze together, the lion and the ox will eat straw from the same trough, but snakes? They’ll be eating dirt. No one and nothing will hurt or destroy anyone on my holy mountain,” says God.

Isaiah.title: God's Final Mic Drop
paragraphs: God's message is this:

"Yo, heaven is my throne, and the whole earth is just my footstool. So what kind of house could you possibly build for me? What kind of vacation spot could you set aside for me? I made all of this! I own it all!" says God. "But here's what I'm actually looking for: someone who is humble and simple, who takes what I say seriously and respectfully.

"Your acts of 'worship' are actually just sinful. Killing an ox for a sacrifice is no different than murdering your neighbor. Your offerings are like dumping pig's blood on the altar. Your memorial gifts are like honoring a fake god. You choose to worship in a way that serves yourselves, and you love it—it's disgusting! So, I'm choosing to call out your nonsense and make your worst fears come true. Because when I invited you, you ghosted me. When I spoke, you ignored me. You did the very things I said were evil and chose what I hate."

But listen up, you who actually respect God's Word: "Your own families hate you and kick you out because of me. They make fun of you, saying, 'Let's see God's glory! If God is so great, why aren't you happy?' But they're the ones who are going to end up embarrassed."
There are loud rumbles from the city! A voice from the Temple! It's the voice of God, serving up judgment to his enemies:

"Before she even went into labor, she had the baby. Before the contractions hit, she delivered a son. Has anyone ever heard of something like that? Has anyone seen anything like it? A whole country born in a single day? A nation born in a flash? But Zion was barely in labor when she had her babies! Do I open the womb and then not deliver the baby? Do I, the one who delivers babies, close the womb?"

"So rejoice, Jerusalem, and everyone who loves her, celebrate! And all of you who have cried over her, come and join in the happy singing. You newborns can get your fill at her nurturing breasts. Yes, enjoy yourselves and drink as much as you want from her."
God's message:

"I'm going to pour out well-being on her like a river, and the glory of nations like a flooding river. You'll nurse at her breasts, be held close in her arms, and bounced on her knees. I will comfort you like a mother comforts her child. You will be comforted in Jerusalem."

"You'll see all this and be so happy—you'll feel like you're on top of the world—as it becomes obvious that God is on your side and against his enemies. Because God is coming like a wildfire, and his chariots are like a tornado. He's bringing a furious outburst of anger, a fierce and fiery punishment. Because God is bringing judgment by fire, a death sentence for the human race. And many, so many, are under God's death sentence:
"All who enter the sacred groves for those secret, unholy rituals that end with a disgusting meal of pigs and mice will all eat together and then die together." This is God's decree.

"I know everything they've ever done or thought. I'm going to come and gather everyone—all nations, all languages. They'll come and see my glory. I'll set up a sign in the center of it all. I'll send the survivors of my judgment all over the world: to Spain and Africa, to Turkey and Greece, and to the faraway islands that have never even heard of me, who know nothing about what I've done or who I am. I'll send them out as missionaries to tell everyone about my glory. They'll bring back all your long-lost brothers and sisters from all over the world. They'll bring them on horses, in wagons and carts, on mules and camels, straight to my holy mountain in Jerusalem," says God. "They'll present them as a living act of worship to God, just like the Israelites present their offerings in a special container in the Temple of God. I'll even choose some of them to be priests and Levites," says God.

"Because just as the new heavens and the new earth that I'm making will last forever before me"—this is God's decree—"so will your children and your reputation last forever. Every month and every week, everyone will come to worship me," says God.

"And then they'll go out and see what happened to those who rebelled against me. Dead bodies! Maggots will be eating them endlessly, and they'll be fuel for fires that never go out. Everyone who sees it and smells the stench will be sick to their stomach."

Jeremiah.title: God's Got Big Plans for You, Bro
paragraphs: This is the message from Jeremiah, son of Hilkiah. He was from a family of priests living in a town called Anathoth, in the Benjamin area. God started talking to him in the thirteenth year that Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah. He kept getting messages during the time Jehoiakim, son of Josiah, was king, and it continued all the way to the fifth month of the eleventh year that Zedekiah, son of Josiah, was king of Judah. That was the year Jerusalem's people were captured and taken away. This is what God said:

"Yo, before you were even a thought in your mom's head, I knew you. Before you were even born, I had huge plans for you. I'm talking prophet-to-the-nations level stuff. That's what I had in mind for you."
But I was like, "Whoa, hold up, God! Look at me. I'm just a kid. I don't know what I'm doing."
But I was like, "Whoa, hold up, God! Look at me. I'm just a kid. I don't know what I'm doing."

God told me, "Don't give me that 'I'm just a kid' excuse. I'll tell you where to go, and you'll go. I'll tell you what to say, and you'll say it. Don't be scared of anyone. I've got your back, for real." That's what God said.

God told me, "Don't give me that 'I'm just a kid' excuse. I'll tell you where to go, and you'll go. I'll tell you what to say, and you'll say it. Don't be scared of anyone. I've got your back, for real." That's what God said.

Then God reached out, touched my mouth, and said, "There. I just put my words in your mouth, fresh from the source. See what I did? You've got a big job to do, dealing with nations and governments. This is a huge day for you. Your job is to pull things up, tear them down, take them apart, and demolish them. And then, you'll start over, building and planting new things."

Then God reached out, touched my mouth, and said, "There. I just put my words in your mouth, fresh from the source. See what I did? You've got a big job to do, dealing with nations and governments. This is a huge day for you. Your job is to pull things up, tear them down, take them apart, and demolish them. And then, you'll start over, building and planting new things."
God's message came to me: "What do you see, Jeremiah?" I said, "A walking stick—that's all." And God said, "Good eyes! I'm sticking with you. I'll make every word I give you come true."

God's message came again: "So what do you see now?" I said, "I see a boiling pot, tipped down toward us." Then God told me, "Disaster will pour out of the north on everyone living in this land. Watch for this: I'm calling all the kings out of the north." God's Decree.

"They'll come and set up their headquarters right in front of Jerusalem's gates, all around the city walls, and in all the towns of Judah. I'm going to lay down my judgment on the people of Judah for leaving me. It was a terrible thing to do. They started chasing after other gods, giving them offerings, and worshiping things they made themselves, like carved sticks and painted stones."

"They'll come and set up their headquarters right in front of Jerusalem's gates, all around the city walls, and in all the towns of Judah. I'm going to lay down my judgment on the people of Judah for leaving me. It was a terrible thing to do. They started chasing after other gods, giving them offerings, and worshiping things they made themselves, like carved sticks and painted stones."
"But you, get up and get ready for work. Stand up and say everything I tell you to say. Don't hold back, or I'll have to take you out of the game."
"But you, get up and get ready for work. Stand up and say everything I tell you to say. Don't hold back, or I'll have to take you out of the game."

"Now, pay attention while I get you ready. I'm making you as strong as a fortress, as unmovable as a steel pole, and as solid as a concrete wall. You're going to be a one-man army against this whole culture, against the kings and princes of Judah, against the priests and the local leaders. They'll try to fight you, but they won't even leave a scratch. I'll be there for you every step of the way." That's what God said.

Jeremiah.title: God's Got Beef With His People
paragraphs: God's message hit me. It went like this:

"Go and shout this all over Jerusalem: 'God's message! I remember how loyal you were when you were young, like our honeymoon phase. You stuck with me through the wilderness, through all the rough patches. Israel was supposed to be my special possession, the best of the best. Anyone who messed with you would regret it big time!' That's God's decree.

Hear God's message, all you people of Jacob and Israel! God is asking: "What did your ancestors find wrong with me that made them drift so far away? They started chasing empty things and became empty themselves. They never bothered to ask, 'Where's the God who got us out of Egypt, who guided us through that gnarly wilderness—a land of deserts and death traps, a place nobody wanted to be?'

I brought you into a paradise, a land full of good things to eat. But you came in and trashed my land, you totally defiled my special place. The priests never asked, 'Where's God?' The religious experts didn't know me. The leaders rebelled against me. The prophets were busy hyping up a fake god, Baal, chasing after worthless idols and silly ideas.

Because of all this, I'm calling you out," says God. "I'm calling out you, your kids, and your grandkids. Just look around. Have you ever seen anything like this? Go check the islands in the west, or the deserts in the east. Look closely. Has any nation ever traded its gods for fake ones that aren't even gods? But my people have traded my glory for worthless idols and silly schemes.

Heavens, be shocked by this! Be horrified!" God declares. "My people have messed up twice. First, they abandoned me, the source of fresh, life-giving water. Then, they dug their own wells—broken wells that can't even hold water.

Isn't Israel supposed to be a treasured member of my family? So how did they end up getting torn apart by enemies like lions, left with nothing but ruins? Even the Egyptians have crushed you. And why did this happen? Because you walked away from your God right when he was leading you down the right path.

And what do you hope to gain by running to Egypt or Assyria? A drink from their rivers? No, your own evil will punish you. Your disloyalty will have bitter consequences. You need to see how terrible it was to abandon your God," says the Lord, the God of Angel Armies.

"A long time ago, you threw off my guidance. You said, 'I won't follow you!' and went off to worship every false god you could find, like a prostitute. I planted you as a top-quality vine, the best stock available. But look at you now—a tangled, rotten mess. You can scrub yourself with the strongest soap, but the stain of your sin is still there, and I can't even look at you," says the Lord God.

"How can you even say, 'I'm not dirty; I haven't chased after false gods'? Just look at the evidence you left behind in the valley. You're like a restless camel or a wild donkey in heat, desperately sniffing the air for a mate. Who could control you? You're obsessed, always chasing after more.
"Slow down. What's the rush? Why are you wearing yourself out chasing these things? But you say, 'It's no use. I'm addicted to these foreign gods. I can't stop.'

"Just like a thief is ashamed when caught, the people of Israel are ashamed—their kings, officials, priests, and prophets. They say to a piece of wood, 'You are my father,' and to a stone, 'You gave me birth.' They've turned their backs on me. But when trouble hits, they come running, crying, 'Get up and save us!' Well, where are the gods you made for yourselves? Let them save you. You have more gods than you have towns, Judah.
"Why are you complaining to me when you're the ones who rebelled?" God asks. "I tried to discipline your children, but they wouldn't listen. You've killed the prophets I sent to you.

"What a generation you are! Have I been like a desert to you, Israel? A land of darkness? Why do my people say, 'We're on our own now; we're not coming back to you'? Does a young woman forget her jewelry, or a bride her wedding dress? Yet my people have forgotten me for days without end.

"You're so good at chasing after what you want; you could teach a masterclass in evil. Your clothes are stained with the blood of the innocent poor you've crushed. You didn't even catch them doing anything wrong. And yet you say, 'I'm innocent. God's not mad at me.' But I am bringing judgment against you for saying you haven't sinned.

"You change your loyalties so easily. But Egypt will let you down, just like Assyria did. You will walk away from there in shame, because I, the Lord, have rejected those you trust. You won't get any help from them."

Jeremiah.title: God's Got Beef: The Cheating Scandal
paragraphs: God's message hit me, and this is what it said:

"Okay, real talk: if a dude's wife just dips and marries some other guy, can he just welcome her back like, 'Hey, what's up?' No way, right? That would be a whole scandal in the country. And lowkey, isn't that exactly what you've done? You've been messing around with every fake god you could find. And now you have the audacity to come back like it's all cool?" That's a direct quote from God.

"Just look around at the hills. Is there a single place you haven't been unfaithful? You've been out there waiting for lover-gods like a hunter waiting for prey. You've been chasing after them like a prostitute looking for customers. That's why the rain stopped. No more showers from the sky! But you're not even bothered. You're so shameless, acting like you did nothing wrong. And then you have the nerve to hit me up like, 'My Father! You were always there for me when I was young. What about now? Are you gonna stay mad forever?' That's your go-to line, but then you just keep on sinning without a break."

"Just look at the hills. Is there a single place you haven't been unfaithful? You've been out there waiting for lover-gods like a hunter waiting for prey. You've been chasing after them like a prostitute looking for customers. That's why the rain stopped. No more showers from the sky! But you're not even bothered. You're so shameless, acting like you did nothing wrong. And then you have the nerve to hit me up like, 'My Father! You were always there for me when I was young. What about now? Are you gonna stay mad forever?' That's your go-to line, but then you just keep on sinning without a break."

During King Josiah's time, God said to me: "You've seen it, right? How two-timing Israel went and worshiped idols on every hill and under every tree, like a total cheater. I really thought that after she got it all out of her system, she'd come back to me. But she never did. And her flaky sister, Judah, saw the whole thing. She saw that I dumped unfaithful Israel and served her divorce papers because she was so morally bankrupt. But that didn't even scare flaky Judah. She went out, bold as ever, and started living the same cheating life. She treated her religion and relationship with me like some cheap hobby, messing around with anyone and anything, completely disrespecting what's sacred and making the whole country stink. And through all this, flaky Judah didn't even give me a real thought, even though she put on a show every now and then." That's God's decree.
Then God told me, "Honestly, two-timing Israel looks way better than flaky Judah. Go and preach this message. Face north toward Israel and say:

"'Come back, you unfaithful Israel. I'm not just waiting to punish you. I'm committed to you out of love. My anger doesn't last forever. Just own up to what you did. Admit you defied your God. Admit you've been hooking up with random foreign gods under the trees and totally ignoring me.'" That's God's decree. "'Come back, you lost kids!'" God's decree. "'I am your true husband. I'll pick you out one by one—one from this city, two from that town—and I'll bring you to Zion. I'll give you good leaders, shepherds who follow my ways, who will lead you with smarts and wisdom.'

"And here's what's gonna happen: You're gonna grow in number and thrive in the land. The time is coming"—God's decree!—"when no one will be talking about, 'Oh, the good old days with the Ark of the Covenant.' It won't even cross their minds to say it. Those so-called 'good old days' of the Ark are over for good.
"Jerusalem itself will be the new Ark—it'll be called 'God's Throne.' All the nations that don't know God will gather there to honor Him, and they won't be stuck in their old, evil habits anymore.
"In that time, the family of Judah will team up with the family of Israel. They'll walk hand-in-hand out of the northern lands and come back to the land I promised to your ancestors.

"I had this whole speech planned for when you came back to me. I was gonna say: 'Awesome! I'll bring you back into the family. I'll give you the best land, a place all the other nations would kill for.' And I imagined you'd call me 'Dear Father!' and would never leave me again. But nope. Like a wife who cheats on her husband, you, the whole family of Israel, have been totally unfaithful to me." God's decree.

You can hear voices coming from the hills, the sad sound of Israel crying, mourning all the wasted years when they never gave their God a single thought. "Come back, you wandering children! I can fix your unfaithfulness!"

You can hear voices coming from the hills, the sad sound of Israel crying, mourning all the wasted years when they never gave their God a single thought. "Come back, you wandering children! I can fix your unfaithfulness!"

"We're here! We're coming back to you. You are our one true God! All that other popular religion was just a cheap fake, with crowds getting tricked into buying the newest trendy gods. We're back! We're back to our true God, the one who saves Israel. That Fraud took everything from us, scammed us out of the inheritance our ancestors left, and ripped off our God-given flocks and kids. We made our bed, and now we have to lie in it, tangled up in the dirty sheets of our own shame. It's all because we sinned against our God, us and our parents before us. From the moment we could walk and talk, we've been rebels, straight-up disobeying the voice of our God."

Jeremiah.title: God's ANGER Issues Are Next Level
paragraphs: “Yo, Israel, if you’re serious about coming back to me, you gotta actually come back. Ditch all that gross stuff you’ve been worshiping and stop wandering off. Then, when you say stuff like, ‘As God lives,’ it’ll actually mean something real and right. And all the other nations will get in on the blessing and see something in you worth talking about.”

Here’s another message from God for the people of Judah and Jerusalem: “Get your unplowed fields ready, but don’t plant weeds in them! Seriously, dedicate your lives to God. Soften up those hard hearts, all you people of Judah and Jerusalem. You gotta stop my anger from turning into a wildfire, because once it starts, it’s not going out. Your wicked lifestyle is the fuel for that fire.

“Sound the alarm in Judah, shout it out in Jerusalem! Tell everyone to blow the trumpets all over the country! Yell it out loud: ‘Everyone, group up! Run to the fortified cities for safety!’ Signal a warning to Zion: ‘Hurry, don’t wait!’ A huge disaster is coming from the north, and I’m the one sending it. It’s gonna be devastating. An invader is coming like a lion out of its den, a destroyer of nations. It’s on the move to wreck your land, leave your cities in ruins, and make them ghost towns. So put on black clothes, cry your eyes out, because God’s crazy anger is coming right for us.
“When that happens,” God says, “the king and his officials will totally lose it, the priests will be clueless, and the prophets will be speechless.”
Then I was like, “Oh man, Lord GOD! You totally tricked this people and Jerusalem. You told them, ‘Everything’s gonna be fine,’ right when a sword was at their throats.”

At that time, this is what will be told to this people, to Jerusalem: “A scorching wind is blowing in from the desert, heading for my people. It’s not a gentle breeze for winnowing grain; it’s a full-on gale-force wind that I’ve commanded. I’m about to drop my hurricane-level judgment on them.”

Look at them coming! They look like a huge bank of storm clouds. Their chariots are like a tornado, and their horses are faster than eagles! We’re so screwed! We’re done for! Jerusalem, you gotta wash the evil out of your heart so you can be saved. How much longer are you gonna let those twisted, evil thoughts hang around in your head?

Listen! A messenger is coming from Dan, bringing bad news from the hills of Ephraim! Announce it to the nations, broadcast it to Jerusalem: “Invaders are coming from a distant land, and they’re shouting war cries against the towns of Judah. They’re surrounding the city like guards watching a field, because she rebelled against me,” says the LORD.
“It’s your own lifestyle and your own actions that brought this on you. This is your punishment, and it’s a bitter one. It’s a pain that cuts straight to your heart.”

I’m doubled over in pain, my stomach is in knots. My heart is pounding inside me, I can’t keep quiet. I hear the sound of the trumpet, the battle cry for war. It’s one disaster after another; the whole land is in ruins! My home was destroyed in a second, my tents torn down in an instant. How long do I have to see the war flags and hear the trumpets of danger?
“My people are such idiots! They don’t even know who I am. They’re a bunch of clueless kids, total morons. They’re pros at doing evil, but they have no idea how to do good.”

I looked at the earth, and it was a total mess, completely empty, like before creation. I looked at the sky, and there were no stars. I looked at the mountains, and they were shaking, and all the hills were swaying back and forth. I looked, and there was no one left, not a single person. All the birds in the sky were gone. I looked, and the fertile land had become a desert. All the towns were destroyed. And it was all because of the LORD, because of his burning anger.

Yes, this is what the LORD says: “The whole land will be destroyed, but I won’t completely wipe it out. The earth will be in mourning, and the sky will be dark, because I have spoken, and I’m not taking it back. I’ve made my decision, and I’m not changing my mind.”

At the sound of the horsemen and archers, everyone is running for their lives. They’re hiding in the thickets and climbing up into the rocky cliffs. All the towns are abandoned; not a single person is left.

And you, what do you think you’re doing? Why are you putting on your fancy red dress and all your gold jewelry? Why are you putting on so much makeup? You’re making yourself beautiful for nothing. Your lovers despise you; they want to kill you. I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a scream like someone giving birth to her first child. It’s the cry of Daughter Zion, gasping for breath, stretching out her hands and saying, “Help me! I’m about to die! The murderers are all around me!”

Jeremiah.title: God's Looking for ONE Good Person...Can He Find One?
paragraphs: Yo, go patrol the streets of Jerusalem. Look around, take notes. Search the market squares. See if you can find just one person, a single soul, who does what's right and tries to live a true life. I want to forgive that person. That's God's decree. But if all they do is say, 'As sure as God lives...' they're nothing but a bunch of liars.

But you, God, you have an eye for truth, don't you? You hit them hard, but it didn't even faze them. You disciplined them, but they refused to be corrected. They're hardheaded, harder than a rock; they wouldn't change. Then I said to myself, 'Well, these are just poor people. They don't know any better. They were never taught anything about God. They never went to prayer meetings. I'll go find some people from the best families. I'll talk to them. They'll know what's going on, the way God works. They'll know the score.' But they were no better! They were all rebels, off doing their own thing. The invaders are ready to pounce and kill, like a mountain lion, a wilderness wolf, or panthers on the prowl. The streets aren't safe anymore. And why? Because the people's sins are piled sky-high; their betrayals are past counting.

I satisfied their deepest needs, and then they went off with the 'sacred' whores, left me for orgies in sex shrines! A bunch of well-groomed, lusty stallions, each one pawing and snorting for his neighbor's wife. Do you think I'm going to stand around and do nothing? That's God's decree. Don't you think I'll take serious measures against a people like this?

Don't you think I'll take serious measures against a people like this?

Go down the rows of vineyards and rip out the vines, but not all of them. Leave a few. Prune back those vines! That growth didn't come from God! They've betrayed me over and over again, both Judah and Israel. That's God's decree.

They've spread lies about God. They've said, 'There's nothing to him. Nothing bad will happen to us, neither famine nor war will come our way. The prophets are all windbags. They speak nothing but nonsense.'

They've spread lies about God. They've said, 'There's nothing to him. Nothing bad will happen to us, neither famine nor war will come our way. The prophets are all windbags. They speak nothing but nonsense.'
Therefore, this is what God said to me, God-of-the-Angel-Armies:
Because they have talked this way, they are going to eat those words. Watch now! I'm putting my words as fire in your mouth. And the people are a pile of kindling ready to go up in flames.

Attention! I'm bringing a far-off nation against you, O house of Israel. That's God's decree. A solid nation, an ancient nation, a nation that speaks another language. You won't understand a word they say. When they aim their arrows, you're as good as dead. They're a nation of real fighters! They'll clean you out of house and home, rob you of crops and children alike. They'll feast on your sheep and cattle, strip your vines and fig trees. And the fortresses that made you feel so safe—leveled with a stroke of the sword!

Attention! I'm bringing a far-off nation against you, O house of Israel. That's God's decree. A solid nation, an ancient nation, a nation that speaks another language. You won't understand a word they say. When they aim their arrows, you're as good as dead. They're a nation of real fighters! They'll clean you out of house and home, rob you of crops and children alike. They'll feast on your sheep and cattle, strip your vines and fig trees. And the fortresses that made you feel so safe—leveled with a stroke of the sword!

Even then, as bad as it will be—that's God's decree!—it will not be the end of the world for you. And when people ask, 'Why did our God do all this to us?' you must say to them, 'This is back on you. Just as you left me and served foreign gods in your own country, so now you must serve foreigners in their own country.'

Tell the house of Jacob this, put out this bulletin in Judah: Listen to this, you scatterbrains, airheads, with eyes that see but don't really look, and ears that hear but don't really listen. Why don't you honor me? Why aren't you in awe before me? Yes, me, who made the shorelines to contain the ocean waters. I drew a line in the sand that cannot be crossed. Waves roll in but cannot get through; breakers crash but that's the end of them. But this people—what a people! Uncontrollable, untamable runaways. It never occurs to them to say, 'How can we honor our God with our lives, the God who gives rain in both spring and autumn and maintains the rhythm of the seasons, who sets aside time each year for harvest and keeps everything running smoothly for us?' Of course you don't! Your bad behavior blinds you to all this. Your sins keep my blessings at a distance.

My people are infiltrated by wicked men, unscrupulous men on the hunt. They set traps for the unsuspecting. Their victims are innocent men and women. Their houses are stuffed with ill-gotten gain, like a hunter's bag full of birds. Pretentious and powerful and rich, hugely obese, oily with rolls of fat. Worse, they have no conscience. Right and wrong mean nothing to them. They stand for nothing, stand up for no one, throw orphans to the wolves, exploit the poor. Do you think I'll stand by and do nothing about this? That's God's decree. Don't you think I'll take serious measures against a people like this?

Unspeakable! Sickening! What's happened in this country? Prophets preach lies and priests hire on as their assistants. And my people love it. They eat it up! But what will you do when it's time to pick up the pieces?

Jeremiah.title: Jerusalem Is SO Canceled
paragraphs: “Yo, people of Benjamin, you gotta bounce! Get out of Jerusalem, like, right now! Sound the alarm in Tekoa, send up smoke signals from Beth Hakkerem. Something terrible is coming from the north, it's gonna be a total nightmare. I thought my girl Zion was like a beautiful, peaceful field. But now, these enemy ‘shepherds’ have found her and are bringing in their whole crew of soldiers. They’ve set up camp all around her, deciding who gets to ‘graze’ where. And then they’re like, ‘Let’s get ready to fight! Attack! We’ll hit ‘em at noon! Oh wait, it’s getting late? The sun’s going down? The evening shadows are getting long? Whatever, let’s go! We’ll attack tonight and wreck their defenses completely.’”
God, the commander of heavenly armies, gave the orders:

“Chop down their trees. Build a ramp to attack Jerusalem, a city that’s just full of cruelty and bursting with violence. You know how a well is always full of water? That’s how much evil is in her, nonstop. All you hear in the streets are cries of ‘Violence! Assault!’ There are wounded and moaning people everywhere. You’re in some serious trouble, Jerusalem. You’ve pushed me to my absolute limit. You’re about to get totally wiped out and turned into a ghost town.”
More orders from God, the commander of heavenly armies:
“It’s over. Time to harvest the grapes for judgment. Save what’s left of Israel. Go back over the vines and pick them clean, every single grape.

“I have something to say, but is anyone even listening? I’m trying to warn you, but will anyone pay attention? It’s useless! Their ears are basically clogged. They’re deaf and blind to it all. It’s hopeless! They’ve totally tuned God out. They don’t want to hear a thing from me. But I’m so full of God’s anger, I can’t hold it in anymore.

“So just let it all out on the kids in the streets. Unleash it on the groups of young people. Because nobody is safe: husbands and wives will be taken, the elderly and those about to die. Their houses will be given away—everything they own, even their families—when I give the signal against everyone living in this country.” This is God’s official statement.

“So just let it all out on the kids in the streets. Unleash it on the groups of young people. Because nobody is safe: husbands and wives will be taken, the elderly and those about to die. Their houses will be given away—everything they own, even their families—when I give the signal against everyone living in this country.” This is God’s official statement.

“Everyone is just chasing money, from the least important person to the most important. Prophets and priests, all of them, are twisting words and faking the truth. My people are completely broken—shattered!—and they’re just putting on little Band-Aids, saying, ‘It’s cool, you’ll be fine.’ But things are NOT fine! You think they’re embarrassed about all this messed-up stuff? Nah, they have zero shame. They don’t even know how to blush. There’s no hope for them. They’ve hit rock bottom and they’re not getting back up. As far as I’m concerned, they’re done.” God has said it.

“Everyone is just chasing money, from the least important person to the most important. Prophets and priests, all of them, are twisting words and faking the truth. My people are completely broken—shattered!—and they’re just putting on little Band-Aids, saying, ‘It’s cool, you’ll be fine.’ But things are NOT fine! You think they’re embarrassed about all this messed-up stuff? Nah, they have zero shame. They don’t even know how to blush. There’s no hope for them. They’ve hit rock bottom and they’re not getting back up. As far as I’m concerned, they’re done.” God has said it.
God’s message, again:

“Go stand at the crossroads and look around. Ask for the old path, the one that’s been tested and is true. Then take it. Find the right way for your souls. But they said, ‘No way. We’re not going that way.’ I even gave them watchmen to warn them, to sound the alarm. But the people said, ‘That’s a false alarm. It’s not for us.’ So now I’m calling all the nations as witnesses: ‘Watch, you witnesses, what happens to them!’ And, ‘Listen up, Earth! Don’t miss this news.’ I’m bringing a disaster on these people, the direct result of the games they’ve been playing with me. They’ve ignored everything I’ve said and had nothing but disrespect for my teaching. Why would I want your incense from Sheba, or your fancy spices from far away? Your burnt offerings mean nothing to me. Your religious ceremonies are pointless.”
So listen up. Here’s God’s final word on your lifestyle:
“Watch out! I’m putting up roadblocks and obstacles on the path you’re on. They’ll make you trip and fall, parents and kids, neighbors and friends—and that’ll be the end of all of you.”
And listen to this verdict from God:

“Look out! An army is coming from the north, a huge force is on its way from a distant land: They’re heavily armed, cruel, and have no mercy. They sound like a roaring sea storm—tramp, tramp, tramp—riding hard on their war horses, in battle formation, coming right for you, dear Daughter Zion!”

We heard the news, and we just went limp. We’re paralyzed with fear. Terror has us by the throat. Don’t even think about going outside! Don’t leave your house! Death is hunting you. There’s danger everywhere!

We heard the news, and we just went limp. We’re paralyzed with fear. Terror has us by the throat. Don’t even think about going outside! Don’t leave your house! Death is hunting you. There’s danger everywhere!

“Dear Daughter Zion: Put on black clothes. Cover your face with ashes. Cry your eyes out, like you’re mourning for your only child. The countdown has started... six, five, four, three... The Terror is here!”

“Dear Daughter Zion: Put on black clothes. Cover your face with ashes. Cry your eyes out, like you’re mourning for your only child. The countdown has started... six, five, four, three... The Terror is here!”
God gave me this job:

“I’ve made you an examiner for my people, to check out and evaluate their lives. They’re a stubborn, hard-headed crew, totally corrupt, every last one of them. The refining fires are turned up super hot, but the metal just stays a useless lump. It’s pointless to keep trying. You can’t get the evil out of them. People will give up and just call them ‘scrap metal,’ thrown on the scrap heap by me, their God.”

Jeremiah.title: Stop Faking It: God's Calling You Out
paragraphs: A message from God came to Jeremiah, and it was a big one. He had to go stand right at the entrance of God's Temple and just let it rip.
He was told to say, 'Yo, listen up, all you people from Judah coming here to worship. The God of Angel Armies, the God of Israel, is laying it all out for you:

'Straight up, you need to fix your lives—how you're living, what you're doing. If you do that, I can actually hang out with you here. But don't even for a second fall for the lie that everyone's repeating: "This is God's Temple, God's Temple, God's Temple!" That's total garbage. The only way this works is if you actually clean up your act. Like, a full-on spring cleaning of your lives and how you treat other people. Stop taking advantage of immigrants, orphans, and widows. Stop letting innocent people get hurt right here, and for real, stop wrecking your own souls by using my Temple as a cover while you're off chasing other gods. Only then will I actually move into your neighborhood. Only then can this land I gave your ancestors be my forever home, my Temple.

'Seriously, get a clue! Your leaders are feeding you a bunch of lies, and you're just eating them up. Use your brains! Do you really think you can go around stealing, murdering, sleeping with your neighbors' partners, lying 24/7, worshipping fake local gods, and collecting every new religious trend out there—and then just stroll into my Temple, the one set aside for me, and say, "We're good!"? Like the building itself gives you a free pass to keep doing all this messed-up stuff? You think you can turn my house into a hideout for criminals? Yeah, right. I have eyes. I see exactly what's going on,' says God.

'Why don't you take a little road trip to the place in Shiloh, where I first met my people way back in the day? Go look at the ruins. See what I did to it because of how messed up my own people, Israel, were acting.

'So now, because of how you've been living and how you've ignored me, even though I've pulled you aside and talked to you seriously over and over, and because you wouldn't change when I called you to, I'm about to do the same thing to this Temple. This place you think is your safety net, this place I gave to you and your ancestors—I'm going to wreck it, just like I did to Shiloh. And as for you, I'm kicking you out, just like I kicked out your relatives, the people from the northern kingdom of Israel.'

'And Jeremiah, my guy, don't even waste your breath praying for these people. Don't bother asking me for favors or trying to step in for them. Don't even bring it up. I'm not listening. Can't you see what they're doing in all the towns of Judah and on the streets of Jerusalem? The kids are out collecting firewood, the dads are building the fires, and the moms are baking bread to offer to the 'Queen of Heaven'! And if that wasn't bad enough, they're pouring out drinks to any other god they can find, just to tick me off.
'But are they really hurting me?' God asks. 'Or are they just hurting themselves? Making themselves look like total fools?
