Habakkuk.title: God, Are You Even Listening?! My Meltdown with the Almighty
paragraphs: The big problem God showed Habakkuk, and here's how it went down:

God, how long do I have to yell for help before you actually listen? How many times do I have to be like, "Help! Murder! Someone call the cops!" before you step in and do something? Why do you make me look at all this evil, just staring trouble in the face day after day? It's pure chaos and violence, with fights and arguments breaking out all over. The law is basically falling apart, and justice is a total joke. The wicked have the good people cornered, and they've completely twisted what's right.

And God's like, "Look around at the nations that don't follow me. Look long and hard. Get ready for a shock, because something is about to happen that you'll find hard to believe. I'm about to bring in the Babylonians to punish you. Yeah, the Babylonians—they're fierce and ferocious, a world-conquering force, just grabbing up nations left and right. They're a terrifying people who make up their own rules as they go. Their horses are fast as the wind, and they attack like hungry wolves. A whole stampede of them thunders in from out of nowhere. They come down like vultures circling their prey. They are out to kill; death is what they're all about. They collect victims like a squirrel gathers nuts. They mock kings, laugh at generals, spit on fortified cities, and leave them in the dust. They'll be blown away by the wind. They're so bold in their sin that they think their own strength is their god."

God, you're eternal, right? Holy God, we're not all going to die, are we? God, you chose the Babylonians to carry out your judgment? My Rock, my solid foundation, you gave them the job of disciplining us? But you can't be serious! You can't stand evil! So why aren't you doing something about this? Why are you silent right now? This is an outrage! Evil people are swallowing up the righteous, and you just stand there and watch!

You're treating people like fish in the ocean, swimming around without any direction, not really getting anywhere. Then this evil Babylonian comes along and goes fishing. He pulls in a huge catch. He gets his limit and fills his bucket—a great day of fishing for him! He's so happy! He praises his rod and reel, puts his fishing gear on an altar, and worships it! It's made his day, and he's going to eat well tonight!
Are you just going to let this go on and on? Are you going to let this Babylonian fisherman keep fishing like it's a hobby, killing people as if they're nothing more than fish?

Habakkuk.title: God's Response is Coming, Just Wait For It
paragraphs: So, what's God gonna say to all my questions? Honestly, I'm prepping for the worst. I'm gonna go up to my watchtower, scan the horizon, and just wait. I'm waiting to see what God says, how he's gonna answer my complaint.

And then God hit me back: “Write this down. Write what you see. Put it in huge, bold letters so anyone can read it on the fly. This message, this vision, is a preview of what's coming. It’s hyped for its own arrival—it can hardly wait! And it’s no lie. If it seems like it’s taking its sweet time, just wait. It’s on its way. It will show up at the perfect moment.

“Look at that guy, all puffed up with his own ego—so full of himself, but his soul is totally empty. But the person who is right with God because they trust and stick with him? That person is truly alive, like, for real alive.

“And for real, money is a total scam. The arrogant rich people? They never last. They're hungrier for more cash than the grave is for dead bodies. Just like death, they always want more. But the 'more' they collect is just... more death. They're like walking cemeteries of dead nations, graveyards of bodies. Don't even give people like that a second thought. Pretty soon, the whole world will be making fun of them, saying:

“‘Who do you think you are, getting rich by stealing and ripping people off? How long do you think you can get away with it?’ Seriously, how long until the people you’ve crushed wake up, stand up, and make you the one who's getting crushed? You’ve wrecked nation after nation. Now it’s your turn to get a taste of your own medicine. All the survivors are coming to take back what's theirs, as payback for all your violence and killing.

“‘Who do you think you are, grabbing and looting everything, living the high life like you're king of the world, above all the drama and problems? You've basically set up your own downfall. By wrecking others, you've wrecked yourself. You've destroyed your own foundation, and your soul is rotten. The very bricks of your house will call you out, and the woodwork will testify against you.

“‘Who do you think you are, building a city on murder and a town on crime? Don't you get it? The LORD of Heaven’s Armies will make sure all that work just turns to ash. The harder you work at that evil stuff, the less you become. Meanwhile, the whole world is filling up with the knowledge of God's glory, like water covering the sea.

“‘Who do you think you are, getting your neighbors wasted at your parties, pushing drinks on them just to see them naked? You thought you were having the time of your life, but you were wrong. It's your time to be disgraced. While you were busy partying, you were actually drinking from the cup of God's anger. You're going to wake up with a massive hangover—a hangover from the violence in Lebanon, from all the animals you slaughtered, from all the murder and chaos, from violating people and places.

“‘And what's the point of a carved idol, even if it's skillfully made? What good is a fancy metal statue when it just tells you lies? What's the logic in a religious person making a god that can't even speak? Who do you think you are, telling a piece of wood to ‘Wake up,’ or a silent stone to ‘Get up’? Can they teach you anything? They're all surface-level, with nothing on the inside.
“But yo, listen up! God is in his holy Temple! So everyone, be quiet—a holy silence. Just listen.”

Habakkuk.title: Habakkuk's Prayer Goes HARD
paragraphs: A prayer from the prophet Habakkuk, orchestra and all:

God, I've heard the stories our ancestors told about you, and I'm literally stopped in my tracks, down on my knees. Please, do the same awesome stuff for us that you did for them. Work your magic for us like you did for them. And yeah, I know judgment is coming, and you have to do it, but please, don't forget to show some mercy.

God is on the move again, taking that same old salvation road trip. He's coming up from the south, from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. The sky is just blazing with how awesome he is, and the whole world is singing his praises. His brightness is like a sunrise cloud, just exploding and spreading out, with forked lightning shooting out of his hand—like, for real, the power in that fist is insane! Sickness marches ahead of him, and plagues follow right behind. He stops, and the Earth just shakes. He looks around, and whole nations are trembling. The mountains that have been around forever just crumble to pieces, and the ancient hills totally collapse like a popped balloon. The paths God walks are older than the oldest mountains and hills. I saw everyone freaking out, totally panicking. Even the old enemies from the wilderness, Cushan and Midian, were terrified, hoping he wouldn't even look their way.

God, are you mad at the River? Are you angry at the good old River? Were you ticked off at the Sea when you rode your horse and chariot to save everyone? You pulled out your bow and just let a whole bunch of arrows fly. You split the Earth open with rivers. The mountains saw it coming and were twisting in pain. Flood waters just poured in. The ocean roared and made these huge waves. The sun and moon just stopped where they were. Your flashing arrows made them stop, and your lightning-strike spears totally nailed them. You were so angry, you stomped all over the Earth. You were furious, and you crushed the godless nations. You were out there to save your people, to save the ones you specially chose. You beat the living daylights out of the evil king, stripped him bare from head to toe, stuck his own head on his spear, and blew his army away. They were scattered everywhere—and ended up as shark food! You galloped through the Sea on your horses, riding the top of the waves. When I heard all that, my stomach did a complete flip. I was stammering and couldn't even talk right. My bones felt like jelly. I was stumbling all over the place. Now I'm just sitting back, waiting for the end of the world to come down on the people attacking us.

Even if the cherry trees don't bloom and the strawberries don't get ripe, even if the apples are all nasty with worms and the wheat fields are a total fail, even if there are no sheep in the pens and no cows in the barns, I'm still going to be singing joyful praises to God. I'm doing cartwheels of joy for my Savior God. I'm counting on God's plan to win in the end, so I'm feeling brave and getting stronger. I can run like a deer. I feel like I'm the king of the mountain!
(For the whole church to sing, with a full orchestra.)

Zephaniah.title: God's Judgment Day is Coming & It's Gonna Be INTENSE
paragraphs: Alright, so this is a message from God, and it's for this dude Zephaniah. He's the son of Cushi, who's the son of Gedaliah, who's the son of Amariah, who's the son of Hezekiah. This all went down when Josiah, son of Amon, was king of Judah.
God's dropping a decree, and it's intense. He's like, 'I'm about to totally wipe the earth clean, like a full-on deep clean.'
'I'm talking everyone and everything—dudes, girls, animals, even birds and fish. Anything that's causing people to mess up, it's gone. But yeah, especially the people.'

'I'm starting with Judah and everyone in Jerusalem. I'm gonna get rid of all the sketchy stuff, like those weird Baal shrines and their priests. And those people who go up on their roofs at night to worship stars? They're out. Same for the people who say they worship God but are also praying to other gods just in case. And don't even get me started on the ones who've totally ghosted God and don't even think about him anymore.'

'Yo, be quiet! Show some respect for God, the Master. Time's up. Judgment Day is coming, for real. The Holy Day is set, and the guests are ready. On that day, I'm gonna deal with the leaders and the princes, and anyone dressing up like foreign priests and priestesses, bringing in all their weird prayers. And I'm gonna deal with everyone who's bringing in superstitions that are turning holy places into a mess. Judgment Day is coming, for real!' God's decree! 'You're gonna hear panic from the Fish Gate, screams from the Second Quarter, and crashing from the hills! All you shopkeepers on Market Street, you better cry, 'cause your money-making days are over. The god of money is dead. On Judgment Day, I'm gonna search every corner of Jerusalem. I'll find all those lazy people who are just sitting around, thinking, 'God doesn't do anything, good or bad. He's not involved, so why should we be?' But just you wait. They're gonna lose everything—their money, their houses, their land. They'll build houses and never live in them. They'll plant vineyards and never even get to taste the wine.'

'The great Judgment Day of God is almost here. It's the final countdown... seven, six, five, four... It's gonna be a bitter and loud day, even the tough guys will be screaming for help. Judgment Day is payday—and I'm paying out my anger. It's gonna be a day of total chaos and pain, a day of darkness and storms, a day of war cries as cities get attacked. I'm gonna make things so bad, people won't know what hit them. They'll be stumbling around like they're blind. They've sinned against God! Their blood will be poured out like dirty water, and their insides will be thrown out like trash. Don't even think about trying to buy your way out of this. Your money is worthless. This is the Day of God's Judgment—my anger! I'm passionate about getting rid of sin—a fire that will burn up this corrupt world and all the corrupt people in it.'

Zephaniah.title: God's Dropping the Hammer on Everyone
paragraphs: Alright, listen up. You guys need to get it together, for real. You're a nation that's totally clueless. You better shape up before you get blown away like dust in the wind, before God's crazy anger hits you, before the final day of judgment goes down.
So look for God, all you humble people who actually follow his rules. Try to do what's right. Live a quiet, disciplined life. Maybe, just maybe, you'll get a pass on the day God's anger is unleashed.

Gaza is about to be totally wrecked. Ashdod is getting cleared out by noon. Ekron is getting ripped out from the ground up. It's game over for the people by the sea, the folks from Crete. God's word is bad news for you who live in Canaan, the land of the Philistines: 'You're getting destroyed. No one's gonna be left.'

The land by the sea will turn into a big pasture, a place for shepherds and their sheep. The survivors from Judah's family will get it all. They'll let their flocks graze by the sea during the day and then crash in Ashkelon at night. Their own God will watch out for them and make everything good again, just like before.

'I've heard all the nasty things Moab has said, and the insults from Ammon. They've been dissing my people and acting all high and mighty on Israel's borders. So, as sure as I'm the living God,' says the Lord of Angel Armies, Israel's personal God, 'Moab is gonna end up like Sodom, and Ammon like Gomorrah—a field of weeds and a salty wasteland, a total ruin forever. What's left of my people will take them over and clean them out. This is what they get for being so proud and for mocking the people of the God of Angel Armies. God's gonna show them how terrifying he is. All the man-made gods will just shrivel up and disappear. And everyone, no matter where they are, will bow down and worship him. And yeah, you Ethiopians too—you're gonna die. I'll make sure of it.'

Then God's gonna reach up north and destroy Assyria. He'll turn Nineveh into a wasteland, as dry and empty as a desert. That ghost town of a city will be a hangout for wild animals. Raccoons and coyotes will be sleeping in the ruins. Owls will be hooting from the windows, and ravens will be croaking in the doorways. All that fancy woodwork will just be a perch for birds. Is this really that super fun city that thought it was the best, the one that bragged, 'I'm number one! No one's better than me!'? Well, look at it now—a total dump, a place for wild animals. People who walk by just shake their heads and move on.

Zephaniah.title: From Total Mess to Total Blessing
paragraphs: Man, it's over for that rebel city, the one full of bullies—Sewer City, for real. The city that wouldn't take advice, wouldn't accept being called out, wouldn't trust God, and wouldn't even get close to Him. Its own leaders are like hungry lions, its judges are like wolves prowling for their next meal. Its prophets are total fakes, just looking out for themselves. You can't trust them. Its priests disrespect the Sanctuary and twist God's law to mess people up. But God is still there, in the middle of it all, totally righteous and untouched by the evil. He's at it day after day, serving justice. He never stops. But the evil people, with zero shame, just keep on doing their thing.
God says, “I literally wiped out other nations. I tore down their defenses and trashed their streets so no one could pass. Their cities were left completely empty, total ghost towns.”

“I thought, ‘Surely now they’ll respect me, take my advice, and escape the punishment I have planned.’ But nope. It didn't even bother them. They got up bright and early and went right back to their old, messed-up ways.”

“I thought, ‘Surely now they’ll respect me, take my advice, and escape the punishment I have planned.’ But nope. It didn't even bother them. They got up bright and early and went right back to their old, messed-up ways.”

God's decree is like, “Fine, if that's what you want, just wait. Your court date is coming, and I'll be there with the receipts. I'm gathering all the nations and kingdoms to pour out my anger on them. My passion is a fire that will literally purify the whole earth.”

“But in the end, I'm gonna flip the script for the people. I'll give them a pure language, so they can all worship God together, united, working as a team. They'll come from all over, even from beyond the rivers of Ethiopia, praying and bringing offerings. All my scattered, exiled people will come home. You won't have to be ashamed of your rebellious past anymore. I'll get rid of your arrogant leaders. No more flexing on my holy hill. I'll leave a core group of humble people, what's left of Israel, who will truly rely on God. This holy crew won't do wrong. They won't lie or try to manipulate people. They'll be content and live in peace, no anxiety.”

So sing, Zion! Shout it out, Israel! Be happy and celebrate, Jerusalem! God has cancelled the charges against you and made your enemies run. From now on, God is Israel's king, right in the center of everything. You'll never have to fear evil again!

Jerusalem will be told: “Don’t be scared. Dear Zion, don’t give up. Your God is with you; he's a mighty Warrior who is here to save you. He's so happy to have you back. He will calm you with his love and sing over you with joy.”

“The sadness from your time in exile will be gone. I, your God, will get rid of it for you. You've carried that weight long enough. At the same time, I'll deal with everyone who made your life a living nightmare. I'll heal the broken and bring home the lost. In the very places where they were shamed, they will be famous. On that day, I'll bring you all back home—a massive family reunion! You'll be famous and honored all over the world. You'll see it with your own eyes—all those painful goodbyes turned into joyful reunions!” That's God's promise.

Haggai.title: God's Calling You Out: Stop Making Excuses
paragraphs: Alright, so check it. This went down on the first day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius's reign. God's message came through the prophet Haggai, and it was for Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah, and for Joshua, the high priest.
This is what God-of-the-Angel-Armies had to say: 'My people are procrastinating. They're all like, 'Nah, it's not the right time to rebuild God's Temple.''

So a little later, God had more to say, and Haggai laid it all out: 'Oh, so it's the 'right time' for you all to be living in your slick new houses while MY house, the Temple, is a complete wreck? Make it make sense.'
And then God-of-the-Angel-Armies came back with more:

'Yo, take a good, hard look at your lives. Seriously, think about it. You're dropping a ton of cash, but you have basically nothing to show for it. You keep loading up your plates, but you're never actually full. You drink and drink, but you're always thirsty. You're layering up clothes, but you can't get warm. And the people working for you? What are they getting? Pretty much nothing—like a leaky, busted bucket. That's what.'
That's why God-of-the-Angel-Armies said:
'Take a good, hard look at your life. Think it over.'
Then God was like:

'Here’s the plan: Go up to the hills, chop down some trees, and bring the timber back to rebuild the Temple. Do it for me. Show me some respect. You had all these big dreams for yourselves, but it all came to nothing. And the little you did bring to my Temple? I just blew it away—it was nothing.'

'And why?' (This is a message from God-of-the-Angel-Armies, just so you know.) 'It's because while you've all been running around, busy fixing up your own houses, my house is a total ruin. That's why. Because you've been stingy. So I've hit you with a dry summer and a pathetic harvest. I've matched your tight fists with a drought, drying up the fields and hills, making your gardens and orchards wither, and stunting your crops. Nothing—not you, not your animals, not your crops—is gonna thrive.'

Then Zerubbabel the governor, Joshua the high priest, and all the people with them actually listened to the voice of their God. When God sent Haggai the prophet to them, they paid attention. By listening to Haggai, they were showing God respect.
Then Haggai, God's messenger, gave the people God's message: 'I am with you!' That's God's Word.

And that's how God got Zerubbabel, Joshua, and all the people fired up—and they started working on the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies. This all happened on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year of King Darius.

Haggai.title: God's Epic Temple Upgrade Is Coming
paragraphs: On the 21st day of the 7th month, a message from God came through the prophet Haggai. He was told to say this to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and all the people: "Is anyone still around who saw the first Temple in all its glory? And what do you see now? Kinda pathetic, right?
"'So, get to work, Zerubbabel!'—this is God talking.
"'Get to work, Joshua, son of Jehozadak—the high priest!'
"'Get to work, all you people!'—God is saying.

"'Yeah, get to work! Because I am with you.' The God of the Angel Armies is speaking! 'Live out the promise I made with you when you left Egypt. I am literally living and breathing among you right now. Don't be scared. Don't hold back.'

"This is what the God of the Angel Armies said: 'In a little while, I'm going to shake up the sky and the earth, the ocean and the land. I'll shake up all the nations that don't know me. They'll bring tons of wealth, and I will fill this Temple with splendor.' The God of the Angel Armies says so.
"'I own all the silver, and I own all the gold.' A decree from the God of the Angel Armies.

"'This new Temple is going to be way better than the original. It had a glorious start, but the finish will be even more glorious. It will be a place where I give out peace and holiness.' A decree from the God of the Angel Armies.

On the 24th day of the 9th month (this was in the second year of King Darius's reign), God's message came to Haggai again: "The God of the Angel Armies says: 'Ask the priests for a ruling. If someone is carrying a piece of holy meat in their pocket, and that pocket touches some bread, stew, wine, oil, or any other food, does that food become holy too?'"
The priests answered, "No."
Then Haggai asked, "What if someone becomes unclean by touching a dead body, and then they touch one of these foods? Does the food become unclean?"
The priests said, "Yes, it will become unclean."
Then Haggai said, "'That's what this nation is like. Everything they do is unclean. Whatever they offer me is unclean.' God says so.

"'Think about it. Before you started laying the foundation stones for my Temple again, how were things for you? Isn't it true that because you were dragging your feet and only giving a half-hearted effort to rebuild, your crops were also only giving you half of what you expected? I sent drought and disease and hail. Everything you tried to do got messed up. But it didn't even seem to bother you. You just kept ignoring me.' God's decree.

"'Now, think about what's going to happen starting today—this 24th day of the 9th month. From the day the Temple rebuilding started, has anything in your fields—your vines, fig trees, pomegranates, olive trees—failed to grow? From now on, you can expect a blessing.'"
God's message came to Haggai a second time on that same important day, the 24th day of the 9th month: "Speak to Zerubbabel, the governor of Judah:

"'I am about to shake everything up, turn it all upside down, and start over. I will overthrow governments, destroy foreign powers, and get rid of all weapons. I'll throw armies into chaos, and they'll end up fighting each other. And on that day'"—this is God's message—"'I will take you, Zerubbabel, my servant, and I will make you like a signet ring, a symbol of my authority. I've looked everywhere and I've chosen you for this job.'" The message from the God of the Angel Armies.

Zechariah.title: God's Comeback Plan is Lowkey Fire
paragraphs: So, in the second year that Darius was king, around October, God's message hit up the prophet Zechariah (son of Berechiah, who was the son of Iddo). God was like, "I was seriously not happy with your ancestors. So, tell the people this message from the God of Angel Armies: 'Come back to me, and I'll come back to you. Don't be like your parents. The prophets back in the day told them, 'A message from the God of Angel Armies: Drop your messed-up life. Stop the evil stuff you're doing.' But they straight up ignored everything I said, being stubborn and refusing to listen.'

"And where are your ancestors now? Yep, dead and gone. And the prophets who called them out? Also dead and gone. But the message my servants the prophets spoke? That's not dead. That message did a number on your ancestors, didn't it? It woke them up and they came back, saying, 'He did what he said he would do, for real. We didn't get away with anything.'"
On the 24th day of the 11th month, in the second year Darius was king, the message of God was given to the prophet Zechariah, son of Berechiah, son of Iddo:
One night I was looking out and saw a guy on a red horse. He was chilling in the shadows in a grove of birch trees. Behind him were more horses—a red one, a chestnut one, and a white one.
I was like, "Sir, what are these horses doing here? What's the deal with this?"
The Angel-Messenger said, "Let me show you."
Then the rider in the birch grove spoke up, "These are the riders God sent to check things out on earth."
They reported what they found to the Angel of God in the birch grove: "We've checked out the whole earth and everything's calm. It's all under control."
The Angel of God reported back, "O God of the Angel Armies, how long are you going to be mad at Jerusalem and the cities of Judah? When are you going to chill? Hasn't seventy years been long enough?"

God then said some good, comforting words to the Angel-Messenger, who then told me: "Tell them this. Tell them that the God of Angel Armies has spoken. This is God's message: 'I care a ton about Jerusalem and Zion. I'm super protective of them. But I'm really mad at the godless nations that act like they own the world. I was only a little mad before, but now they've gone way too far. I'm about to do something.'

"'I've come back to Jerusalem, but with compassion this time.' This is God speaking. 'I'll make sure my Temple gets rebuilt.' A decree from the God of Angel Armies! 'The rebuilding is already being planned out.' Say it again—a decree from the God of Angel Armies: 'My cities will be successful again, God will comfort Zion again, and Jerusalem will be my favorite again.'"
I looked up and was surprised by another vision: four horns!
I asked the Messenger-Angel, "And what's the meaning of this?"
He said, "These are the powers that have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem all over the place."
Then God showed me a vision with four blacksmiths.
I asked, "And what are these guys for?"

He said, "Since the 'horns' scattered Judah so bad that no one had any hope left, these blacksmiths have shown up to fight the horns. They'll dehorn the godless nations who used their horns to scatter Judah everywhere."

Zechariah.title: God's Moving In?! Jerusalem's Epic Glow-Up
paragraphs: I looked up and, no cap, there was a dude holding a tape measure. I was like, “Yo, what are you up to?”
He said, “I’m about to go measure Jerusalem, see how wide and long it is.”

Then, right at that moment, the angel who was with me was heading out and another angel came to meet him, saying, “Run! Go tell that surveyor guy, ‘Jerusalem is gonna be so packed with people and animals that it won’t even have walls. And I’ll be right there with her’—this is God’s decree—‘like a wall of fire all around unwalled Jerusalem, and I'll be a radiant presence right in the middle of it.’”

“Up on your feet! Get out of there—like, now!” God says so. “Come back from your exile in that far-off land. I scattered you to the four winds.” God’s decree. “Zion, you gotta escape from Babylon and come home—now!”

God-of-the-Angel-Armies, the One of Glory who sent me on my mission, had this to say about the godless nations that totally stripped you and left you homeless: “Anyone who hits you, hits me—it’s like they’re poking me in the eye. Yeah, and when the time is right, I’ll give the signal and they’ll get stripped and thrown out by their own servants.” Then you’ll know for real that God-of-the-Angel-Armies sent me on this mission.
“Shout and celebrate, Daughter of Zion! I’m on my way. I’m moving into your neighborhood!” That’s God’s decree.

At that time, a bunch of other nations will link up with God. (“They will become my family! I’ll live in their homes!”) And then you’ll know for sure that God-of-the-Angel-Armies sent me on this mission. God will reclaim his inheritance in Judah in the Holy Land. He’ll again make it clear that Jerusalem is his top choice.
Quiet, everyone! Shh! Be silent before God. Something is going down in his holy house. He’s making his move!

Zechariah.title: Joshua's Courtroom Drama: From Dirty Rags to Divine Robes
paragraphs: Alright, so next the Messenger-Angel showed me this vision of the high priest, Joshua. He was just standing there in front of God's Angel, and then boom, the Accuser—basically, Satan—rolls up to start pointing fingers. But God was like, 'Yo, Accuser, I shut you down! I'm shutting you down because I've chosen Jerusalem. Surprise! It looks like everything's a dumpster fire, but I'm reaching in and pulling Jerusalem right out of the flames.'

So there's Joshua, standing in front of the angel, and his clothes are just nasty, like he's been mud-wrestling. The angel turns to his crew and says, 'Get these gross clothes off him.' Then he looks at Joshua and says, 'See? I've totally wiped away your sin and I'm hooking you up with a fresh new fit.'

Then I couldn't help myself, I chimed in like, 'Hey, what about a clean new turban for his head too?' And they were like, 'Good call!' So they put a fresh turban on him and finished getting him all dressed up, with God's Angel watching the whole time.

Then God's Angel got serious and gave Joshua the official charge. He was like, 'This is a message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies: If you stick to my ways and stay loyal in serving me, you'll be the one in charge of my house and my courts. Plus, all these angels standing here will have your back.'

'Listen up, High Priest Joshua—this is for you and your crew sitting here with you, 'cause you guys are a sign of what's coming. Here's the deal: I'm about to introduce my servant, Branch. And get this: I'm putting this special stone in front of Joshua, a single stone with seven eyes on it.' This is a decree from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies, who says, 'I'm gonna engrave a message on it myself: I'm going to wipe out all the sin from this land, like, all at once, in a single day.'
'When that day comes, everyone's gonna be chill with each other, inviting their neighbors over for a hangout, just visiting and vibing on each other's porches.'

Zechariah.title: Don't Sleep on Small Beginnings
paragraphs: The angel who was talking to me came back and woke me up, like when you're in a super deep sleep.
He asked, “Yo, what do you see?”
I was like, “I see this solid gold lampstand with a bowl on top. It's got seven lamps, and each lamp has seven spouts. And there are two olive trees, one on each side.”
So I asked the angel, “Sir, what's the deal with all this?”
The angel was like, “You seriously don't get it?”
“Nah, for real, I don't,” I said.

Then he explained, “This is God's message for Zerubbabel: It's not about your own strength or power. It's all about my Spirit, says the LORD of Heaven's Armies. So that huge mountain in your way? It's gonna look like a tiny little hill next to Zerubbabel. He's gonna lay the final stone of the temple, and everyone's gonna be cheering, ‘Let's go! Let's go! Get it done!’”

Then God's word came to me again: “Zerubbabel laid the foundation of this temple, and he's gonna be the one to finish it. That's how you'll know for sure that the LORD of Heaven's Armies sent me to you. Who dares to look down on these small beginnings? They'll be singing a different tune when they see Zerubbabel putting that final stone in place!”
Back to the vision, the angel said, “Those seven lamps? They're the eyes of the LORD, searching every nook and cranny of the world.”
I asked, “But what about the two olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they mean? And what about the two olive branches that are pouring oil into the lamps?”
He was like, “You still haven't figured it out?”
I said, “Nope, no clue, sir.”
He said, “These are the two who are anointed to serve the Lord of all the earth, supplying his light to the whole world.”

Zechariah.title: Flying Scrolls & Wickedness in a Basket?!
paragraphs: So I looked up again, and you won't believe what I saw—a flying book! Like, for real, a book with wings.
The angel asked me, "What are you seeing now?"
I was like, "I see a flying book, and it's massive—like 30 feet long and 15 feet wide!"

He explained, "This scroll is basically the judgment call going out to all the thieves and liars in the world. One side of the scroll is for the thieves, and the other side is for the liars. God sent it out, and it's going to fly into the house of every single thief and liar, land there, and completely wreck the place, from the roof to the foundation."
Then the angel showed up again and was like, "Look up. What do you see?"
I was like, "Whoa, what is that thing?"
He said, "It's a big basket, and it's on a trip. It's basically carrying the sins of everyone, everywhere."
Then the heavy lead lid was lifted off the basket, and guess what? There was a woman just sitting inside!
He said, "That's 'Miss Wickedness' herself." Then he shoved her back down into the basket and slammed the lead lid back on.
Then I looked up, and get this—I saw two women flying. They had wings and they were airlifting the basket up into the sky.
I asked the angel, "Yo, where are they taking that basket?"
He said, "They're taking it east to Shinar. They're going to build a special place for it, and once it's ready, the basket will be stored there for good."

Zechariah.title: God's Wild Chariot Race & A King Named Branch?!
paragraphs: Yo, I looked up again and saw something else totally wild. Four chariots were just blasting out from between these two mountains, and the mountains were made of bronze. Insane.
The first chariot had red horses, the second had black ones, the third had white, and the fourth had these spotted ones. And all of them were super strong, like total beasts.
I was like, 'Yo, angel dude, what's the deal with this?'

The angel said, 'These are the four winds of heaven, and they come from the Lord of the whole planet. The black horses are going north, and the white ones are right behind them. The spotted ones are going south.' These powerful horses just took off, full of energy, ready to check out the whole world. The angel yelled, 'Go! Check out the earth!' and boom, they were gone in every direction.
Then he shouted to me, 'Look at them! The ones going north are bringing my peaceful and secure spirit with them. So, no more drama from up there.'

Then God gave me this message: 'Go get a donation from the exiles. Find Heldai, Tobiah, and Jedaiah. They just got back from Babylon. You'll find them at Josiah's house. Get some silver and gold from them and make some crowns. Put one on the head of Joshua, the high priest, and tell him this:

'A message from God, the commander of angel armies. Listen up. There's a guy named Branch. He's going to grow from where he is and build God's Temple. Yep, he's the one. He'll build God's Temple. Then he'll be treated like royalty, sit on the throne and rule—a priest on a throne!—showing that a king and a priest can actually get along.'
'The other crown will be kept in God's Temple as a symbol of royalty, and Helem, Tobiah, Jedaiah, and Hen will be in charge of it.'

'People will come from all over the place to help rebuild God's Temple. This will prove that God, the commander of angel armies, really sent me to you. All this will happen if you actually listen and obey what your God says.'

Zechariah.title: Are You For Real? God's Not Into Fake Religion
paragraphs: On the fourth day of the ninth month, during the fourth year King Darius was in charge, God hit up Zechariah with another message.

Basically, the town of Bethel sent a crew with Sarezer and Regem-Melech to go pray and get some advice from the priests at the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and the prophets too. They asked, “So, like, should we still do our big sad fast in August to mark the 70th anniversary of Jerusalem getting wrecked, like we’ve been doing for years?”

God-of-the-Angel-Armies gave me this message for all the people and the priests: “Yo, when you were fasting all dramatically in the fifth and seventh months for the last seventy years, were you *really* doing that for me? And when you had big parties and feasts, was that for me either? Lowkey, no. You're all about the religious rules, but I'm all about the people.

“There’s nothing new to say here. Don’t you remember the message from the OG prophets back when Jerusalem was popping and the whole area was full of people? God gave Zechariah this message, and it hasn't changed. God-of-the-Angel-Armies said it then and is saying it now:
“‘Treat each other right. Love your neighbors. Be compassionate. Don’t rip off widows, orphans, immigrants, or the poor. And stop plotting against each other—that’s just evil.’

“But did your ancestors listen? Nah, they were stubborn AF. They plugged their ears. They totally hardened their hearts against God’s truth and the sermons the earlier prophets gave, which were straight from the Spirit by order of God-of-the-Angel-Armies. And God got legit angry, because he laid it all out for them, and they wouldn't listen to a single word.

“So, God-of-the-Angel-Armies was like, ‘Fine, if you won't listen to me, I'm not listening to you.’ He scattered them all over the place, making them strangers in foreign lands. Their awesome ‘promised land’ turned into a total wasteland—just weeds and trash. Zero signs of life. They turned a dream into a dump.”

Zechariah.title: God's Epic Comeback for Jerusalem
paragraphs: Yo, so God of the Angel Armies dropped some more messages, and here's the deal:
This is a message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"I'm super passionate about Zion, like, I actually care. I'm kinda mad about what's happened to Zion, so I'm getting involved."
God's message continued:
"I'm back in Zion, for real. I've moved back to Jerusalem. Jerusalem's gonna get some new nicknames: 'Truth City,' 'Mountain of the God of the Angel Armies,' and 'Mount Holiness.' How cool is that?"
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Old guys and ladies will be chilling in Jerusalem again, sitting on benches in the streets, telling stories, and walking around safely with their canes. It's gonna be a great place to grow old. And kids, boys and girls, will be all over the parks, laughing and playing. It's gonna be a great place to grow up."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"So, you think the problems of coming back and rebuilding with just a few people are too much? Seriously? Is anything too much for me? Not a chance."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"I'm gonna gather my people from all over, from the east and the west. I'll bring them back and they'll live in Jerusalem. They'll be my people, and I'll be their God. I'm gonna stick with them and always do right by them."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Alright, get it together. Listen up, you who are hearing what I'm saying through the prophets. The Temple of the God of the Angel Armies is back. The Temple is being rebuilt. We've been through some tough times, for sure. You were working for basically nothing, and the streets were sketchy. You always had to watch your back. I had turned the world into a war zone.
"But things are different now. I'm on the side of my crew of survivors.
"You'll be able to plant and harvest again. The vines will have grapes, the gardens will be poppin', and everything will be green and lush.

"My crew of survivors will have everything they need and then some. You guys in Judah and Israel have had a bad rap, like you're the bad-news crew. But I'm coming to save you. From now on, you're the good-news crew. So don't be scared. Just hold on to what I'm doing."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"Just like I decided to punish your ancestors when they made me mad, and I didn't hold back, now I've decided to bless Jerusalem and Judah. Don't be afraid. So here's what I want you to do: Tell the truth, the whole truth, and nothing but the truth. Be good to each other, in your personal lives and in court. Don't be scheming to get ahead by taking advantage of people. Don't say or do things that aren't true. I hate all that stuff. Just keep your lives simple and honest. That's a decree from God."
Then I got another message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"Those sad days you had in the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months? They're gonna be party days for Judah. Feasts, celebrations, holidays. So embrace truth and love peace!"
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:

"People and their leaders are gonna come from all over to see what's up. The leaders will be like, 'Yo, shouldn't we get in on this? Get some of God's blessings? Pray to the God of the Angel Armies? What are we waiting for? Let's go!'
"Tons of people, even powerful nations, will come to Jerusalem to see what they can get from the God of the Angel Armies, trying to get a blessing from God."
A message from the God of the Angel Armies:
"When that time comes, ten guys who speak different languages will grab a Jewish person's sleeve, hold on tight, and say, 'Let us go with you. We heard God is with you.'"

Zechariah.title: The King is Coming & He's Lowkey... Riding a Donkey?!
paragraphs: War Bulletin:

God's message is calling out the country of Hadrach. It's gonna land hard on Damascus. The whole world is watching God, not just Israel. That includes Hamath on the border, and Tyre and Sidon, who think they're so smart. Tyre built a crazy kingdom for itself, stacking up silver like firewood and piling up gold like haystacks. But for real, God's gonna make them go bankrupt. He's gonna toss all that wealth into the ocean and burn what's left in a huge fire. Ashkelon will see it and freak out, Gaza will be wringing its hands, and Ekron will hit a dead end. Gaza's king will die. Ashkelon will be a ghost town, and some random villain will take over Ashdod.

“I’m gonna humble proud Philistia. I’ll make them spit out their gross, bloody sacrifices and give up their nasty habits.” Whatever's left will belong to God—a small group of survivors, a family brought together in Judah. But enemies like Ekron will end up like the Jebusites—basically, erased from history. “I'm gonna set up camp in my own country and protect it from anyone who tries to invade. No one is ever gonna mess with my people again. I'm keeping a close watch on them.

I’ll make them spit out their gross, bloody sacrifices and give up their nasty habits.” Whatever's left will belong to God—a small group of survivors, a family brought together in Judah. But enemies like Ekron will end up like the Jebusites—basically, erased from history. “I'm gonna set up camp in my own country and protect it from anyone who tries to invade. No one is ever gonna mess with my people again. I'm keeping a close watch on them.

“Shout and get hyped, Zion! Let's hear you, Jerusalem! Your king is coming! He's a good king who makes everything right, a humble king riding on a donkey, just a young colt. I'm so over war—no more chariots in Ephraim, no more war horses in Jerusalem, no more swords and spears, bows and arrows. He's gonna bring peace to all the nations, a peaceful rule over the whole world, from sea to shining sea.

“And as for you, because of the blood covenant I made with you, I'm gonna free your prisoners from their hopeless situations. Come home, you prisoners who now have hope! Today, I'm telling you, you're getting a double bonus—everything you lost is coming back to you, times two! Judah is my new weapon, the bow I'm gonna pull. Ephraim is the arrow I'm loading up. I'm gonna get your sons, Zion, ready to fight against the sons of Greece. From now on, my people are my swords.”

“And as for you, because of the blood covenant I made with you, I'm gonna free your prisoners from their hopeless situations. Come home, you prisoners who now have hope! Today, I'm telling you, you're getting a double bonus—everything you lost is coming back to you, times two! Judah is my new weapon, the bow I'm gonna pull. Ephraim is the arrow I'm loading up. I'm gonna get your sons, Zion, ready to fight against the sons of Greece. From now on, my people are my swords.”

Then God will show up, and his arrows will flash like lightning! The Lord GOD will sound the trumpet and march out in a whirlwind. The GOD-of-the-Angel-Armies will protect them. It's gonna be an all-out war, the war to end all wars, no holding back. Their God will save them that day. He'll rescue them. They'll be like gentle sheep, or like shiny jewels in a crown, sparkling in the sun. They're gonna shine so bright! The young men will be strong and the young women will be beautiful!

Zechariah.title: God's Epic Comeback Plan
paragraphs: Ayo, when you need that spring rain, you gotta ask God for it. He's the one who makes the thunderstorms happen and gets the crops growing.

Those fake gods you see in stores? Total nonsense. And the religious gurus? They're just talking trash. Their advice is basically smoke. So the people are all lost, like sheep without a shepherd to look after them. God is seriously ticked off at these so-called leaders. He thinks they're a joke and is gonna treat them like it.

But God, the leader of the angel armies, is gonna step in and take care of his squad, the people of Judah. He's gonna hype them up and make them proud to be on his team. God's gonna use them in his big rebuilding project, like they're the foundation and the main pillars. They'll be the tools and the supervisors for the whole thing. They'll be a crew to be proud of, all working together, super confident, walking through any mess. They'll be brave and full of energy because God is with them, not scared of any bullies.

God's like, "I'm gonna make the people of Judah strong; I'm gonna rescue the people of Joseph. I see what they've been through, and I'm gonna give them a total reset. It's a fresh start, like none of the bad stuff ever happened. Why? 'Cause I'm their God, and I'll do whatever it takes for them. The people of Ephraim will be famous, their lives just filled with good vibes. Their kids will get in on it too—man, they'll see how blessed they are by God! I'll just give a signal, and they'll all come running back. I've freed them, and they're gonna thrive, for real. Even though I scattered them all over the world, they'll remember me way out there. They'll pass down the stories to their kids, and they will come back home. I'll bring them back from Egypt in the west and gather them from Assyria in the east. I'll bring them back to the good land of Gilead and Lebanon. The whole place will be filled with people coming home. They'll get through any tough times, pushing past any obstacle. Huge rivers will seem like nothing. Flashy Assyria will get exposed, and bully Egypt will be shown for the fraud it is. But my people—yo, I'll make them super strong, God-level strong! And they'll live life my way." That's a promise from God!

Zechariah.title: God Fires a Shepherd & Breaks Everything
paragraphs: Alright, Lebanon, you think you're so great? Open up your gates, 'cause a fire is coming for your famous trees. All you big-shot pine trees, get ready to cry. And you cedars? You're basically just firewood now. Hey, Bashan oaks, you can weep too. Your super thick forest? It's about to be a field of stumps. You hear that? That's the sound of shepherds freaking out 'cause they just lost everything. And the lions? They're roaring mad 'cause their jungle home in the Jordan is totally wrecked. Make way for the people coming back from exile!

God told me, 'Go be a shepherd to these sheep that are basically walking dead.' The people who buy them are just gonna kill them for a quick buck, and no one's gonna do anything about it. The sellers are all like, 'Sweet! I'm rich! God must love me!' And the shepherds they have now? They literally could not care less about them.

God's decree was basically: 'I'm washing my hands of the people of this land. From now on they’re all on their own. It’s a total free-for-all, survival of the fittest, every person for themselves. Don't even think about asking me for help.'

So I took over from the trashy, money-hungry owners and started shepherding the sheep that were marked for slaughter. I got myself two shepherd staffs. I named one 'Grace' and the other 'Unity.' Then I got to work. In less than a month, I got rid of the three corrupt shepherds. I was so over their drama—and they couldn't stand me either.

But then I got tired of the sheep too and was like, 'I'm out. No more shepherding from me. If you die, you die. If you get attacked, you get attacked. Whoever's left can just eat each other for all I care.'
Then I took my staff named 'Grace' and snapped it in half. Just like that, the awesome promise I had with all the people was broken. The greedy owners saw me do it and knew it was a message from God.
Then I told them, 'Pay me what you think I'm worth.' So they paid me a ridiculously insulting amount: thirty silver coins. It was a joke.
God told me, 'Throw it in the charity box.' That's how little they thought of me and all my work! So I took the thirty silver coins and chucked them into the charity box at God's Temple.
Then I broke my other staff, 'Unity,' and snapped it in half, breaking the family bond between Judah and Israel.

Then God said, 'Now, go act like a totally clueless shepherd. Because I'm about to put a shepherd just like that in charge of this land—a shepherd who doesn't care about the suffering, ignores the lost, abandons the injured, and looks down on good people. He'll only be in it for himself, using and abusing everyone.

'You're so screwed, you useless shepherd, just walking away and leaving the sheep! A curse on your arm and a curse on your right eye! Your arm will be totally useless, and your right eye will go completely blind.'

Zechariah.title: Jerusalem's Epic Comeback Story
paragraphs: War Bulletin:

A message from God about Israel, a decree from the very God who created the universe, put the earth in its place, and gave us life: 'Yo, check this out: I'm about to make Jerusalem like a super strong drink that will make all the people attacking Judah and Jerusalem totally wasted and confused.'

'On that big day, I'm gonna make Jerusalem like a massive boulder that nobody can move. Anyone who tries to lift it will get seriously hurt. All the other nations will team up to try and get rid of it, but it's not gonna happen.'

'On that day,' God says, 'I'll make all the enemy horses freak out and their riders too. But I'll be watching over Judah, keeping them safe, while I make the enemy's horses go blind. The people of Judah will be like, 'Wow, our leaders are super strong because of God, our God.'

'On that day, I'll make the families of Judah like a lit match in a dry forest, or a torch in a barn full of hay. They'll destroy everyone around them, left and right, while Jerusalem gets filled up with its own people again, making it their home.'

'I, God, will start by helping out the regular families of Judah first, so that the big shots in David's family and the leaders in Jerusalem don't get all the glory and overshadow the ordinary people. On that day, I'll take care of everyone in Jerusalem, so even the weakest person will be as awesome as King David, and David's family will be like angels leading the people.'
'On that day, I'm gonna completely get rid of all the nations that came to fight against Jerusalem.'

'Then, I'll deal with David's family and the people in Jerusalem. I'll give them a spirit of grace and prayer. They'll finally realize that I'm the one they hurt so badly, the one they stabbed with a spear. And they will be so, so sorry. They'll cry and mourn like a parent who lost their first child. The sadness in Jerusalem that day will be huge, as famous as the mourning for Hadad-Rimmon in the fields of Megiddo.'

'Everyone will be crying and grieving, the whole land and everyone in it: David's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Nathan's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Levi's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; Shimei's family by themselves, and their women by themselves; and all the other families by themselves, and their women by themselves.'

Zechariah.title: No More Fakes
paragraphs: On that epic day, a fountain's gonna burst open for David's fam and all the Jerusalem crew. It's for a total spiritual shower, washing away all their sin and grime.

God of the Angel Armies says, 'On that day, I'm deleting all the fake, store-bought gods from existence. Their names will be totally erased from memory. People will be like, 'Never heard of 'em.' And I'm kicking out all those prophets who were polluting the world with their toxic talk.' And get this—if someone keeps trying to spread those toxic, polluting words, their own parents will step up and be like, 'Dude, you're done. Your lies about God are putting everyone at risk.' And then, no joke, they'll take him out right then and there while he's prophesying. His own parents!

On that same epic day, all the lying prophets are gonna get totally exposed and humiliated. They'll be wishing they never scammed people with their so-called 'visions.' No more pretending to be prophets. They'll be like, 'A prophet? Who, me? Nah, I'm just a farmer, been working the land my whole life.' And if someone points out, 'So, what's with the black eye?' they'll just make up some lame excuse like, 'Oh, I walked into a door at my friend's place.'

Then God of the Angel Armies gives this command: 'Sword, go after my shepherd, my right-hand man! Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will scatter. I'll even turn my back on the little lambs.' God's decree says that all over the land, two-thirds will be wiped out, but one-third will make it through. And that surviving third? I'm gonna put them through the fire, like refining silver, and test them like gold to see if they're the real deal. Then they'll call my name, and I'll answer them personally. I'll say, 'You are my people.' And they'll say, 'God is my God!'

Zechariah.title: God's Ultimate Battle Royale
paragraphs: Yo, for real, God's Judgment Day is coming. It's gonna be wild. Loot will be stacked high and passed around. God's bringing all the nations that don't follow Him to attack Jerusalem. Houses will be robbed, women assaulted, half the city will be dragged into exile, and the other half just left behind.

But then, plot twist! God will march out and fight those nations Himself—it's gonna be a huge war! On that day, He'll stand on the Mount of Olives, east of Jerusalem. The Mount of Olives will literally split down the middle, east to west, creating a massive valley. Half the mountain will move north, the other half south. You'll have to run for your lives down that valley, your escape route that goes all the way to Azal. You'll be running for your life, just like people did during that insane earthquake back when Uzziah was king. Then my God will show up with all the holy angels.
That day is gonna be something else. No more cold nights—actually, no more nights at all! The Day is coming—God's got the timing—when it'll be daylight 24/7. Every evening will just be a new morning.
What a day that will be! Fresh rivers will flow out of Jerusalem, one half to the eastern sea, the other half to the western sea, flowing all year round, summer and winter.
God will be king over the whole earth, one God and one God only. That day will be legendary.

And the land around Jerusalem will stretch out wide—from Geba in the north to Rimmon in the south. Jerusalem will be towering in the center, with all its main gates—from the Gate of Benjamin to the First Gate to the Corner Gate, and from the Tower of Hananel to the Royal Winery—the city will be packed with people. Jerusalem will never be completely destroyed again. From then on, it'll be a safe city.

But here's what's gonna happen to everyone who fought against Jerusalem: God will hit them with a gnarly plague. People's skin will rot right off their bones while they're still walking around. Their eyes will rot in their sockets, and their tongues will rot in their mouths. People will literally be dying on their feet! It'll be mass chaos when that happens—total panic. Soldiers will start fighting and killing each other—it's gonna be terrifying. And then Judah will jump into the fight.

The treasures from all the nations will be piled high—gold, silver, and all the latest styles. The plague will also hit the animals—horses, mules, camels, donkeys. Everything alive in the enemy camps will get hit by the plague.

All the survivors from the nations that fought Jerusalem will have to go to Jerusalem every year to worship the King, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and to celebrate the Feast of Booths. If any of these survivors don't make the yearly trip to Jerusalem to worship the King, God-of-the-Angel-Armies, they won't get any rain. If the Egyptians don't go and worship, no rain for them either. Any nation that doesn't go up to celebrate the Feast of Booths will get hit with the plague. Egypt and any other nation that skips the pilgrimage to celebrate the Feast of Booths will get punished.

On that Day, the Big Day, even the bells on the horses' harnesses will be engraved with 'Holy to God.' The cooking pots in God's Temple will be as sacred as the special cups and plates on the altar. In fact, every single pot and pan in all the kitchens of Jerusalem and Judah will be holy to God-of-the-Angel-Armies. People who come to worship and prepare their meals and sacrifices will use them. On that Big Day, there will be no more buying or selling in the Temple of God-of-the-Angel-Armies.

Malachi.title: God's Got Beef: The Priests Are Lowkey Scammers
paragraphs: Alright, so here's the 411. God has a message for the people of Israel, and he's delivering it through his prophet, Malachi.
God straight up says, "I love you guys."
But the people are skeptical, like, "For real? How have you even shown us love?"

God's reply is basically, "Dude, just look at history. See how differently I treated your ancestor Jacob compared to his brother Esau? I chose Jacob and rejected Esau. I totally wrecked Esau's territory and turned his whole country into a ghost town."

When the Edomites (Esau's descendants) were all like, "We got knocked down, but we'll just rebuild and be better than ever," the LORD of Heaven's Armies said, "Go ahead, try me. When I knock you down, you stay down. People will look at your land and call it 'The Evil Territory' and you'll be known as 'the people God cursed.'"
"Yeah, for real, take a good look. Then you'll see how loyal my love for you has been, and you'll want even more. You'll be saying, 'May God's greatness be known even beyond the borders of Israel!'"

"Okay, real talk. A son respects his father, and a servant respects his master, right? So if I'm your Father, where's my respect? If I'm your Master, where's the honor?" The LORD of Heaven's Armies is calling you out, you priests. "You despise my name!"
And you're like, "No way! How are we despising you?"
"By offering lame, messed-up sacrifices during worship. That's how."
Then you ask, "What do you mean, 'messed-up'? What's so bad about it?"

"It's when you say, 'The Lord's altar isn't a big deal anymore; worship isn't a priority.' That's how it's messed up. And when you bring worthless animals for sacrifices—the blind, sick, and injured ones you're just trying to get rid of—isn't that messed up? Try pulling a stunt like that with your governor. You think he'd be impressed?" asks the LORD of Heaven's Armies.
"So now, go ahead and beg God to be nice to you. But since you priests caused all this trouble, do you really think he's going to listen to you?" asks the LORD of Heaven's Armies.

"Honestly, I wish one of you would just lock the Temple doors so you can't come in and play these fake religious games with your empty worship. I'm not happy," says the LORD of Heaven's Armies. "And I don't want any more of your so-called worship!"

"My name is honored by people all over the world. From east to west, they know how to worship me right, honoring me by bringing their absolute best. They're all saying it: 'God is great, this LORD of Heaven's Armies.'"

"But not you guys. Instead of honoring me, you're disrespecting me. You do it when you say, 'Worship is whatever, and what we bring doesn't matter,' and when you complain, 'Ugh, this is so boring, I get nothing out of it.' You act all high and mighty, looking down your noses—at me, the LORD of Heaven's Armies! And the sacrifices you do bring are just leftovers, broken or useless. You really think I'm going to accept that? This is God telling you straight up!"

"So a curse on the person who pretends they're doing something big for me—like promising an expensive sacrifice—but then swaps it out for something cheap and worthless at the last second. I'm a great King," says the LORD of Heaven's Armies, "and my name is respected everywhere. I'm not going to tolerate this disrespect!"

Malachi.title: God's Calling You Out, Priests!
paragraphs: Alright, priests, listen up. This one's for you. If you don't start listening to me and giving me the respect I deserve—I'm the God of Angel Armies, btw—then I'm gonna curse you. All those blessings you have? Yeah, they're turning into curses. Actually, it's already happening because you're not taking me seriously. And this curse is gonna hit your kids too. I'm gonna smear nasty, rotten trash from your own parties all over your faces. Have fun with that.

Maybe that'll finally get your attention. Maybe then you'll get that I'm calling you out to bring back the deal I made with your ancestor Levi. That was a promise from the God of Angel Armies, you know? My deal with Levi was all about life and peace. I kept my end of the bargain, and he respected me for it. He was genuinely in awe of me. He taught the truth, no cap. He was my boy, always doing the right thing. He saved a ton of people from messing up their lives.

It's a priest's job to teach the truth. People are supposed to go to them for real guidance. The priest is a messenger from the God of Angel Armies. But you guys have totally bailed on that. Your teachings have messed up so many people. You've wrecked the deal I had with Levi. The God of Angel Armies is saying it, so you know it's real. And that's why I'm exposing you for what you are. Everyone's gonna be grossed out by you and stay away because you don't live like I told you to, and you twist my words instead of teaching them straight up.
Don't we all have the same Dad? Didn't the same God make all of us? So why are we always fighting? Why are we disrespecting the promise our ancestors made that's supposed to hold us together?

Judah totally cheated on God—it's a disgusting betrayal in Israel and Jerusalem. Judah has dishonored God's holy standards by falling for and marrying foreign women who worship other gods. God's curse on anyone who does this! Kick them out of their homes! They're not fit to be part of the community anymore, no matter how many gifts they try to bring to the God of Angel Armies.

And here's another thing you're doing wrong: You flood the temple with your crying and complaining because you're not getting what you want from God. You wanna know why? It's simple. God was there when you made your wedding vows to the bride you married when you were young. And now you've broken those vows. You broke the sacred bond with your partner, your wife by covenant. God made marriage, not you. His Spirit is in every part of it. And what does he want from marriage? Godly kids, that's what. So protect the spirit of your marriage. Don't cheat on your spouse.
"I hate divorce," says the God of Israel. The God of Angel Armies says, "I hate the violent tearing apart of the 'one flesh' of marriage." So watch yourselves. Don't let your guard down. Don't cheat.
You're making God tired with all your talk.
"How are we making him tired?" you ask.
By saying stuff like, "God is cool with sinners and sin." and "Judgment? Nah, God's too nice to judge."

Malachi.title: God's Messenger is Coming & He's Got Receipts
paragraphs: “Yo, check it! I’m sending my messenger ahead to clear the path for me. Then, bam, out of nowhere, the Leader you’ve been looking for will just show up in his Temple—yep, the Messenger of the Covenant you’ve all been waiting for. Look! He’s on his way!” This is a direct message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
But for real, who’s gonna be able to handle that? Who can even survive when he shows up?

He’ll be like a blazing hot fire in a furnace. He’ll be like the strongest soap you can get. He’s gonna sit down like a silversmith, purifying and cleaning everything up. He’ll scrub the Levite priests clean, refining them like gold and silver, until they’re good enough for God, ready to make offerings that are actually righteous. Then, and only then, will Judah and Jerusalem be right with God and pleasing to him, like they were way back in the day.

“Yeah, I’m coming to you with judgment. I’ll be a witness against sorcerers, cheaters, liars, people who rip off their workers, those who take advantage of widows and orphans, and those who are rude to immigrants—basically anyone and everyone who doesn’t respect me.” A message from the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.

“I am God—yeah, I Am. I haven’t changed. And because I haven’t changed, you, the descendants of Jacob, haven’t been totally wiped out. You guys have a long history of straight-up ignoring my rules. You haven’t done a single thing I’ve told you. Come back to me so I can come back to you,” says the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
“You ask, ‘But how do we come back?’
“Start by being honest. Do honest people rob God? But you guys rob me every single day.
“You ask, ‘How have we robbed you?’

“The tithe and the offering—that’s how! And now you’re all under a curse—the whole nation—because you’re robbing me. Bring your full tithe to the Temple treasury so there’s plenty of food in my Temple. Test me in this and see if I don’t throw open the windows of heaven for you and pour out a blessing so huge you won’t know what to do with it. I’ll protect your crops from pests, and your fields and gardens won’t be raided.” The Message of the God-of-the-Angel-Armies.
“You’ll be called the ‘Happiest Nation.’ You’ll see what it’s like to be a country full of grace.” The God-of-the-Angel-Armies says so.
God says, “You’ve said some really harsh, rude things to me.
“And you ask, ‘When did we ever say that?’

“It was when you said, ‘It’s pointless to serve God. What do we get out of it? We did what he said, walked around looking all serious for the God-of-the-Angel-Armies, and what difference did it make? The people who do whatever they want are the lucky ones. They break all the rules and still get ahead. They push God to the limit and get away with it.’”

Then the people who truly honored God got together and talked about it. God saw what they were doing and listened in. A book was opened in God’s presence, and minutes were taken of the meeting, with the names of everyone who feared and honored God’s name written down.

The God-of-the-Angel-Armies said, “They’re mine, all mine. They’ll get special treatment when I make my move. I’ll treat them with the same care and kindness that parents give a child who respects them. And you’ll once again see the huge difference between someone who does the right thing and someone who doesn’t, between serving God and not serving him.”

Malachi.title: The Final Showdown: Good vs. Evil
paragraphs: Yo, for real, a day is coming that's gonna be like a massive wildfire. All the proud, evil people? They're gonna get torched like kindling, totally burnt up. Nothing left but scorched earth and ash. It's gonna be a dark day for them. But for you guys who respect my name? It's gonna be like a sunrise. The sun of justice will show up, bringing healing vibes. You'll be super energetic, like a young horse just let out to play. And you'll totally crush the wicked—they'll be like dust under your feet on that day. That's a promise from the God of Angel Armies.
Don't forget the instructions I gave through my boy Moses, the stuff I commanded at Horeb for all of Israel—all the rules for how to live right.

But also, get ready for what's next. I'm sending the prophet Elijah to prep everyone for the huge Day of God—the ultimate Judgment Day! He's gonna get parents to actually care about their kids, and kids to respect their parents. If they don't, I'll have to come and basically curse the whole land.
